projects.content:
## Overview

Agency Agents, presented as The Agency, is a growing collection of meticulously crafted AI agent personalities\. Each agent is described as a specialized expert with a distinct voice, processes, and concrete deliverables\. The project includes a native desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows that browses the roster and installs agents into supported tools, plus scripts for command\-line and multi\-tool integration\.

## Key Features

- Specialized agents with deep domain expertise rather than generic prompt templates\.
- Personality\-driven voices, communication styles, and approaches for each agent\.
- Deliverable\-focused profiles with code examples, workflows, and success metrics\.
- Production\-ready agent workflows described as battle\-tested\.
- Native desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows that browses the roster, installs agents with a click, and auto\-updates\.
- Script\-based installation and multi\-tool integration, including selection by division or individual agent\.

## Use Cases

- Activate a specialist mode inside Claude Code sessions, such as Frontend Developer mode for building a React component\.
- Install selected divisions or individual agents into supported tools such as Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode\.
- Use agent files as reference material to adapt identity, workflows, technical deliverables, and success metrics\.
- Browse and install the roster through the native desktop app or command\-line scripts\.

## Getting Started

- Install the native Agency Agents app for macOS, Linux, or Windows to browse the roster and install agents into supported tools\.
- On a Mac, install the app with: brew install \-\-cask msitarzewski/agency\-agents/agency\-agents\.
- For Claude Code, run \./scripts/install\.sh \-\-tool claude\-code to install all agents, or copy engineering markdown files into ~/\.claude/agents/\.
- For other supported tools, run \./scripts/convert\.sh to generate integration files, then run \./scripts/install\.sh and select a target tool\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The native app is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Script\-based installation uses the repository scripts install\.sh and convert\.sh and supports Claude Code and other listed development tools\.
- OpenCode installations should use a subset selected with \-\-division because of its runtime registration limit\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- OpenCode's runtime may silently drop agents beyond its registration limit, so install a subset with \-\-division and heed installer warnings\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Agency Agents（项目中也称 The Agency）是一组经过精心构建、持续扩充的 AI 代理角色集合。每个代理都被描述为具备鲜明表达风格、流程和具体交付物的领域专家。项目提供面向 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 的原生桌面应用，可浏览整个代理名册并将代理安装到支持的工具中，也提供用于命令行和多工具集成的脚本。

## 核心功能

- 特色包括：专注特定领域的代理，而非通用提示模板；每个代理拥有个性化表达、沟通方式与工作方法；以交付为导向，包含代码示例、工作流和成功指标；工作流被描述为经过实战检验且可直接用于生产；原生桌面应用支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，可浏览名册、一键安装并自动更新；提供脚本安装与多工具集成，支持按部门或单个代理选择。

## 适用场景

projects.content:
## Overview

agent\-browser is a browser automation CLI designed for AI agents\. It provides compact text output to reduce context usage and is implemented as a native Rust CLI with a client\-daemon architecture that manages Chrome via the Chrome DevTools Protocol\.

## Key Features

- Agent\-first compact text output uses fewer tokens than JSON for AI context efficiency\.
- Snapshot returns an accessibility tree with refs for deterministic element selection\.
- 50\+ commands cover navigation, forms, screenshots, network, storage, files, tabs, frames, and debugging\.
- Built\-in observability includes video recording, streaming, debugging, profiler, and diffing tools\.
- Stateful sessions, profiles, auth state, cookies, storage, proxy, and security controls support long\-running agents\.
- Cross\-platform native binaries are available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.

## Use Cases

- AI coding agents and shell\-capable agents can drive browsers through CLI commands\.
- Agents can navigate pages, inspect accessibility snapshots, interact by ref, capture screenshots, and close the browser\.
- Long\-running agents can use sessions, profiles, auth state, cookies, storage, and proxy controls\.
- Developers can use built\-in recording, streaming, debugging, profiling, and diffing for browser workflow observation\.

## Getting Started

- Install globally with npm install \-g agent\-browser, then run agent\-browser install to download Chrome on first use\.
- Try without installing by running npx agent\-browser open example\.com\.
- Use agent\-browser open example\.com, agent\-browser snapshot, agent\-browser click @e2, agent\-browser fill @e3 "test@example\.com", agent\-browser get text @e1, agent\-browser screenshot page\.png, and agent\-browser close for a basic workflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Chrome is required; run agent\-browser install to download Chrome from Chrome for Testing, and existing Chrome, Brave, Playwright, and Puppeteer installations are detected automatically\.
- No Playwright or Node\.js is required for the daemon\.
- Node\.js 24\+ and pnpm 11\+ are required only when building from source; Rust is also required only when building from source\.
- On Linux, agent\-browser install \-\-with\-deps installs system dependencies and exits nonzero if the package manager cannot install every required browser library\.
- Native binaries are provided for macOS ARM64 and x64, Linux ARM64 and x64, and Windows x64\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Chrome is the runtime browser dependency; existing Chrome, Brave, Playwright, and Puppeteer installations are detected automatically, and the daemon does not require Playwright or Node\.js\.
- The daemon exits after one hour without commands or dashboard input by default; headed browsers, Safari and iOS WebDriver sessions, and user\-attached browsers are exempt, while provider\-owned cloud browsers are not\.
- WebMCP page\-provided names, descriptions, schemas, annotations, and results are untrusted data\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Agent Development Kit (ADK) is an open\-source, code\-first Python framework for building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents\. It applies software development principles to AI agent creation and is designed to simplify building, deploying, and orchestrating agent workflows, from simple tasks to complex systems\. ADK is optimized for Gemini but is model\-agnostic, deployment\-agnostic, and compatible with other frameworks\.

## Key Features

- Workflow Runtime: graph\-based execution engine for composing deterministic agentic app flows with routing, fan\-out/fan\-in, loops, retry, state management, dynamic nodes, human\-in\-the\-loop, and nested workflows\.
- Task API: structured agent\-to\-agent delegation with multi\-turn task mode, single\-turn controlled output, mixed delegation patterns, human\-in\-the\-loop, and task agents as workflow nodes\.
- Modular Multi\-Agent Systems: compose multiple specialized agents into flexible hierarchies for scalable applications\.
- Rich Tool Ecosystem: use pre\-built tools, custom functions, OpenAPI specs, MCP tools, or existing tools to give agents diverse capabilities\.
- Code\-First Development: define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for flexibility, testability, and versioning\.
- Deploy Anywhere: containerize and deploy agents on Cloud Run or scale with Vertex AI Agent Engine\.

## Use Cases

- Building, evaluating, and deploying sophisticated AI agents with flexibility and control\.
- Creating modular multi\-agent systems by composing specialized agents into flexible hierarchies\.
- Orchestrating agent workflows from simple tasks to complex systems with routing, loops, retry, state, and human\-in\-the\-loop\.
- Running local development and evaluation through interactive CLI, Web UI, and bundled evaluation samples\.

## Getting Started

- Install the latest stable release with pip install google\-adk; Python 3\.10\+ is required\.
- For transitive dependency protection, install with companion constraints files for Python 3\.10 to 3\.14\.
- Define an Agent with name, model, and instruction, and define a Workflow with edges to orchestrate agents\.
- Run locally with adk run path/to/my\_agent or use the Web UI with adk web path/to/agents\_dir\.
- Optional integrations can be installed with pip install "google\-adk\[extensions\]"\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10\+ is required\.
- Agents can be deployed locally in a Docker container with adk deploy docker \-\-with\_ui\.
- Agents can be deployed in Google Cloud with Cloud Run using adk deploy cloud\_run \-\-with\_ui\.
- Environment variables may be set in the adk command or in a \.env file, for example GOOGLE\_GENAI\_USE\_ENTERPRISE=1\.
- Vertex AI Agent Engine is mentioned as a scaling option\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The development version may contain experimental changes or bugs, so it is intended mainly for testing upcoming changes or accessing critical fixes before official release\.

projects.content:
## Overview

AI Job Search is a structured, local workflow that turns Claude Code into a job application assistant\. It covers self\-profiling, fit evaluation, and a drafter\-reviewer pipeline for tailored CVs and cover letters; the core workflow is language\- and country\-agnostic, while the shipped portal search skills target Denmark and can be extended for other markets\.

## Key Features

- Evaluates job postings against a candidate profile and returns fit scores, deal\-breaker vetoes, and ranked shortlists\.
- Drafts tailored CVs and cover letters in LaTeX through a drafter\-reviewer workflow, then compiles and visually inspects the PDFs\.
- Runs ATS parseability checks on the compiled CV text layer and verifies contact details, reading order, and keyword coverage without stuffing unsupported skills\.
- Prepares candidates for interviews with company research, STAR question mapping, gap\-aware bridge answers, and mock interviews\.
- Tracks applications and outcomes, archives submitted materials, drafts follow\-ups, and generates a self\-contained offline HTML dashboard\.
- Supports extension through job\-portal search skills, custom CV or cover\-letter templates, and configurable evaluation criteria\.

## Use Cases

- Job seekers who want a local, Claude Code\-based workflow for evaluating postings and preparing tailored applications\.
- Candidates targeting the Danish job market through the shipped Jobindex, Jobnet, Jobbank, and Jobdanmark search skills\.
- Users adapting the framework to another job market with /add\-portal or borrowing community portal skills\.
- Career planners using skill\-gap analysis and learning plans between applications\.

## Getting Started

- Fork or clone the repository, run python3 tools/install\_portal\_clis\.py to install the portal CLI tools, start Claude Code, and use /setup to populate a profile\.
- Use /scrape to search job portals, optionally /rank to batch\-score postings, and /apply with a job URL or pasted job description to run the full application workflow\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Claude Code CLI and either a Claude Pro/Max/Team subscription or Anthropic API credits\.
- Python 3\.10\+\.
- Bun for the job search CLI tools\.
- A LaTeX distribution with lualatex and xelatex; minimal TeX installs may need extra packages\.
- Optional pypdf for the ATS parseability check; Poppler pdftotext is a fallback\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The workflow depends on Claude Code, which has no free tier and requires a Claude subscription or Anthropic API credits\.
- Job postings are treated as untrusted input, but the agentic defenses are instruction\-level rather than a sandbox, so users should review fetched and written content on unfamiliar boards\.
- The LinkedIn search skill is intended for personal use only, and automated access is against LinkedIn's Terms of Service, so volume should be kept low\.
- The project is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or maintained by Anthropic\.

projects.description: A self-hosted long-term memory system for AI coding agent CLIs. It captures sessions into a git-backed Markdown wiki, shares project context across agents and machines, and supports typed handoffs between different harnesses.
projects.descriptionZh: ai-memory 是自托管的 AI 编码代理 CLI 长期记忆方案：自动捕获会话并整理为由 Git 版本管理的 Markdown 项目 wiki，让不同代理与机器共享上下文，并通过带类型的交接继续任务。
projects.content:
## Overview

ai\-memory is a self\-contained, self\-hosted solution for long\-term memory across AI coding agent CLIs\. It captures lifecycle observations, consolidates session summaries into a project wiki of ordinary Markdown files, and lets the next agent retrieve context or continue from a typed handoff across supported harnesses and machines\.

## Key Features

- Shared memory across more than twenty coding agent harnesses, with typed claim\-once handoffs between agents\.
- A git\-backed Markdown wiki is the source of truth, while the database is a derived index that can be rebuilt from the files\.
- Lifecycle hooks capture prompts, tool calls, and session boundaries silently, with a typed privacy boundary before storage\.
- Cross\-project profiles carry working habits into new repositories, and server\-hosted memory follows users across machines and teams\.
- The default path uses zero LLM calls for capture, search, handoffs, and aging operations such as decay, compaction, deduplication, and contradiction flagging\.
- Optional LLM consolidation, vector search, and dream\-style rewrites are off by default and never delete source versions\.

## Use Cases

- Continue work after switching from one coding agent to another in the same project directory\.
- Share project knowledge across a team using one server while keeping personal handoffs personal\.
- Resume project memory from a different machine through a self\-hosted server\.
- Bootstrap memory for an existing project that already has a long history\.

## Getting Started

- On Linux or macOS, run the install\.sh release script, then run ai\-memory setup\.
- On Windows PowerShell, run the install\.ps1 release script, then run ai\-memory setup\.
- Wire agents with install\-mcp and install\-hooks, or start harnesses with ai\-memory run for automatic wiring and session continuity\.
- Restart the agents and ask what they remember about the project to verify recall\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The product ships as one self\-contained binary, with Linux, macOS, and NixOS module support and Windows via WSL2\.
- Native Windows is listed as experimental in the support matrix\.
- Docker or Podman deployment is supported, and the published Docker image includes linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants\.
- The NixOS module requires git as a runtime dependency and provides a hardened systemd service\.
- For LAN or WAN binds, place TLS in front of the service; loopback binds may omit secrets and tolerate a missing environment file\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Native Windows support is marked experimental\.
- The Docker quick\-start can start without a bearer token\.
- NixOS settings are rendered into a world\-readable store path, so API keys should not be placed there\.

## 项目简介

ai\-memory 是一个自包含、自托管的长期记忆方案，面向 AI 编码代理 CLI。它通过生命周期钩子捕获观察，将会话摘要整理成项目 wiki 中的普通 Markdown 页面，并让后续代理在支持的运行环境和机器之间检索上下文或从带类型的交接继续工作。

## 核心功能

- 共享记忆：二十多个编码代理运行环境（包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、OpenCode 等）共享同一份记忆，代理之间通过带类型且只能被认领一次的交接传递任务。
- Git 支持的 Markdown wiki 是事实来源，数据库只是可从文件重建的派生索引。
- 生命周期钩子静默捕获提示词、工具调用和会话边界，并在存储前经过带类型的隐私边界处理。
- 跨项目配置档案把工作习惯带入新仓库；由服务器承载的记忆可跟随用户跨机器和团队使用。
- 默认路径在捕获、搜索、交接以及衰减、压缩、去重和矛盾标记等老化操作中使用零次 LLM 调用。
- 可选的 LLM 整理、向量搜索和 dream 式重写默认关闭，且从不删除源版本。

## 适用场景

- 在同一项目目录中从一个编码代理切换到另一个后继续工作。
- 团队共用一台服务器共享项目知识，同时让个人交接保持私密。
- 通过自托管服务器从另一台机器恢复项目记忆。
- 为已有长期历史的现有项目引导记忆。

## 快速开始

- 在 Linux 或 macOS 上运行 install\.sh 发布脚本，然后运行 ai\-memory setup。
- 在 Windows PowerShell 中运行 install\.ps1 发布脚本，然后运行 ai\-memory setup。
- 使用 install\-mcp 和 install\-hooks 接入代理，或以 ai\-memory run 启动运行环境，以便自动接入并获得会话连续性。
- 重启代理，并询问它记得这个项目的什么，以验证召回。

## 部署与要求

- 产品以单个自包含二进制形式发布，支持 Linux、macOS 和 NixOS 模块，并通过 WSL2 支持 Windows。

- 面向局域网或广域网绑定服务时，应在服务前放置 TLS；回环绑定可以省略密钥，并容忍环境文件缺失。

projects.content:
## Overview

AI\-DLC Workflows, also called AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle, is a structured, gated methodology for AI\-driven software development\. It provides a harness\-neutral core that runs natively in Claude Code, Kiro CLI, Kiro IDE, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, and GitHub Copilot, keeping requirements, decisions, implementation, tests, and operational work connected through an audited lifecycle\.

## Key Features

- Five phases and 33 stages from initialization through operation\.
- Fourteen agents, including 11 domain experts, 2 reviewers, and an adaptive composer\.
- Eleven workflow profiles for features, bug fixes, infrastructure, security, proofs of concept, enterprise delivery, and other common work\.
- Human approval gates and source\-bound review evidence\.
- A 119\-event audit trail plus persistent state, team knowledge, and learned rules\.
- The same deterministic engine across every supported harness\.

## Use Cases

- Building software with AI\-assisted workflows\.
- Fixing bugs and delivering infrastructure or security work through focused workflow profiles\.
- Running proofs of concept and enterprise delivery with approval gates and audit evidence\.
- Onboarding teams through a guided first week and first workflow\.

## Getting Started

- Install AI\-DLC with the native installer for macOS, Linux, WSL, or Windows PowerShell\.
- From the project root, run aidlc config \-\-harness \<harness\>, replacing \<harness\> with claude, kiro, kiro\-ide, codex, cursor, opencode, or copilot\.
- Run aidlc doctor to check the setup\.
- Open the configured harness and invoke /aidlc with a work request; Codex CLI uses $aidlc\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The native installer sets up the aidlc command and every harness runtime; Bun and Node\.js are not required for the native install\.
- The manual\-copy alternative requires Bun and copying the complete runtime/\<harness\>/ directory into the project\.
- On Windows, run the installer from a normal PowerShell window and reopen any already\-open terminal or IDE before using aidlc\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\-0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Amazon Bedrock access depends on enabling the configured models and verifying AWS credentials and region\.
- On Windows, run the installer from a normal PowerShell window because an administrator\-opened session receives a warning and a prompt\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Anatomy is a Claude Code skill that turns a one\-line idea into a live isometric figure of a real machine\. The skill invents the object, builds it from many solid parts, and makes every readout come from the same model that drives the motion\. Figures can be SVG, WebGL, or true 3D, and each is also available as a themeable React component or custom element\.

## Key Features

- Turns a one\-line idea into an interactive isometric figure of an invented machine\.
- Builds figures from dozens to hundreds of small solid parts, with depth\-sorted painting and one lit accent\.
- Supports optional interactive controls, WebGL shaders, and true 3D figures\.
- Ships every collection figure as a React component and a custom element, with five themes and customizable tokens\.
- Figures take keyboard focus, announce readout changes to screen readers, and go still under reduced motion\.
- Collection includes 33 live figures, and six complete examples ship with the skill\.

## Use Cases

- Explain technical concepts in documentation, articles, and landing pages\.
- Create interactive explainer diagrams for software and engineering ideas such as LRU caches, bloom filters, TCP handshakes, and turbofan engines\.
- Embed themeable live figures into React or Next\.js sites\.
- Build educational or technical illustrations from a natural\-language prompt\.

## Getting Started

- Add the skill to Claude Code with npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy\.
- Or download the skill ZIP and unzip it into your skills folder, such as ~/\.claude/skills\.
- Then open Claude Code in your project and ask for an explanatory figure, naming the idea rather than the drawing\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Claude Code environment\.
- Node\.js 20\.10 or newer, per the README badge\.
- No additional dependencies are reported\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- 3D figures are a beta feature and are slow to audit, so they are best requested only when a part must move in depth\.
- The skill favors detailed figures over speed and will not trade detail for speed on its own, so quick results should be requested explicitly\.
- Claude may build a figure that works but does not visually read correctly, so the first figure should be reviewed and refined\.
- Reference images are used for finish and mood, not for faithful copying of another drawing\.

projects.descriptionZh: anydoc 是 Firecrawl 开发的开源 Rust 库，可将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转换为整洁的 GitHub 风格 Markdown，并提供 Node.js、Python、浏览器和 CLI 绑定。
projects.content:
## Overview

anydoc is an open\-source Rust library by Firecrawl that converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF documents into GitHub\-Flavored Markdown\. It provides Node\.js, Python, browser WebAssembly, and CLI bindings, and its browser demo converts files locally\.

## Key Features

- Converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into GitHub\-Flavored Markdown\.
- Uses one shared document model and Markdown serializer so output structure stays consistent across formats\.
- Detects formats from file bytes rather than extensions, so mislabeled files still convert\.
- Runs as pure Rust with no ML models or external services and reports median conversion under 5 ms\.
- Ships bindings for Rust, Node\.js, Python, browser WebAssembly, and CLI usage\.
- Preserves headings, lists, tables with merged cells, footnotes, speaker notes, and equations as LaTeX\.

## Use Cases

- Converting mixed office document collections into one consistent, structured Markdown output for LLM pipelines\.
- Converting documents locally in the browser so files never leave the user's machine\.
- Letting agents read office documents through the shipped Agent Skill\.
- Extracting text\-based PDFs locally without requiring an OCR service\.

## Getting Started

- Install anydoc for Rust with cargo add anydoc, for Node\.js with npm install @firecrawl/anydoc, for Python with pip install firecrawl\-anydoc, or for the browser with npm install @firecrawl/anydoc\-wasm\.
- Run the CLI with npx @firecrawl/anydoc report\.docx, or use the same conversion API from a path or bytes\.
- Stop at the document model when embedded assets need to be kept\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Pure Rust, no ML models, and no external services for local conversion\.
- Browser WebAssembly demo downloads a few MB of WebAssembly once\.
- Text\-based PDFs convert locally through pdf\-inspector; scanned or image\-only PDFs require opt\-in hosted OCR through Firecrawl Parse\.
- Hosted OCR can be used without signup; setting FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY provides higher limits\.
- The Rust crate has no OCR option and never makes network calls\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Scanned or image\-only PDFs are not handled by local conversion and rely on Firecrawl Parse for OCR\.
- When hosted OCR is used, the entire document is sent off the machine because Parse has no page selection\.

## 项目简介

anydoc 是 Firecrawl 开发的开源 Rust 库，可将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 文档转换为 GitHub 风格 Markdown。它提供 Node\.js、Python、浏览器 WebAssembly 和 CLI 绑定，官网演示在浏览器本地完成转换，文件不会离开用户设备。

## 核心功能

- 支持将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 转换为 GitHub 风格 Markdown。
- 所有格式都解析为同一个文档模型，并通过同一个 Markdown 序列化器输出，标题、嵌套列表、合并单元格表格和脚注的表现保持一致。
- 根据文件字节而非扩展名识别格式，扩展名标注错误的文件也能正确转换。
- 使用纯 Rust 实现，不依赖机器学习模型或外部服务，官方称单文档转换中位耗时低于 5 毫秒。
- 提供 Rust、Node\.js、Python、浏览器 WebAssembly 和 CLI 多种使用方式。
- 保留标题、列表、含合并单元格与表头的表格、引用、脚注与尾注、演讲者备注等内容，Word 和 PowerPoint 的公式可转换为 LaTeX 数学标记。

## 适用场景

- 将来源混杂的办公文档批量转换为结构一致的 Markdown，供 LLM 流程使用。
- 在浏览器中本地转换文档，文件不离开本机。
- 通过随包发布的 Agent Skill 让智能体读取办公文档。
- 在无需 OCR 服务的条件下本地提取文本型 PDF 的内容。

## 快速开始

- Rust 用户可执行 cargo add anydoc 安装。
- Node\.js 用户可执行 npm install @firecrawl/anydoc 安装。
- Python 用户可执行 pip install firecrawl\-anydoc 安装。
- 浏览器 WebAssembly 版本可执行 npm install @firecrawl/anydoc\-wasm 安装。
- CLI 可直接运行 npx @firecrawl/anydoc report\.docx，将 Markdown 输出到标准输出。

## 部署与要求

- 本地转换使用纯 Rust，不需要机器学习模型，也不依赖外部服务。
- 浏览器 WebAssembly 演示页面需要一次性下载几 MB 的 WebAssembly。
- 文本型 PDF 通过 pdf\-inspector 在本地转换。
- 扫描件或仅有图像的 PDF 需要选择启用 Firecrawl Parse 提供的托管 OCR。
- 托管 OCR 无需注册即可使用，设置 FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY 可获得更高额度。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：MIT。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

Archify is an open\-source Agent Skill for turning a system, process, or plan into a diagram\. The agent authors typed JSON, and Archify renders and validates a self\-contained interactive HTML artifact\. The Skill and renderers are licensed under MIT\.

## Key Features

- Five diagram types: architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow, and lifecycle\.
- Four visual presets: Classic, Signal Flow, Blueprint, and Editorial\.
- Self\-contained HTML output with inline SVG and typed JSON source\.
- Dual dark and light themes in one file\.
- Exports PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, and WebM, with clipboard copy\.
- Validates authored diagrams with 9/9 checks per artifact\.

## Use Cases

- Diagram software systems, including services, databases, and security boundaries\.
- Map workflows and approval chains, such as leave plans or CI/CD pipelines\.
- Explain sequences, such as renting a flat or an API call chain\.
- Track lifecycles, such as job applications or deployments\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Skill with npx skills add tt\-a1i/archify \-g, or use an agent\-specific command\.
- Describe the steps, people, parts, or states to your agent\.
- Ask your agent to use Archify to draw it\.
- Open the generated HTML file in a browser and refine it in chat\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A supported AI agent: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, or GitHub Copilot\.
- Agent access to files\.
- A local Node\.js runtime\.
- Any tools needed for the requested export\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source AI observability platform for tracing, evaluating, and improving LLM applications. It provides tracing via OpenTelemetry, LLM-based evaluations, prompt management, and experiments to compare changes. Built
projects.descriptionZh: Arize Phoenix 是 Arize AI 与开源社区共同打造的开源 AI 可观测性平台，用于追踪、评估和改进 LLM 应用。它基于 OpenTelemetry 和 OpenInference 提供追踪、评估、提示词管理和实验功能。
projects.content:
## Overview

Phoenix helps you understand and improve AI applications by giving you a workflow for debugging and iteration\. You can send detailed logging information, known as traces, from your app to see exactly what happened during a run, score outputs using evaluation tests to identify failures and regressions, iterate on your prompts using real production examples, and optimize your app with experiments that compare changes on the same inputs\. Phoenix is built by Arize AI and the open\-source community, on top of OpenTelemetry and powered by OpenInference instrumentation\.

## Key Features

- Tracing: See what happened during a single run of your AI application, step by step, capturing model calls, retrieval, tool use, and custom logic\.
- Evaluation: Score traces and spans with LLM\-based evaluators, code\-based checks, or human labels to track performance and identify failures consistently\.
- Prompt Engineering: Version prompts, test prompt variants across datasets, and replay calls to see how changes affect outputs before rolling them out\.
- Datasets & Experiments: Group traces into datasets, rerun them through different versions of your application, and compare evaluation results to confirm whether a change actually improved performance\.
- PXI (Phoenix Intelligence): An AI engineering agent built into Phoenix for debugging traces, iterating on prompts, and navigating the product\.
- Remote MCP Server: Connect Claude Code, Cursor, and other MCP clients directly to your Phoenix instance's /mcp endpoint to query traces, datasets, experiments, and more\.

## Use Cases

- Debugging LLM applications by inspecting traces to understand behavior and identify where time is spent\.
- Measuring output quality with evaluations to track performance and identify failures consistently\.
- Iterating on prompts using real production examples and comparing prompt variants across datasets\.
- Optimizing applications with experiments that compare changes on the same inputs to confirm improvements\.

## Getting Started

- Start Phoenix in one terminal: \`uvx arize\-phoenix serve\` (or \`phoenix serve\` after pip install)\. It serves at http://localhost:6006\.
- Add tracing with a coding agent: run \`npx \-y @arizeai/phoenix\-cli setup\` or \`npm i \-g @arizeai/phoenix\-cli && px setup\` from your app's root directory\.
- Alternatively, follow the Python or TypeScript quick starts to send traces, measure performance, iterate on prompts, and optimize with experiments\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Phoenix container images are available via Docker Hub and can be deployed using Docker or Kubernetes via the Helm chart\.
- Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, and cloud platforms like Railway, Render, Google Cloud, Azure, and AWS\.
- The Google Cloud button builds Phoenix from source in Cloud Shell rather than deploying the prebuilt Docker Hub image\.
- The Azure template serves plain HTTP (Azure Container Instances does not terminate TLS) — front it with a TLS proxy such as an Application Gateway before production use\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The Azure deployment template serves plain HTTP and requires a TLS proxy for production use\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ArtCraft is an open\-source studio for controllable AI image and video creation\. It is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers, built around visual control, ownership, and expression rather than text prompting alone\. ArtCraft can be used on the web or downloaded for desktop, with no subscription required and no aggregator middleman between the user and the models\.

## Key Features

- Image to Location: Place virtual actors into physical environments and plan multiple shots in a consistent room\.
- 2D and 3D compositing: Layer images, backdrops, foreground elements, props, background removal, and drawing tools to compose scenes with depth and precise layering\.
- Image to 3D Mesh: Turn images into 3D objects that can be positioned, rotated, and framed for scene blocking\.
- Character posing and identity transfer: Pose characters and set camera blocking before generating the final shot, and use a posed mannequin to guide character placement and pose\.
- Mixed asset crafting: Combine image cutouts, worlds, and 3D meshes in one canvas\.
- Prompt\-based generation and editing: Use text to image, prompted image editing, canvas image editing, and image to video with selected models\.

## Use Cases

- Artists, designers, and filmmakers can compose and block shots before generating final images or video\.
- Filmmakers can place virtual actors in physical environments and film multiple shots in one location without elements disappearing\.
- 3D scene blocking with kitbashing and mixed assets helps control camera angles, object placement, and depth\.
- Creators can start with a prompt for quick ideation, then refine using canvas and scene tools\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop studio for macOS or Windows\.
- Use ArtCraft on the web by launching the studio in your browser\.
- Build from source, including for Linux\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop builds are available for macOS and Windows\.
- The web version runs in the browser with no install needed\.
- Linux is supported through building from source\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some catalog models are marked as currently disabled or restricted, and restricted models are not currently available in the desktop app\.
- Additional provider integrations for Kling, Google, Runway, and Luma are planned, and support for aggregator subscriptions such as OpenArt and Freepik is an expressed interest rather than a current feature\.

## 项目简介

## 核心功能

- 图像到场景：将虚拟演员放入物理环境，并在一致的房间内规划多个镜头。2D 和 3D 合成：分层图像、背景、前景元素、道具、背景移除和绘图工具，以深度和精确分层合成场景。图像到 3D 网格：将图像转换为可定位、旋转和取景的 3D 对象，用于场景阻挡。角色摆姿和身份转移：在生成最终镜头前摆好角色姿势并设置相机阻挡，使用摆好姿势的人体模型引导角色放置和姿势。混合资产创作：在一个画布中组合图像抠图、世界和 3D 网格。基于提示的生成和编辑：使用文本到图像、提示图像编辑、画布图像编辑和图像到视频，并选择模型。

## 适用场景

- 艺术家、设计师和电影制作人可以在生成最终图像或视频之前构图和阻挡镜头。电影制作人可以将虚拟演员放入物理环境，并在一个地点拍摄多个镜头而不会导致元素消失。使用套件组合和混合资产的 3D 场景阻挡有助于控制相机角度、对象放置和深度。创作者可以从提示开始快速构思，然后使用画布和场景工具进行细化。

projects.description: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English rules, repurposed as a Claude Code skill for rewriting ambiguous agent-facing English. The skill targets agent-to-agent messages, tool descriptions, and error messages.
projects.descriptionZh: ASD-STE100 简化技术英语规则被改造成 Claude Code 技能，用于改写含糊的、面向智能体的英文。该技能针对智能体之间的消息、工具描述和错误消息。
projects.content:
## Overview

A Claude Code skill that rewrites dense, ambiguous English into ASD\-STE100 Simplified Technical English\. It is aimed at AI agents and non\-native readers that must parse tool descriptions, error messages, inter\-agent instructions, and other agent\-facing English without a human to resolve ambiguity\.

## Key Features

- Applies ASD\-STE100 principles to rewrite ambiguous agent\-facing English\.
- Offers a strict mode for procedures, error messages, and tool descriptions\.
- Offers an STE\-flavored mode for READMEs, PR descriptions, and explanatory prose\.
- Flags rule violations such as ambiguous word choice, passive voice, complex tenses, long sentences, and dropped words\.
- Includes a deterministic linter for structural patterns such as semicolons, soft phrasal verbs, nominalizations, marketing adjectives, passive voice, and present\-perfect forms\.
- Outputs rewritten text without preamble, mode announcement, or change summary\.

## Use Cases

- Rewriting agent\-to\-agent messages and inter\-agent instructions\.
- Clarifying tool and function descriptions for machine readers\.
- Rewriting error messages and system prompts\.
- Checking structural STE patterns in Markdown or text files with the linter\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx skills add danyuchn/asd\-ste100\-skill from your project root to install the skill for the current project\.
- Clone the repository into ~/\.claude/skills/asd\-ste100 to make it available in every Claude Code project\.
- Trigger the skill by asking Claude to disambiguate, rewrite, or apply ASD\-STE100 to English text\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The skills CLI sends anonymous install telemetry\.
- The linter checks only structural patterns and does not verify meaning preservation\.
- The standard cannot be freely redistributed; reproduction requires ASD's written authority or an authorised organisation type\.
- The repository's own prose does not pass the linter; findings are examples, not defects\.
- The linter does not check noun\-cluster length, phrasal verbs outside its list, hedges, or modality\.

## 项目简介

一个 Claude Code 技能，可将稠密、含糊的英文改写成 ASD\-STE100 简化技术英语。它面向必须解析工具描述、错误消息、智能体间指令及其他面向智能体的英文的 AI 智能体和母语非英语读者，且没有人类来消解歧义。

## 核心功能

- 应用 ASD\-STE100 原则改写含糊的、面向智能体的英文。提供严格模式，覆盖流程、错误消息和工具描述。提供 STE 风格模式，覆盖 README、PR 描述和说明性文字。标记歧义词选择、被动语态、复杂时态、过长句子和省略词等规则违规。包含确定性 linter，检查分号、软性短语动词、名词化、营销形容词、被动语态和现在完成形式等结构模式。输出改写文本时不加前言、模式公告或变更摘要。

## 适用场景

- Install Node\.js and ensure you can run npx bun commands\.

projects.name: billion-context
projects.tagline: Context-compression plugin for long coding sessions
projects.taglineZh: 面向长时间编码会话的上下文压缩插件
projects.description: billion-context is a context-compression plugin that lets agents work with small context windows, use about 5x fewer tokens, and sustain month-long single sessions handling billions of tokens.
projects.descriptionZh: billion-context 是一款上下文压缩插件，让智能体在小上下文窗口（10 万上下文即可）下工作，token 用量约为原来的五分之一，并能支撑持续数月、累计数十亿 token 的单次会话。
projects.content:
## Overview

billion\-context sits between an agent and its model API and rewrites Anthropic or OpenAI streams using acp\-kernel compression\. It compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so a single session can run for days, with the model deciding when and what to compress rather than relying on a hard truncation limit\. Compression is described as incremental, reversible, and prefix\-cache friendly\.

## Key Features

- Compresses consumed conversation into layered summaries so one context window can support days\-long sessions and billions of tokens\.
- Works as a proxy between agents and model APIs, parsing Anthropic or OpenAI request shapes and rewriting streaming responses\.
- Injects context\-management tools: compress, decompress, search\_context, and acp\_status\.
- Keeps compression incremental, reversible, and prefix\-cache friendly, with summaries restorable on demand\.
- Offers native plugin, launcher, and base URL prefix usage modes across many coding clients\.
- Describes a healthy session as keeping a 95–97% prefix\-cache hit rate, with compression itself costing ≤2%\.

## Use Cases

- Long coding sessions that would otherwise exceed a model's context window\.
- Reducing token usage and cost during agent interactions\.
- Running a single agent session continuously for days or months while processing billions of tokens\.
- Adding context compression to clients such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, pi, Gemini CLI, and others\.

## Getting Started

- Install with npm install \-g billion\-context \-\-prefix=~/\.local on Linux or macOS, or npm install \-g billion\-context on Windows\.
- Choose a usage mode: native plugin with bili plugin install \<client\>, launcher with bili \<client\>, or URL prefix by starting bili and prefixing the client base URL with the local proxy's /bili/ path\.
- In native plugin mode, supported clients include pi, omp, opencode, dsh, kimi, hermes, and zcode\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Installation uses npm; the global package provides the bili command, with bili\-proxy kept as an alias\.
- On Linux or macOS, a user\-level npm prefix avoids sudo and permission errors; the Windows default npm prefix is user\-writable\.
- Native plugin mode requires a client with a plugin seam; clients without one use launcher or /bili/ prefix modes\.
- Some launcher modes use certificate\-based MITM or environment\-specific base URL rewrites, depending on the client\.
- A manual bili start uses port 8787; client lanes use a self\-managed zone starting at 18787 and hop by one on collisions\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Native plugins and standalone in\-process extensions are mutually exclusive; running both causes double compression\.
- Claude Desktop Code tab sessions bypass the proxy and therefore get neither bili compression nor native auto\-compaction\.
- Goose cannot use certificate\-based MITM because rustls trusts no CA file; it uses plain\-HTTP base URL redirects instead\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Browser Harness is a thin, self\-healing harness built directly on CDP\. It connects an LLM to a real browser through one editable CDP websocket, and the agent writes missing helpers as it works so the harness improves with every task\. It can run on local Chrome, stealth browsers, or a Browser Use Box, and it offers an MCP server for MCP clients\.

## Key Features

- Thin self\-healing harness built directly on CDP\.
- Connects an LLM directly to a real browser through one editable CDP websocket\.
- Agents write missing helpers mid\-task in their local workspace, so the harness improves with every task\.
- Protected core source stays separate while agents write reusable helpers\.
- MCP server browser\-harness\-mcp exposes browser control helpers as MCP tools over stdio\.
- Can run on local Chrome, stealth browsers, or 24/7 on your own Browser Use Box\.

## Use Cases

- Complete browser tasks such as opening a profile, finding the latest 20 video posts, and downloading them\.
- Handle logged\-in, personal browser work with a local browser\.
- Scale many browsers in parallel with live previews, proxies, stealth, and CAPTCHA solving through Browser Use Cloud\.
- Drive the browser from MCP clients such as Claude Code, Devin, and Cursor without writing a second CDP layer\.

## Getting Started

- Paste the provided setup prompt into Claude Code or Codex\.
- Install or upgrade browser\-harness to the latest stable version with uv using Python 3\.12\.
- Register the skill from browser\-harness skill and connect it to your browser\.
- On first setup, tick the checkbox in chrome://inspect/\#remote\-debugging so the agent can connect to your browser\.
- If setup or connection fails, follow install\.md\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- First\-time connection to a local browser requires enabling remote debugging in Chrome\.
- Local browser recordings are optional and default to off, with existing preferences preserved on upgrades\.
- Scaling to many parallel browsers depends on Browser Use Cloud for features such as live previews, proxies, stealth, and CAPTCHA solving\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Bytebase is an open\-source database governance platform that acts as a single control plane between users, including humans and AI agents, and databases\. It governs database change management, access control, and compliance so every change and query is reviewed, controlled, and recorded\. Bytebase supports PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, MariaDB, TiDB, Snowflake, ClickHouse, Spanner, OceanBase, and more\.

## Key Features

- GUI\-based change workflow for requesting, reviewing, deploying, and rolling back database changes through a web console\.
- GitOps integration with native GitHub/GitLab support for database\-as\-code workflows\.
- SQL review with more than 200 lint rules to enforce SQL standards and best practices\.
- Access control with fine\-grained RBAC, just\-in\-time access grants with automatic revocation, and role\-based dynamic data masking\.
- Compliance capabilities including audit logging, codified policy through Terraform Provider and API, and data classification\.
- AI features including an MCP server for AI agents and IDEs, text\-to\-SQL in the SQL Editor, and a built\-in page agent for natural\-language workflow guidance or execution\.

## Use Cases

- For development teams: implement database schema version control, automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines, and collaborate on database changes with review workflows\.
- For DBAs: centralize database management across all environments, enforce organization\-wide SQL standards and policies, and monitor and audit all database activities\.
- For security teams: control data access with column\-level permissions, implement data masking for sensitive information, and maintain compliance with audit trails\.

## Getting Started

- Run the Docker quick start: docker run \-\-init \-\-name bytebase \-\-publish 8080:8080 \-\-volume ~/\.bytebase/data:/var/opt/bytebase bytebase/bytebase:latest
- Run the Kubernetes quick start: helm install bytebase bytebase/bytebase
- Visit localhost:8080 and follow the setup wizard\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Self\-hosted Docker quick start uses the bytebase/bytebase image with port 8080 published and a data volume mounted at /var/opt/bytebase\.
- Self\-hosted Kubernetes quick start uses the bytebase/bytebase Helm chart\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GitOps database\-as\-code workflows use GitHub or GitLab integration\.
- AI agent and IDE integration depends on the Model Context Protocol\.

## 项目简介

Bytebase 是一个开源数据库治理平台，在用户（包括人员和 AI 代理）与数据库之间充当单一控制平面。它治理数据库变更管理、访问控制和合规，使每次变更和查询都经过审查、受控并留有记录。Bytebase 支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server、Oracle、MongoDB、Redis、MariaDB、TiDB、Snowflake、ClickHouse、Spanner、OceanBase 等数据库。

## 核心功能

- 提供基于图形界面的变更工作流，可通过 Web 控制台请求、审查、部署和回滚变更；提供 GitOps 集成，原生支持 GitHub/GitLab 的数据库即代码工作流；提供 SQL 审查，包含 200 多条 lint 规则以执行 SQL 标准和最佳实践；提供访问控制，包括细粒度 RBAC、带自动撤销的即时访问授权，以及基于角色的动态数据脱敏；提供合规能力，包括审计日志、通过 Terraform Provider 和 API 将策略代码化，以及数据分类；提供 AI 功能，包括面向 AI 代理和 IDE 的 MCP 服务器、SQL 编辑器中的文本转

## 适用场景

- 面向开发团队：实现数据库模式版本控制，通过 CI/CD 流水线自动化数据库部署，并通过审查工作流协作处理数据库变更；面向 DBA：集中管理所有环境中的数据库，执行组织级 SQL 标准与策略，并监控和审计所有数据库活动；面向安全团队：通过列级权限控制数据访问，对敏感信息实施数据脱敏，并通过审计追踪保持合规。

## 快速开始

- Docker 快速启动命令为 docker run \-\-init \-\-name bytebase \-\-publish 8080:8080 \-\-volume ~/\.bytebase/data:/var/opt/bytebase bytebase/bytebase:latest；Kubernetes 快速启动命令为 helm install bytebase bytebase/bytebase；启动后访问 localhost:8080 并按设置向导操作。

## 部署与要求

- 自托管 Docker 快速启动使用 bytebase/bytebase 镜像，发布 8080 端口，并将数据卷挂载到 /var/opt/bytebase；自托管 Kubernetes 快速启动使用 bytebase/bytebase Helm chart。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Caveman
projects.tagline: Make AI agents say less and read less.
projects.taglineZh: 让 AI 代理少说、少读。
projects.description: Caveman is an open-source response skill and local CLI proxy for coding agents. It shortens answers and compresses inputs like logs, JSON, CSV, and test output while keeping code, commands, paths, and error messages exact.
projects.descriptionZh: Caveman 是面向编码代理的开源响应技能与本地 CLI 代理。它缩短回答，并在模型读取前压缩日志、JSON、CSV 和测试输出等输入，同时保持代码、命令、路径和错误消息原样。
projects.content:
## Overview

Caveman is an open\-source project for coding agents with two main parts: a response skill that makes agent answers shorter and a local proxy that compresses what the agent reads\. The skill follows a controlled, answer\-first style while preserving negations, numbers, units, code, commands, paths, and error messages\. The proxy runs on the user's machine with the user's keys and keeps every original on disk so the agent can retrieve it\.

## Key Features

- Response skill shortens agent answers with an answer\-first style and preserves negations, numbers, units, code, commands, paths, and error messages\.
- Local CLI proxy compresses logs, JSON, CSV, YAML, and test output before the model reads them; the benchmark reports 33\.2% fewer input tokens across whole sessions\.
- Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Copilot, and 30\+ more agents\.
- Provides /caveman, /ultracave, and /megacave modes plus commands for commit messages, code review, memory\-file compression, stats, and help\.
- Includes optional Auto model and effort routing, Blocks code mode, browse compression, and middleware for TypeScript or Python applications\.
- Runs locally, uses the user's keys and Claude Pro/Max login, and keeps original files on disk for retrieval\.

## Use Cases

- Reduce input and output token usage in coding\-agent sessions without changing code payloads\.
- Compress noisy command output, logs, test results, JSON, CSV, YAML, or web pages before an agent reads them\.
- Shorten responses in supported assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and Copilot using caveman response modes\.
- Shrink memory files such as CLAUDE\.md while keeping headings, code blocks, and paths intact\.

## Getting Started

- Install the full tool with npx @caveman\-ai/cli@latest, then start an agent with caveman claude or another supported command\. For the response skill alone, run npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman \-g and type /caveman if it does not start automatically\. The CLI requires Node\.js

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 22\.13 or newer\.
- Mac, Linux, or Windows\.
- Runs locally with your keys and Claude Pro/Max login; no hosted account is needed for local use\.
- Auto requires a free account\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The CLI requires Node\.js 22\.13 or newer\.
- HTML currently has no compressor, so that file type may not benefit and can incur overhead\.
- Blocks is pre\-release, Python\-only, and does not yet include a sandbox\.
- Auto routing requires an account, though the account is free\.
- Per\-request billing can make shorter answers offer no cost saving\.

## 项目简介

Caveman 是面向编码代理的开源项目，包含两个主要部分：缩短代理回答的响应技能，以及压缩代理所读内容的本地代理。该技能采用受控的、先给答案的风格，同时保留否定词、数字、单位、代码、命令、路径和错误消息。代理在用户机器上使用用户密钥运行，并将每个原始文件保留在磁盘上，以便代理随时取回。

## 核心功能

- 响应技能以先给答案的风格缩短代理回答，并保留否定词、数字、单位、代码、命令、路径和错误消息。本地 CLI 代理在模型读取前压缩日志、JSON、CSV、YAML 和测试输出；基准测试报告整个会话的输入 token 减少 33\.2%。兼容 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、Copilot 及 30 多个代理。提供 /caveman、/ultracave 和 /megacave 模式，以及提交信息、代码审查、内存文件压缩、统计和帮助命令。包括可选的 Auto 模型与推理强度路由、Blocks

## 适用场景

- 减少编码代理会话的输入和输出 token 用量，同时不改变代码内容。在代理读取前压缩嘈杂的命令输出、日志、测试结果、JSON、CSV、YAML 或网页。使用 caveman 响应模式，在 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor 和 Copilot 等受支持的助手中缩短回答。压缩 CLAUDE\.md 等内存文件，同时保留标题、代码块和路径。

## 快速开始

- 安装完整工具可运行 npx @caveman\-ai/cli@latest，然后用 caveman claude 或其他受支持命令启动代理。若只需要响应技能，运行 npx skills add JuliusBrussee/caveman \-g，若未自动启动则输入 /caveman。CLI 需要 Node\.js 22\.13 或更高版本。

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Node\.js 22\.13 或更高版本。支持 Mac、Linux 或 Windows。在本地运行，使用你的密钥和 Claude Pro/Max 登录；本地使用无需托管账户。Auto 需要免费账户。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

cf is the agentic CLI for the entire Cloudflare API\. It is built for the next generation of software development, with bespoke search and steering for agents, JSON as the default interface, cloudflare\.config\.ts configuration, and Vite as the default local development server\.

## Key Features

- Bespoke search and steering to help agents find the command they need for Cloudflare tasks\.
- JSON as the default interface, pretty printed for humans and condensed for agents to save context\.
- cloudflare\.config\.ts as the configuration format for the whole of Cloudflare, starting with Workers, bringing TypeScript safety and accuracy to you and your agent's language server protocol (LSP)\.
- Vite as the default local development server, with a plugin suite for developers and framework authors\.
- Installable globally via npm and runnable from anywhere\.

## Use Cases

- Agents finding and running Cloudflare API commands using bespoke CLI search and steering\.
- Human developers using pretty\-printed JSON output for Cloudflare API interactions\.
- Configuring Cloudflare services with cloudflare\.config\.ts, starting with Workers\.
- Developers and framework authors extending local development with Vite and its plugin suite\.

## Getting Started

- Install the open beta globally: npm i \-g cf
- Run it from anywhere\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- cf is offered as an open beta\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

## 核心功能

- 面向智能体的定制搜索与引导，帮助智能体找到执行 Cloudflare 任务所需的命令。默认使用 JSON 接口，为人类可读美化输出，为智能体压缩输出以节省上下文。cloudflare\.config\.ts 作为整个 Cloudflare 的配置格式，从 Workers 开始，并将 TypeScript 的安全性和准确性带入你与智能体的语言服务器协议（LSP）。Vite 成为默认本地开发服务器，并附带面向开发者和框架作者的插件套件。可通过 npm 全局安装并随处运行。

- 智能体使用 CLI 的搜索与引导查找并运行 Cloudflare API 命令。人类开发者使用美化输出的 JSON 与 Cloudflare API 交互。使用 cloudflare\.config\.ts 配置 Cloudflare 服务，从 Workers 开始。开发者和框架作者通过 Vite 及其插件套件扩展本地开发。

## 快速开始

- 全局安装开放测试版：npm i \-g cf。安装后可从任意位置运行。

projects.content:
## Overview

Cherry Studio is an open\-source, free AI desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux\. It provides AI chat, autonomous agents, AI image generation, knowledge base, and translation, with unified access to 300\+ leading LLMs from major providers and local models via Ollama and LM Studio\. All data is stored locally, and it includes 300\+ pre\-configured assistants\.

## Key Features

- Multi\-model freedom: supports 50\+ AI providers including OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and local models via Ollama and LM Studio\.
- 300\+ pre\-configured assistants for writing, coding, learning, translation, marketing, and more\.
- AI chat, drawing, and translation capabilities built in\.
- Multi\-source knowledge base: import local files and web pages to build a personal AI assistant\.
- Document handling and productivity tools: text, images, Office, PDF, WebDAV, Mermaid charts, global search, and topic management\.
- Extensibility via mini\-programs and MCP servers\.

## Use Cases

- Build a personal knowledge base from documents and web pages for research, document analysis, and personalized Q&A\.
- Compare and switch between multiple AI models for tasks like coding, writing, and translation\.
- Deploy a privately\-controlled AI workspace for teams with centralized model and knowledge management (Enterprise Edition)\.

## Getting Started

- Download the stable release from the official website for Windows, macOS, or Linux\. Run the installer and launch the application; no environment setup is required\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- For the Enterprise Edition, deploy the backend service on on\-premises servers or private cloud\. The Community Edition is a desktop client with no server requirements\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Chroma is an open\-source search infrastructure for AI\. It offers fast, serverless, and scalable infrastructure supporting vector, full\-text, regex, and metadata search, built on object storage and used by millions of developers\.

## Key Features

- Vector search for semantic similarity search\.
- Sparse vector search for lexical search with BM25 and SPLADE\.
- Full\-text search with trigram and regex search\.
- Metadata search with filtering and faceted search\.
- Forking for dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll\-outs\.
- Command\-line tools for development\.

## Use Cases

- AI applications and agents that need search, retrieval, and context engineering\.
- Knowledge bases and question\-answering workflows\.
- Multi\-tenant search over billions of indexes\.
- Dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll\-outs using forking\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Python client with pip install chromadb\.
- Install the JavaScript/TypeScript client with npm install chromadb\.
- Start client\-server mode with chroma run \-\-path /chroma\_db\_path\.
- Start free on Chroma Cloud with $5 in free credits, or read the docs\.
- Get up and running in 30 seconds or less\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Run Chroma OSS on your own infrastructure using open\-source deployment guides\.
- Use client\-server mode with chroma run \-\-path /chroma\_db\_path\.
- Chroma Cloud provides a hosted serverless deployment option\.
- Enterprise deployment supports BYOC in your VPC, multi\-cloud/multi\-region replication, and point\-in\-time recovery\.
- Built on object storage with automatic data tiering and caching\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Chroma Cloud became generally available in August 2025\.
- The project is described as rapidly developing and welcomes contributions\.
- Chroma Cloud offers customer\-managed encryption keys to encrypt data with users' own keys\.
- Chroma Cloud supports private networking through AWS PrivateLink\.

## 项目简介

Chroma 是面向 AI 的开源搜索基础设施。它提供快速、无服务器且可扩展的基础设施，支持向量、全文、正则与元数据搜索，基于对象存储构建，并被数百万开发者使用。

projects.descriptionZh: Chrome DevTools for agents（chrome-devtools-mcp）是面向编码代理的 MCP 服务器与 CLI，可让代理控制并检查实时 Chrome 浏览器，用于自动化、调试、性能分析、用户模拟和发布前验证。
projects.content:
## Overview

Chrome DevTools for agents, published as chrome\-devtools\-mcp, is a Model\-Context\-Protocol server and CLI for coding agents\. It lets agents control and inspect a live Chrome browser to automate interactions, debug pages, collect performance insights, and run checks before shipping\.

## Key Features

- Performance insights from Chrome DevTools traces with actionable findings\.
- Advanced browser debugging, including network requests, screenshots, console messages, and source\-mapped stack traces\.
- Reliable automation through Puppeteer with automatic waiting for action results\.
- Live Chrome session connection for inspecting, pausing, and troubleshooting in real time\.
- Proactive QA with Lighthouse audits for accessibility, SEO, and performance\.
- User experience emulation for responsive designs, geolocations, and real user flows\.

## Use Cases

- Testing responsive designs and emulating locations or real user flows in a managed browser\.
- Debugging a live Chrome session by inspecting network activity, console output, and screenshots\.
- Running Lighthouse accessibility, SEO, and performance audits to catch issues before production\.
- Using a coding agent to navigate sites, click controls, and verify page behavior through prompts\.

## Getting Started

- Add the chrome\-devtools MCP server to your MCP client using npx \-y chrome\-devtools\-mcp@latest\.
- For basic browser tasks, use slim mode with the \-\-slim and \-\-headless flags\.
- Run a first prompt to check performance and confirm the browser opens and records a trace\.
- Client\-specific setup guidance is available for editors and agents such as Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Copilot, and OpenCode\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js LTS version\.
- Google Chrome current stable version or newer\.
- npm\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Official browser support is limited to Google Chrome and Chrome for Testing; other Chromium\-based browsers may produce unexpected behavior\.
- Performance tools may send trace URLs to the Google CrUX API for real\-user experience data, and this can be disabled with a flag\.
- Google collects usage statistics to improve reliability and performance, with opt\-out controls available\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

projects.content:
## Overview

Claude Code is an AI\-powered coding assistant that helps you build features, fix bugs, and automate development tasks\. It understands your entire codebase and can work across multiple files and tools to get things done\. It is available in the terminal, IDE extensions, desktop app, and web\.

## Key Features

- Agentic coding tool that reads your codebase, edits files, runs commands, and integrates with your development tools\.
- Available in terminal, IDE extensions, desktop app, and browser\.
- Executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands\.
- Connects to external data sources and tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP)\.
- Customizable with CLAUDE\.md instructions, skills, hooks, and auto memory\.
- Supports parallel agents and custom agent workflows, including the Agent SDK\.

## Use Cases

- Automate tedious tasks such as writing tests, fixing lint errors, resolving merge conflicts, updating dependencies, and writing release notes\.
- Build features and fix bugs by describing what you want in plain language; Claude Code plans the approach, writes code across multiple files, and verifies it works\.
- Create commits and pull requests, including staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, and opening pull requests\.
- Connect external tools through MCP to read design docs in Google Drive, update tickets in Jira, or pull data from Slack\.

## Getting Started

- Install on macOS, Linux, or WSL with the native install script: curl \-fsSL https://claude\.ai/install\.sh \| bash
- Install on Windows PowerShell with: irm https://claude\.ai/install\.ps1 \| iex
- Alternatively install with Homebrew: brew install \-\-cask claude\-code
- Alternatively install with WinGet: winget install Anthropic\.ClaudeCode
- After installation, navigate to your project directory and run claude\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Most surfaces require a Claude subscription or Anthropic Console account\.
- The Terminal CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains also support third\-party providers\.
- The desktop app requires a paid subscription\.
- The JetBrains plugin requires the Claude Code CLI, installed separately\.
- Teleport and the /desktop handoff require a claude\.ai subscription\.

## Before You Adopt

- No recognizable license was detected; verify permission to use, modify, and distribute the project before adoption\.
- Installing via npm is deprecated in favor of recommended installation methods\.
- Most Claude Code surfaces require a Claude subscription or Anthropic Console account, though some CLI and IDE surfaces support third\-party providers\.
- Homebrew installations do not auto\-update, so users must manually upgrade to get the latest features and security fixes\.
- WinGet installations do not auto\-update, so periodic upgrades are required for the latest features and security fixes\.
- The desktop app is in beta on Ubuntu and Debian\.

projects.content:
## Overview

claude\-mem is an open\-source persistent memory compression system for Claude Code and other coding agents\. It captures tool usage observations during sessions, generates semantic summaries, and injects relevant context into future sessions so work can continue across session boundaries and machines\. The local engine stores memory on the user's machine, while optional CMEM Pro adds hosted observation, cloud sync, and private MCP recall\.

## Key Features

- Persistent memory keeps context available across sessions\.
- Progressive recall lets an agent find a relevant note before reading its details\.
- MCP search workflow uses search, timeline, and get\_observations for token\-efficient retrieval\.
- Cloud sync keeps captured project memory available across connected computers\.
- Privacy control supports private tags to exclude sensitive content from storage\.
- TeamBrain provides an optional shared workspace with team work lists, member attribution, and linked findings\.

## Use Cases

- Resume work with prior decisions, discoveries, and fixes available in later sessions\.
- Search project history for past bug fixes and architectural decisions\.
- Recall synced memory from MCP clients, including ChatGPT when the account supports custom connectors\.
- Share a project's history across supported tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx claude\-mem install for the default setup\.
- Target specific environments with IDE flags, such as npx claude\-mem install \-\-ide opencode or npx claude\-mem install \-\-ide grok\-bot\.
- Restart the host tool after installation so previous\-session context can appear in new sessions\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 20\.0\.0 or higher\.
- Claude Code latest version with plugin support for Claude Code integration\.
- Bun JavaScript runtime and process manager, auto\-installed if missing\.
- uv Python package manager for vector search, auto\-installed if missing\.
- SQLite 3 for persistent storage, bundled with the system\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Capture is limited to the tools and integrations installed; MCP recall does not imply automatic capture from every client\.
- Memory is stored locally by the open\-source engine; enabling cloud sync also stores synced data with CMEM, so privacy policy review is advised before connecting\.
- Hosted observation and cloud sync are provided by the paid CMEM Pro service rather than the free open\-source engine\.
- Token\-use effects vary by workload and provider, and CMEM Pro does not alter another subscription's price or limits\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Claude Code Plugins is Anthropic's official marketplace and directory for Claude Code plugins\. A Claude Code plugin is a directory of skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, or other components that Claude Code installs and loads as one unit; most plugins come from a marketplace, and the directory lists both Anthropic\-maintained internal plugins and third\-party plugins from partners and the community\.

## Key Features

- Packages skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, and other components into a single installable plugin\.
- Lists internal plugins developed and maintained by Anthropic alongside external third\-party plugins from partners and the community\.
- Supports installing from the official marketplace with /plugin install \{plugin\-name\}@claude\-plugins\-official or browsing plugins in /plugin \> Discover\.
- Defines a standard plugin structure with a required \.claude\-plugin/plugin\.json manifest and optional MCP configuration, commands, agents, skills, and README documentation\.
- Supports skill\-bundle marketplace entries for repositories that ship SKILL\.md files without a plugin manifest, using strict false and an explicit skills array\.

## Use Cases

- Install curated plugins from Anthropic's official marketplace to extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, or MCP servers\.
- Browse internal and third\-party plugins in the Discover tab to find a setup someone else built\.
- Submit third\-party plugins for inclusion in the official marketplace through the plugin directory submission form\.
- Package several skills, subagents, hooks, or MCP servers as one unit for teammates or multiple projects\.

## Getting Started

- Run /plugin in a Claude Code terminal session to open the plugin interface\.
- Browse the Discover tab to see plugins from your marketplaces, or install a plugin from the official marketplace with /plugin install \{plugin\-name\}@claude\-plugins\-official\.
- For plugin development without a marketplace, load the plugin directly from its folder with \-\-plugin\-dir\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Plugins may include MCP servers, files, or other software that Anthropic does not control or verify, so users should confirm trust before installing, updating, or using a plugin\.
- Installing a plugin can run code with the user's own privileges, regardless of marketplace tier\.
- An enabled plugin is active across every session, not only sessions where it is used\.

projects.content:
## Overview

CLI\-Anything is a project that makes software agent\-native\. It generates an agent\-native CLI for any software, codebase, or Web API so AI agents can operate it, with installation through a single command\. It is backed by CLI\-Hub, a registry of generated CLIs that can be browsed, searched, installed, updated, and removed from the command line\.

## Key Features

- Generates an agent\-native CLI for any software, codebase, or Web API so AI agents can operate it\.
- CLI\-Hub registry currently lists 656 CLIs across 279 categories, with browsing via cli\-hub list and keyword lookup via cli\-hub search\.
- One\-command agent skill installation through npx skills add HKUDS/CLI\-Anything \-\-skill cli\-hub\-meta\-skill \-g \-y\.
- A pip\-installed toolkit (pip install cli\-anything\-hub) providing cli\-hub list, search, install, info, update, and uninstall commands\.
- Matrices bundle curated intents mapped to provider CLIs, with 5 matrices and 62 capabilities listed\.
- Real\-world demos show agents driving generated CLIs to produce CAD models, 3D scenes, diagrams, gameplay, captioned video, and live GIS without a GUI\.

## Use Cases

- Prompting an agent to find appropriate CLI software in CLI\-Hub and complete a task through the generated CLI\.
- Bringing any application with a GUI or an API to the hub, including desktop apps, dev tools, cloud services, SaaS APIs, and creative suites\.
- Producing finished artifacts such as 3D CAD models, diagrams, gameplay, captioned video, and live GIS entirely through CLI automation\.

## Getting Started

- Add the agent skill: npx skills add HKUDS/CLI\-Anything \-\-skill cli\-hub\-meta\-skill \-g \-y
- Install the CLI toolkit: pip install cli\-anything\-hub
- Use cli\-hub list to browse the registry, cli\-hub search for keywords, cli\-hub install to install, cli\-hub info to inspect one CLI, cli\-hub update to update an install, and cli\-hub uninstall to remove an install\.
- Then prompt your agent: "Find appropriate CLI software in CLI\-Hub and complete the task: \.\.\."

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## Overview

Cline is an open\-source AI coding agent that runs as a VS Code extension, JetBrains plugin, CLI, desktop app, and SDK\. It helps developers understand codebases, refactor large projects, and automate workflows with human\-in\-the\-loop approval\. It supports Plan and Act modes, runs bash commands, and works with any model provider including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and local models via Ollama\.

## Key Features

- Plan and Act modes: toggle between planning and execution with approval on every step\.
- Edits across your project: coordinated multi\-file changes with linter\-aware fixes, diffs, checkpoints, and one\-click undo\.
- Runs bash commands: executes in your terminal and reacts to output in real time\.
- Rules and Skills: define \.clinerules to teach the agent your coding standards and conventions\.
- Works with every model: Claude, GPT, Gemini, local Ollama, or any OpenAI\-compatible endpoint\.
- Extend with MCP and plugins: register custom tools and lifecycle hooks via the SDK\.

## Use Cases

- Understand your codebase: ask questions about files, dependencies, and behavior\.
- Refactor large codebases: make coordinated changes while keeping imports, types, and behavior consistent\.
- Automate with Cline CLI: use in scripts, cron jobs, and CI pipelines for recurring checks and updates\.
- Multi\-agent teams: coordinate specialist agents for complex tasks\.

## Getting Started

- Install the CLI with \`npm i \-g cline\`, the SDK with \`npm install @cline/sdk\`, or download the desktop app for macOS and Windows\. For VS Code, install from the Marketplace; for JetBrains, install from the JetBrains Marketplace\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Cline runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux\. The desktop app is available for macOS and Windows\. The CLI and SDK require Node\.js\. It can connect to various model providers, including cloud and local endpoints\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

cmux is a free and open source native macOS terminal built on Ghostty for multitasking, organization, and programmability\. It is designed for developers running coding agents, with vertical tabs, notification rings, split panes, an in\-app browser, and a CLI\.

## Key Features

- Vertical tabs show git branch, working directory, listening ports, and latest notification text\.
- Notification rings and sidebar badges alert when coding agents need attention\.
- Split panes support horizontal and vertical splits within each tab\.
- The in\-app browser can be split alongside the terminal and controlled through a scriptable API\.
- A CLI and Unix socket API enable automation, scripting, and workspace control\.
- The native Swift and AppKit app uses libghostty for GPU\-accelerated rendering\.

## Use Cases

- Running multiple coding agents in parallel and seeing which pane needs attention\.
- Orchestrating subagents or teammates as native panes and splits instead of hidden background processes\.
- Verifying web changes with the in\-app browser while agents work in the terminal\.
- Working with remote machines by opening workspaces over SSH and attaching to remote tmux sessions\.

## Getting Started

- Download the macOS DMG, open it, and drag cmux to the Applications folder; cmux auto\-updates via Sparkle\.
- Alternatively, install with Homebrew by running brew tap manaflow\-ai/cmux and brew install \-\-cask cmux\.
- On first launch, macOS may ask you to confirm opening an app from an identified developer; click Open to proceed\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires macOS to run the native cmux terminal app\.
- Available platform builds are listed in the Download menu; platforms not yet released have a waitlist\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The iOS companion app is in beta\.
- The iOS companion is distributed through TestFlight as cmux BETA\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Codewhale is an open\-source coding agent and terminal client built on a local Rust agent engine\. It can read a project, edit files, run commands, and check its work, while using hosted provider APIs or local and self\-hosted models\.

## Key Features

- Provider choice across more than 40 built\-in provider routes, OpenAI\-compatible endpoints, and local models through Ollama, vLLM, or SGLang\.
- Plan, Work, and Operate modes with approval postures, workspace recovery through /undo and /restore, and session activity listed by /receipts\.
- Interactive terminal, headless exec, local browser client, and a local HTTP runtime API for threads, events, and approvals\.
- Extensibility through MCP servers, skills, plugins, hooks, and compatibility with existing Claude Code plugins\.
- Multi\-agent workflows with sub\-agents, supervised agent teams, Fleet setup and status, and checked\-in workflows\.
- Computer Use plugin for observing and operating other applications, with access granted by the user\.

## Use Cases

- Build an app, add a feature, or write a script, then run the code and test what it builds\.
- Automate repeated workflows from the terminal, scripts, or CI, including headless turns with codewhale exec\.
- Connect tools through plugins and MCP servers, or use APIs from your own scripts\.
- Split a larger job across agents with different roles and models using Fleet\.

## Getting Started

- Install Codewhale on macOS or Linux with the install script, follow any PATH instruction it prints, then open a project folder\.
- Connect a model with codewhale auth set \-\-provider deepseek, use /provider or F3, and switch models with /model\.
- Run codewhale and describe a concrete task, then choose permissions and review its work\.
- Optionally save a multi\-agent team with /fleet setup and check runs with /fleet status\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on macOS, Linux, and Windows; Android on Termux is a preview\.
- Install routes include the install script, npm, Cargo, Docker, Nix, Homebrew on Linux, and manual downloads\.
- Model access can use provider accounts, an OpenAI\-compatible endpoint, or local and self\-hosted inference through Ollama, vLLM, or SGLang\.
- Connected services require their own setup and authentication\.
- The terminal, local browser, and VS Code GUI need no Codewhale account; hosted web and desktop use an account\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The hosted web app is a development preview, and hosted task execution is still being qualified\.
- The native desktop app is in development and has no public download yet\.
- Connected services require separate setup and authentication\.
- On Linux, bubblewrap sandboxing depends on bubblewrap being installed and working\.

## Overview

Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer\. It provides a lightweight terminal\-based coding agent experience and can also be used through IDE integrations, a desktop app, and the cloud\-based Codex Web\.

- Runs locally on your computer

- Local coding agent workflows

- Standalone installers download from https://releases\.openai\.com/codex by default and fall back to GitHub Releases if a metadata or asset download is unavailable\.

## Before You Adopt

- Standalone installers have a default download source and fall back to GitHub Releases if metadata or asset downloads are unavailable\.
- Using Codex with a ChatGPT plan depends on signing in with a ChatGPT account and is associated with Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, or Enterprise plans\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Cognee is an open\-source agent memory platform for LLM agents\. It builds persistent memory across sessions from documents, code, and conversations, turning them into a self\-hosted knowledge graph that agents can search and reuse\. It supports graph, vector, and relational retrieval and can run locally, in Docker, on\-prem, or on Cognee Cloud\.

## Key Features

- Persistent long\-term memory across sessions for AI agents
- Graph, vector, and relational retrieval
- Self\-hosted knowledge graph engine
- First\-party integrations for Claude Code, Cursor, LangGraph, OpenClaw, and more, plus an MCP server
- Custom ontologies, custom data models, and permissions control
- Local use without an OpenAI or Anthropic API key

## Use Cases

- Build a Company Brain by bringing documentation, conversations, tickets, code, and agent work into shared memory\.
- Give agents memory across runs so they retain project context, past decisions, fixes, and learned rules\.
- Ground agents in your domain by structuring memory around entities and relationships with custom data models and ontologies\.
- Support customer\-facing agents that retrieve cited facts, follow domain rules, and improve from real usage\.

## Getting Started

- Requires Python 3\.10–3\.14\.
- Install with uv pip install "cognee\[gliner\]" or another Python package manager\.
- Optionally configure the LLM by setting LLM\_API\_KEY or creating a \.env file from the template\.
- Run locally without an LLM by saving the quickstart script and running python quickstart\.py, or use cognee\-cli remember and cognee\-cli recall\.
- Explore the bundled demo with cognee\-cli demo\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.10–3\.14\.
- Can run self\-hosted, in Docker, on\-prem, or on Cognee Cloud\.
- Cognee can be deployed BYOC in your own cloud\.
- Cognee Cloud is a managed service option\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Default processing uses OpenAI for language models and embeddings, and processing plus generated answers make provider calls\.
- Generated answers and media processing that requires vision or transcription models need additional LLM configuration\.
