projects.content:
## Overview

ComfyUI is an AI creation engine for visual professionals, centered on a modular node\-graph interface for building and reusing image, video, audio, 3D, and text workflows\. It offers local and cloud options, an API, App Mode, and Comfy Agent, which can plan, build, and run workflows from natural\-language descriptions inside ComfyUI\.

## Key Features

- Visual node graph for building and reusing image, video, audio, 3D, and text workflows without code, with visible and adjustable models, parameters, and processing steps\.
- Comfy Agent lets users describe what they want inside ComfyUI; it plans, builds, and runs workflows while editing the canvas alongside the user\.
- Efficient local execution with asynchronous queueing, partial graph re\-execution, smart VRAM and RAM management, model offloading, and quantized model support\.
- Broad native model support spanning image generation and editing, video generation, audio and music, 3D and vision, and text generation\.
- Reusable subgraphs, workflow templates, App Mode, a local API, and JSON workflow save/load with workflow and seed recovery from supported generated media\.
- Runs fully offline for built\-in functionality; the core does not download anything unless requested, and optional API nodes can be disabled\.

## Use Cases

- Creating product scenes and video ads from base compositions, product references, keyframes, and motion references\.
- Generating and editing images with models such as Stable Diffusion, SDXL, SD3\.5, Flux\.1, and Flux\.2\.
- Generating video with models such as Wan, LTX\-Video, HunyuanVideo, CogVideoX, and Mochi\.
- Running 3D, vision, and media processing tasks such as depth estimation, segmentation, upscaling, frame interpolation, and inpainting or outpainting\.

## Getting Started

- Download the desktop application or try Comfy Cloud for free\.
- Load a workflow from a community template or build one from scratch\.
- Generate and iterate by running and adjusting workflows, then scale when ready\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Available locally on Windows, Linux, and macOS through the desktop application, portable install, or manual install, and available in the cloud via Comfy Cloud\.
- Manual install supports all operating systems and GPU types, including NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple Silicon, and Ascend\.
- With asynchronous weight streaming, the biggest open\-source models can run on as low as 4GB VRAM plus 8GB RAM relatively quickly\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: GPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Commits outside stable release tags may be very unstable and can break many custom nodes\.

ComfyUI 是面向视觉专业人员的 AI 创作引擎，核心是模块化节点图界面，用于构建和复用图像、视频、音频、3D 与文本工作流。它提供本地与云端选项、API、App Mode，以及可在 ComfyUI 内根据自然语言描述规划、构建并运行工作流的 Comfy Agent。

## 核心功能

- 可视化节点图无需代码即可构建和复用图像、视频、音频、3D 与文本工作流，模型、参数和处理步骤均可见且可调整。Comfy Agent 允许用户在 ComfyUI 内描述需求，由它规划、构建并运行工作流，同时在用户工作时编辑画布。本地执行支持异步排队、部分图重新执行、智能显存与内存管理、模型卸载和量化模型。原生支持广泛的模型，覆盖图像生成与编辑、视频生成、音频与音乐、3D 与视觉以及文本生成。支持可复用子图、工作流模板、App Mode、本地 API，以及 JSON

## 适用场景

- 从基础构图、产品参考、关键帧和运动参考创建产品场景与视频广告。使用 Stable Diffusion、SDXL、SD3\.5、Flux\.1 和 Flux\.2 等模型生成和编辑图像。使用 Wan、LTX\-Video、HunyuanVideo、CogVideoX 和 Mochi 等模型生成视频。执行 3D、视觉和媒体处理任务，例如深度估计、分割、放大、帧插值以及内补或外补。

## 快速开始

- 下载桌面应用或免费试用 Comfy Cloud。从社区模板加载工作流，或从零构建工作流。运行并调整工作流以进行生成和迭代，准备好后再扩展。

## 部署与要求

- 可通过桌面应用、便携安装或手动安装在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上本地使用，也可通过 Comfy Cloud 在云端使用。手动安装支持所有操作系统和 GPU 类型，包括 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel、Apple Silicon 和 Ascend。借助异步权重流式传输，最大的开源模型也能在低至 4GB 显存加 8GB 内存的环境中相对快速地运行。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：GPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.name: Context Mode
projects.tagline: The control plane between coding agents and models.
projects.taglineZh: 连接编码智能体与模型的控制平面
projects.description: Context Mode is a control plane between AI coding agents and model APIs. It folds tool output before the model reads it, archives full output, persists memory and skills across sessions, and enforces rules for commands and file reads.
projects.descriptionZh: Context Mode 是位于 AI 编码智能体与模型 API 之间的控制平面。它在模型读取前折叠工具输出并归档完整内容，跨会话保留记忆与技能，并对命令、文件读取和网页抓取执行规则。
projects.content:
## Overview

Context Mode is a control plane that sits between AI coding agents and model APIs\. It acts before requests go out, before tool calls run, and when results return, aiming to lower request costs, carry session memory across agents and machines, and enforce rules over what agents may run, read and fetch\.

## Key Features

- Folds test, build, log and large tool output before the model reads it while keeping the full output in an archive\.
- Runs scripts so only the answer returns to the model, and trims tool schemas\.
- Maintains active context with recent work unchanged and an index of older work\.
- Shares memory facts and skills across agents and machines, with session resume\.
- Protect checks commands, file reads, web fetches and tool\-server calls against team rules before execution\.
- The console shows tokens, cost, savings and blocks for each request\.

## Use Cases

- Reducing model costs for long agentic coding sessions and test\-fix loops\.
- Handling large logs, JSON files and API responses without sending entire outputs to the model\.
- Continuing long sessions after pauses or on another machine without compaction\.
- Blocking access to environment files, protected branches, destructive commands and restricted sites\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @context\-mode/cli; it signs you in, asks which agents to connect, and keeps a backup of each file\.
- Restart your agent and start a new session\.
- Use the console to watch tokens, cost, saving and blocks for every request\.
- To leave, run npx @context\-mode/cli disconnect\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Your own Anthropic or OpenAI account pays the model; Context Mode adds no fee on tokens\.
- The CLI connects Claude Code and Codex by changing the base URL and writing configuration files\.
- Enterprise can run on Context Mode cloud, a dedicated instance, or the customer's own Cloudflare account\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Protect examines the tool call rather than the program, so script files or compiled programs can bypass its checks; the agent sandbox should stay on\.
- Model usage remains billed to the user's own Anthropic or OpenAI account\.
- Published benchmark comparisons include Claude Code on Opus 5\.5, and no Codex benchmark figure is provided\.

## 项目简介

## 核心功能

- 在模型读取前折叠测试、构建、日志和大型工具输出，同时将完整输出保留在归档中。运行脚本后仅把答案返回模型，并精简工具模式。维护活动上下文：近期工作保持不变，较早工作以索引呈现。跨智能体和机器共享记忆事实与技能，并支持会话恢复。Protect 在执行前依据团队规则检查命令、文件读取、网页抓取和工具服务器调用。控制台显示每次请求的 token、成本、节省和拦截情况。

## 快速开始

- 运行 npx @context\-mode/cli；该命令会登录、询问要连接哪些智能体，并为每个文件保留备份。重启智能体并开始新会话。使用控制台查看每次请求的 token、成本、节省和拦截情况。要退出，运行 npx @context\-mode/cli disconnect。

projects.content:
## Overview

Crawl4AI is an open\-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents\. It converts websites into clean, LLM\-ready Markdown for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines\. It can be self\-hosted for free with Python, CLI, Docker, and MCP, or used through Crawl4AI Cloud with one API key\.

## Key Features

- Clean LLM\-ready Markdown with headings, lists, tables, code blocks, and citation hints\.
- Structured data extraction with CSS, XPath, regex, or LLM strategies into typed JSON\.
- Browser control with persistent profiles, remote CDP connections, sessions, proxies, stealth mode, and Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit\.
- Deep crawling with BFS, DFS, best\-first strategies, crash recovery, adaptive crawling, and URL discovery\.
- Self\-hosting through the Python library, CLI, Docker REST API, MCP server, dashboard, and playground\.
- Crawl4AI Cloud adds hosted scrape, batch, search, answer, and extract APIs plus MCP for agents\.

## Use Cases

- Feed clean Markdown into RAG pipelines and AI agents\.
- Extract typed JSON records from websites with CSS, XPath, regex, or LLM extraction\.
- Run web search and direct answers through the hosted API\.
- Crawl many pages at scale for data pipelines and research\.

## Getting Started

- Install the open\-source library with pip install \-U crawl4ai and run crawl4ai\-setup\.
- Use the Python AsyncWebCrawler to fetch a URL and print result\.markdown\.
- For cloud use, get an API key and call the hosted scrape, search, answer, or extract endpoints with a Bearer token\.
- Add the cloud MCP server to agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or OpenCode using one configuration line\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The library supports Python 3\.10 through 3\.13\.
- crawl4ai\-setup installs and sets up the browser; if it fails, install Playwright Chromium manually\.
- The Docker server requires CRAWL4AI\_API\_TOKEN; without a token it answers only inside its container\.
- Crawl4AI Cloud requires an API key and uses the hosted service instead of running browsers or proxies yourself\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The hosted answer endpoint is marked experimental\.
- Launch pricing is discounted for the first year and may change, while credit already held keeps its value\.
- The self\-hosted Docker server requires an API token; without one it only responds inside its container\.
- Enterprise compliance maturity is in progress: SOC 2 Type I is complete and Type II is under way\.

projects.description: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an open-source agent harness in developer preview. Every agent capability is implemented as a composable Cordis plugin for models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and the UI.
projects.descriptionZh: DeepSeek Harness（dsh）是 DeepSeek AI 开发的开源智能体框架，目前处于开发者预览阶段。它基于 Cordis 插件系统构建，模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度与界面等各项能力均以可替换、可重组的插件实现，并且每一次运行都可追溯。
projects.content:
## Overview

DeepSeek Harness is an open\-source agent harness developed by DeepSeek AI and built on the Cordis plugin system\. It is in developer preview with source code available\. In DeepSeek Harness, every agent capability is implemented as a plugin that can be swapped or recomposed, and every run is recorded in an append\-only session log for traceability\.

## Key Features

- Everything is a plugin: models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and the UI are provided by Cordis plugins that can be selected, swapped, or extended in configuration\.
- Every run is traceable through an append\-only session log that records system prompts, reasoning, tool calls and results, subagent scheduling, and context injections\.
- Multiple runtime modes: Standard mode includes the full toolset; Code mode orchestrates multi\-step tool calls through the Code Mode SDK; Minimal mode keeps only a shell tool and a file editor; Creator mode supports runtime inspection and plugin experiments\.
- The Cordis kernel manages plugin mounting, unmounting, and dependencies, with Cordis services and events connecting plugins\.
- A Web UI and command\-line runtime are available, with quick launch through npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web or source installation options\.

## Use Cases

- Building and customizing agent harnesses for tasks such as file editing, shell commands, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows\.
- Benchmarking models in a minimal environment with a two\-tool coding agent\.
- Creating custom agent presets and experimenting with Cordis plugins in Creator mode\.
- Inspecting, resuming, forking, searching, and replaying agent runs from session logs\.

## Getting Started

- Install Node\.js, then run npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web to start the Web UI\.
- To run from source, clone the repository, run pnpm install, run pnpm run build, and then run pnpm dsh web\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js is required for the npm launch method\.
- Running from source requires pnpm, a repository checkout, and built artifacts prepared by pnpm run build before pnpm dsh web\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project remains in developer preview, is still being tested, and its core plugins and APIs will continue to evolve\.
- The append\-only session log records everything the model sees, including system prompts, reasoning, tool calls and results, subagent scheduling, and context injections, which is relevant when handling sensitive data\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek AI 开发的开源智能体框架（agent harness），基于 Cordis 插件系统构建，源代码随开发者预览一同发布。在 DeepSeek Harness 中，每一项智能体能力都以插件形式实现，可以替换或重新组合；每一次运行都会记录在只追加的会话日志中，便于追溯。

## 核心功能

- 一切皆插件：模型、工具、技能、会话、沙箱、存储、循环、调度和界面均由 Cordis 插件提供，可在配置中选择、替换或扩展，无需改动 DeepSeek Harness 源码。
- Cordis 内核负责插件的挂载、卸载与依赖管理，插件之间通过 Cordis 服务与事件协同工作。
- 每次运行都可追溯：模型看到的一切都会记录在只追加的会话日志中，包括系统提示、推理、工具调用与结果、子智能体调度以及每一次上下文注入。
- 轨迹视图可按来源查看这些记录，恢复、分叉、搜索和重放都基于同一事件流。
- 多种运行模式：标准模式包含完整工具集；代码模式通过 Code Mode SDK 暴露工具，让模型在一个 TypeScript 程序中组合多步操作；最小模式只保留 shell 与文件编辑器两个工具；创造者模式支持检查当前运行时、在内存中测试 Cordis 插件并组合成新模式。
- 提供 Web 界面与命令行运行时，可通过 npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web 快速启动。

## 适用场景

- 构建和定制智能体框架，用于文件编辑、shell 命令、文件与网络搜索、技能、规划、目标、子智能体和流程等任务。
- 在最小环境中以两工具编码智能体对模型进行基准测试。
- 在创造者模式中创建自定义智能体预设，并试验 Cordis 插件。
- 通过会话日志检查、恢复、分叉、搜索和重放智能体运行过程。

## 快速开始

- 安装 Node\.js，然后运行 npx @deepseek\-ai/dsh web 启动 Web 界面，默认在本地 127\.0\.0\.1:3080 打开。
- 如需从源码运行，先克隆仓库，进入目录后依次执行 pnpm install、pnpm run build，再执行 pnpm dsh web；pnpm run build 准备构建产物，pnpm dsh web 直接使用这些产物而不再重新构建。

## 部署与要求

- 使用 npm 启动方式需要安装 Node\.js。
- 从源码运行需要 pnpm、仓库检出代码，以及由 pnpm run build 准备好的构建产物，之后才能执行 pnpm dsh web。

projects.name: DeepSeek-V3
projects.tagline: Mixture-of-Experts language model with 671B parameters
projects.taglineZh: 671B 参数混合专家语言模型，每 token 激活 37B
projects.description: DeepSeek-V3 is a Mixture-of-Experts language model with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token. It supports a 128K context and is available in Base and Chat variants with open weights for local deployment and API use.
projects.descriptionZh: DeepSeek-V3 是一款混合专家（MoE）语言模型，总参数量 671B，每个 token 激活 37B 参数。它支持 128K 上下文，提供 Base 与 Chat 两个版本，开放权重可用于本地部署，也可通过 API 使用。
projects.content:
## Overview

DeepSeek\-V3 is a Mixture\-of\-Experts (MoE) language model with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token\. It uses Multi\-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE, an auxiliary\-loss\-free load balancing strategy, and a Multi\-Token Prediction objective\. It was pre\-trained on 14\.8 trillion tokens and then fine\-tuned and reinforced, with evaluations reporting strong performance on math and code tasks and a 128K context window\.

## Key Features

- Mixture\-of\-Experts architecture with 671B total parameters and 37B activated per token\.
- Multi\-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE architectures\.
- Auxiliary\-loss\-free load balancing strategy for minimizing performance degradation\.
- Multi\-Token Prediction (MTP) training objective that can also support speculative decoding\.
- FP8 mixed precision training framework validated on an extremely large\-scale model\.
- Pre\-trained on 14\.8 trillion tokens with 128K context length and Base and Chat variants\.

## Use Cases

- Chatting with DeepSeek\-V3 through the official website or an OpenAI\-compatible API\.
- Running local inference and deployment with DeepSeek\-Infer Demo, SGLang, LMDeploy, TensorRT\-LLM, vLLM, or LightLLM\.
- Handling code and math tasks where DeepSeek\-V3 reports strong benchmark performance\.
- Researching MoE architectures, FP8 training, Multi\-Token Prediction, and reasoning distillation from DeepSeek\-R1\.

## Getting Started

- Clone the DeepSeek\-V3 GitHub repository and navigate to the inference folder\.
- Install dependencies from requirements\.txt, preferably in a fresh conda or uv virtual environment\.
- Download model weights from Hugging Face and place them in a local folder\.
- Convert Hugging Face model weights using convert\.py with the desired expert and model\-parallel settings\.
- Run interactive or batch inference with torchrun and generate\.py using the provided config\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo requires Linux with Python 3\.10 only; Mac and Windows are not supported\.
- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo dependencies include torch 2\.4\.1, triton 3\.0\.0, transformers 4\.46\.3, and safetensors 0\.4\.5\.
- FP8 weights are provided; BF16 weights can be generated with the provided fp8\_cast\_bf16\.py conversion script\.
- Hugging Face Transformers is not directly supported yet\.
- SGLang supports NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and multi\-node tensor parallelism in BF16 and FP8 modes\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GitHub records the last push on 2025\-08\-28, at least 12 months before this listing was prepared; verify the current maintenance status before adoption\.
- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo has platform restrictions and supports only Linux with Python 3\.10; Mac and Windows are not supported\.
- Hugging Face Transformers is not directly supported yet, so users need another supported inference path\.
- MTP support is under active development within the community, so that capability may require community progress or contributions\.
- Only FP8 weights are provided, and BF16 weights require a conversion script for experimentation\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

DeepSeek\-V3 是一款混合专家（MoE）语言模型，总参数量 671B，每个 token 激活 37B 参数。它采用多头潜在注意力（MLA）与 DeepSeekMoE 架构，使用无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测目标。模型在 14\.8 万亿 token 上预训练，随后经过监督微调与强化学习阶段；评估显示其在数学和代码任务上表现突出，并支持 128K 上下文窗口。

## 核心功能

- 总参数量 671B，每个 token 激活 37B 参数。采用多头潜在注意力（MLA）和 DeepSeekMoE 架构。使用无辅助损失的负载均衡策略，以减少因鼓励负载均衡而带来的性能下降。采用多 token 预测（MTP）训练目标，该目标也可用于推测解码。设计 FP8 混合精度训练框架，并在超大规模模型上验证其可行性与有效性。在 14\.8 万亿 token 上预训练，支持 128K 上下文长度，提供 Base 与 Chat 版本。

## 适用场景

- 通过 DeepSeek 官网或 OpenAI 兼容 API 与 DeepSeek\-V3 对话。使用 DeepSeek\-Infer Demo、SGLang、LMDeploy、TensorRT\-LLM、vLLM 或 LightLLM 进行本地推理和部署。处理模型在基准测试中表现较强的代码和数学任务。研究 MoE 架构、FP8 训练、多 token 预测以及从 DeepSeek\-R1 进行推理蒸馏。

## 快速开始

- 克隆 DeepSeek\-V3 GitHub 仓库，并进入 inference 文件夹。在新建的 conda 或 uv 虚拟环境中，从 requirements\.txt 安装依赖。从 Hugging Face 下载模型权重并放入本地文件夹。使用 convert\.py 并按所需的专家数和模型并行设置转换 Hugging Face 模型权重。使用提供的配置，通过 torchrun 和 generate\.py 运行交互式或批量推理。

## 部署与要求

- DeepSeek\-Infer Demo 仅支持 Linux 与 Python 3\.10；不支持 Mac 和 Windows。DeepSeek\-Infer Demo 依赖包括 torch 2\.4\.1、triton 3\.0\.0、transformers 4\.46\.3 和 safetensors 0\.4\.5。官方仅提供 FP8 权重；如需 BF16 权重，可使用提供的 fp8\_cast\_bf16\.py 转换脚本生成。Hugging Face Transformers 尚未直接支持。SGLang 在 BF16 和 FP8 模式下支持 NVIDIA 与 AMD

## 采用前须知

projects.content:
## Overview

Dify is an open\-source LLM app development platform\. Its intuitive interface combines AI workflow, RAG pipeline, agent capabilities, model management, and observability features, letting you quickly go from prototype to production\.

## Key Features

- Workflow: Build and test powerful AI workflows on a visual canvas\.
- Comprehensive model support: Seamless integration with hundreds of proprietary and open\-source LLMs from dozens of providers\.
- Prompt IDE: Intuitive interface for crafting prompts and comparing model performance\.
- RAG Pipeline: Extensive RAG capabilities from document ingestion to retrieval with out\-of\-box text extraction\.
- Agent: Autonomous agents with a sandbox to run commands, install software, and handle files\.
- LLMOps: Monitor and analyze application logs and performance over time\.

## Use Cases

- Use Dify Cloud for zero\-setup trial with 200 free GPT\-4 calls\.
- Self\-host Dify Community Edition in your environment\.
- Deploy Dify Enterprise for SSO, RBAC, and support SLAs\.
- Integrate Dify into your business logic via its APIs\.

## Getting Started

- Install Docker and Docker Compose v2\.24\.0 or later\. In the dify/docker directory, copy \.env\.example to \.env and run docker compose up \-d\. Then access http://localhost/install to start initialization\. Ensure CPU \>= 2 Core and RAM \>= 4 GiB\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- CPU \>= 2 Core, RAM \>= 4 GiB, Docker and Docker Compose v2\.24\.0 or later\. Can deploy on cloud, VPC, or self\-hosted\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Security issues should be reported via email rather than GitHub to protect privacy\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Docling simplifies document processing by parsing diverse formats, including advanced PDF understanding, and providing seamless integrations with the generative AI ecosystem\. It offers a unified DoclingDocument representation and export formats such as Markdown, HTML, and lossless JSON\.

## Key Features

- Parses multiple document formats including PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, EPUB, Apple Pages, WAV, MP3, WebVTT, Box Notes, email formats, images, LaTeX, DocLang, and plain text\.
- Advanced PDF understanding including page layout, reading order, table structure, code, formulas, and image classification\.
- Unified DoclingDocument representation with export formats including Markdown, HTML, WebVTT, DocLang, DocTags, and lossless JSON\.
- Local execution for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.
- Plug\-and\-play integrations with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Crew AI, and Haystack, plus MCP server and API server support\.
- Extensive OCR support, Visual Language Models, and Automatic Speech Recognition for audio\.

## Use Cases

- Convert documents into structured Markdown or JSON for generative AI and RAG pipelines\.
- Build RAG applications with integrations such as Haystack, LangChain, and LlamaIndex\.
- Extract information from PDFs, office files, emails, EPUB, and images with OCR\.
- Run document processing locally for sensitive or air\-gapped environments\.

## Getting Started

- Install Docling with pip install docling\.
- Use the Docling CLI to convert a document and generate a Markdown file with structured content\.
- Use the Python DocumentConverter to convert a source and export the document to Markdown\.
- Detailed installation and usage documentation is available\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or higher is required; Python 3\.9 support was dropped in docling version 2\.70\.0\.
- Works on macOS, Linux, and Windows for x86\_64 and arm64 architectures\.
- Local execution is available for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.
- Can run as a service with the API server (docling\-serve)\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Python 3\.9 support was dropped in docling version 2\.70\.0, so deployments should use Python 3\.10 or higher\.
- Metadata extraction is listed as coming soon, indicating it is not currently supported\.
- Local execution is available for sensitive data and air\-gapped environments\.
projects.contentZh:

## 核心功能

- 支持解析 PDF、DOCX、PPTX、XLSX、HTML、EPUB、Apple Pages、WAV、MP3、WebVTT、Box Notes、电子邮件格式、图像、LaTeX、DocLang 和纯文本等多种文档格式。具备高级 PDF 理解能力，包括页面布局、阅读顺序、表格结构、代码、公式和图像分类等。提供统一的 DoclingDocument 表示，可导出 Markdown、HTML、WebVTT、DocLang、DocTags 和无损 JSON 等格式。支持敏感数据和气隙环境中的本地执行。提供与 LangChain、LlamaIndex、Crew AI

## 适用场景

- 将文档转换为结构化 Markdown 或 JSON，用于生成式 AI 和 RAG 流程。借助 Haystack、LangChain 和 LlamaIndex 等集成构建 RAG 应用。通过 OCR 从 PDF、办公文件、电子邮件、EPUB 和图像中提取信息。在敏感或气隙环境中本地运行文档处理。

## 快速开始

- 使用 pip install docling 安装 Docling。使用 Docling CLI 转换文档并生成包含结构化内容的 Markdown 文件。使用 Python DocumentConverter 转换来源并将文档导出为 Markdown。详细安装和使用文档可供查阅。

## 部署与要求

projects.content:
## Overview

ECC is an open\-source toolkit that gives coding agents a shared engineering process across harnesses\. It combines skills, agents, hooks, memory, planning tools and security scanning so agents can plan, test, review, verify and retain useful lessons\. The open\-source project is MIT\-licensed, and a separate GitHub App adds repository workflow guidance and paid plans\.

## Key Features

- Includes 71 agents for planning, review, build repair, security, architecture and domain work\.
- Provides 311 skills covering TDD, research, security, docs, frontend, data, ML and operations\.
- Adds hooks, rules, unified memory and continuous learning for session summaries, handoffs and context controls\.
- Includes AgentShield scanning for prompts, hooks, MCP configuration, permissions, secrets and agent files\.
- Offers Plan Canvas for annotating plans in the browser and reviewing revisions in place\.
- Supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Kimi Code, GitHub and other harnesses with native or adapter\-based integration\.

## Use Cases

- Reviewing code changes with a repeatable reviewer process\.
- Checking security surfaces such as permissions, inputs and exposed secrets\.
- Planning and coordinating work through annotated plans and a session overview\.
- Carrying context between agents with saved handoffs and searchable project memory\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx ecc\-universal@2\.2\.3 setup for guided package setup for Claude Code, Codex and Kimi Code\.
- For a typical personal setup, choose Global user and Standard hooks, then confirm\.
- After setup, start a new Claude Code session and run /plugin list to verify that ecc@ecc is enabled\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The universal package requires Node\.js 18 or newer\.
- Claude plugin setup also requires Git and Claude Code 2\.1 or newer on PATH\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AgentShield scanning is a review aid and does not guarantee that a repository or agent is safe\.
- Install only from official channels because third\-party re\-uploads and unofficial mirrors may contain malware\.
- Review requested GitHub permissions before installing the GitHub App\.

projects.content:
## Overview

ego lite is a browser built for AI agents to run automation alongside your own browsing\. Agents work in isolated Spaces within the same browser, so they never interrupt you\. It inherits your Chrome data and uses code\-based tools for faster, cheaper runs\. It is free and requires no configuration\.

## Key Features

- Code\-based tools instead of CLI commands, enabling faster runs and fewer tokens for complex tasks\.
- Dedicated isolated Space for each agent, so you and your agents work in parallel without conflict\.
- Parallel multitasking: multiple agents can run different tasks in separate Spaces simultaneously\.
- High\-quality page snapshots that handle deeply nested iframes reliably\.
- Any agent CLI can drive the browser via the ego\-browser skill, exposing in\-page JavaScript tools\.

## Use Cases

- Running parallel data enrichment tasks, e\.g\., Claude Code enriching leads in multiple Spaces\.
- Scraping competitor websites with Codex in separate Spaces\.
- Automating repetitive browser workflows while you continue browsing normally\.

## Getting Started

- Download the macOS app from the provided links, or install the ego\-browser skill via npx skills add citrolabs/ego\-lite\. On first launch, choose to migrate Chrome data to inherit logins and cookies\. Then use /ego\-browser in your agent CLI to start tasks\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Currently supports macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)\. Windows closed beta is coming soon, with Linux on the roadmap\. Requires an agent CLI (e\.g\., Claude Code, Codex) to drive the browser via the ego\-browser skill\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Data stays on\-device with deliberately narrow collection\.

projects.description: EmDash is an open source, full-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro from Cloudflare. It provides a typed schema, polished admin, and MCP server, REST API, and CLI for humans and AI agents to manage content.
projects.descriptionZh: EmDash 是 Cloudflare 推出的开源全栈 TypeScript CMS，基于 Astro 构建，提供类型化内容模型、管理后台、MCP 服务器、REST API 和 CLI，方便人类与 AI 智能体管理内容。
projects.content:
## Overview

EmDash is an open source, full\-stack TypeScript CMS built on Astro, described as the spiritual successor to WordPress\. It combines typed content modeling, an admin panel, media and taxonomy management, and agent tooling, while plugins run in isolated sandboxes with declared capabilities\.

## Key Features

- Astro\-native CMS with content types defined in the admin and TypeScript types generated from the schema\.
- Drafts, revisions, scheduled publishing, preview links, and full\-text search\.
- Admin includes a visual schema builder, media library, navigation menus, taxonomies, widgets, and a WordPress import wizard\.
- Passkey\-first authentication with OAuth and magic link fallbacks, plus role\-based access control\.
- Built\-in MCP server, CLI, and REST API let AI agents and scripts manage content and schema\.
- Sandboxed plugin system with declared capabilities, hooks, storage, admin pages, custom blocks, and API routes\.

## Use Cases

- Build blogs, marketing sites, and portfolios using starter templates\.
- Migrate WordPress content, including posts, pages, media, and taxonomies\.
- Let AI assistants or coding agents draft, edit, search, and schedule content\.
- Extend a site with custom plugins, blocks, admin pages, and API routes\.

## Getting Started

- Run npm create emdash@latest to scaffold a new project\.
- Try the admin in the browser through the EmDash playground\.
- Deploy directly to a Cloudflare account using the Deploy to Cloudflare button\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on Cloudflare with D1, R2, and Workers, or on any Node\.js server with SQLite\.
- Database options include SQLite, D1, Turso/libSQL, and PostgreSQL; storage options include R2, AWS S3, S3\-compatible services, and local filesystem\.
- Plugins execute in sandboxed Cloudflare Worker isolates or in a workerd child process on Node\.js\.
- Sessions can use KV, Redis, or file\-based storage\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Core packages follow semantic versioning; breaking changes ship only in major releases and are called out in the changelog\.
- First\-party plugins and plugin tooling are still on 0\.x and may change between minor releases\.
- Cloudflare is the best\-supported runtime, but EmDash is not locked to it\.

## Overview

This repository is the canonical local source for reusable, project\-neutral agent skills\. It includes first\-party skill sources and local third\-party runtime installs, with reviewed source, revision, license, date, and digest recorded for installed third\-party skills\.

## Key Features

- First\-party skill sources are tracked as repository source and can be edited directly\.
- Local third\-party runtime installs are recorded with reviewed source, revision, license, date, and digest in third\-party\-skills\.json\.
- Dated audits cover first\-party skill guidance and routing for Zod 4\.5, Object Pascal, and Delphi\.
- Repository maintenance guidance is provided in AGENTS\.md before editing documentation or skills\.
- Safety boundaries address host configuration, runtime authority, runner execution, third\-party trust, and credential handling\.
- First\-party skills and repository tooling are licensed under the MIT License; third\-party skills remain subject to their upstream licenses\.

## Use Cases

- Maintaining reusable, project\-neutral agent skills across repositories\.
- Reviewing third\-party skill source, revision, license, date, and changed content before updating records\.
- Auditing first\-party skill guidance and routing for specific languages or frameworks\.
- Keeping repository documentation and skill guidance consistent before handoff\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Firecrawl is the web data API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale\. It helps find sources, extract content, and turn it into clean Markdown or structured data that AI agents can use\. The project is open source and also available as a hosted service, with core endpoints for Search, Scrape, and Interact plus Agent, Crawl, Map, and Batch Scrape\.

## Key Features

- Search the web and get full page content from results\.
- Scrape any URL into Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured JSON\.
- Interact with a scraped page using AI prompts or code\.
- Use the Agent endpoint to describe the data needed and let the AI agent search, navigate, and retrieve it\.
- Crawl all URLs of a website, map all site URLs instantly, and batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously\.
- Connect to AI agents and MCP clients, with SDKs for Python, Node\.js, Go, Java, Elixir, Rust, Ruby, \.NET, and PHP\.

## Use Cases

- Build AI agents that need real\-time web data in clean Markdown or structured JSON\.
- Search the web and retrieve full page content for research, monitoring, or RAG pipelines\.
- Scrape single pages or crawl entire websites into LLM\-ready formats\.
- Automate data gathering with a prompt when URLs are not known in advance\.

## Getting Started

- Sign up on the Firecrawl website to get an API key\.
- Install an SDK, such as pip install firecrawl\-py for Python or npm install firecrawl for Node\.js\.
- Create a Firecrawl client with your API key and call endpoints such as search, scrape, agent, crawl, map, or batch scrape\.
- For MCP, configure an MCP server with npx \-y firecrawl\-mcp and set the FIRECRAWL\_API\_KEY environment variable\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A Firecrawl API key is required for the hosted service; sign up on the Firecrawl website to obtain one\.
- The project is open source and can be run locally; the contributing guide provides local setup instructions\.
- The project can be self\-hosted, with a separate self\-hosting guide\.
- The cloud version includes additional features compared with the open\-source version\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Users are advised to follow applicable privacy policies and terms of use, and Firecrawl respects robots\.txt directives by default\.
- Use of Firecrawl is subject to compliance with the stated scraping and privacy conditions\.
- When using the Agent endpoint, sending both the model and effort fields results in a 400 error\.

projects.content:
## Overview

GDevelop is an open\-source, no\-code game engine for building 2D, 3D, and multiplayer games\. It is designed to be fast, intuitive, and usable from any device, with an event\-based system, modular behaviors, AI assistance, and export options for desktop, web, and mobile\.

## Key Features

- Drag\-and\-drop interface for visual, what\-you\-see\-is\-what\-you\-get game creation\.
- No\-code event system that avoids advanced programming languages\.
- Ready\-made behaviors that can be attached to objects for game logic\.
- One\-click exporting for desktops, the web, and mobile devices\.
- Built\-in multiplayer lobbies, leaderboards, and player accounts\.
- Open\-source extension ecosystem with JavaScript support\.

## Use Cases

- Create 2D, 3D, and multiplayer games for mobile, desktop, and the web\.
- Publish games on Steam, Android, iOS, and web platforms\.
- Use in classrooms and education settings\.
- Create promotional games for brands\.

## Getting Started

- Go to the GDevelop homepage to download the app\.
- Start your game now from the GDevelop editor\.
- Follow in\-app tutorials and courses to learn from newbie to pro\.
- Use AI assistance to ask questions and build game mechanics\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- One\-click publishing, a beginner course, weekly AI usage, and multiplayer lobbies are unlocked through a paid plan\.
- Online game services and commercial support are available as separate offerings\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Gemini CLI is an open\-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into the terminal, providing lightweight access from your prompt to the model\.

## Key Features

- Free tier with 60 requests per minute and 1,000 requests per day when using a personal Google account\.
- Access to powerful Gemini 3 models with improved reasoning and a 1M token context window\.
- Built\-in tools including Google Search grounding, file operations, shell commands, and web fetching\.
- Extensibility through MCP (Model Context Protocol) support for custom integrations\.
- Terminal\-first design for developers who live in the command line\.
- GitHub integration for pull request reviews, issue triage, on\-demand assistance, and custom workflows\.

## Use Cases

- Query and edit large codebases, generate new apps from PDFs, images, or sketches, and debug issues with natural language\.
- Automate operational tasks such as querying pull requests or handling complex rebases, and run non\-interactively in scripts\.
- Integrate with GitHub workflows for pull request reviews, issue triage, on\-demand assistance, and custom automation\.
- Ground queries with built\-in Google Search for real\-time information and use MCP servers for custom capabilities including media generation\.

## Getting Started

- Run instantly with npx @google/gemini\-cli without installation\.
- Install globally with npm using npm install \-g @google/gemini\-cli, Homebrew using brew install gemini\-cli, or MacPorts using sudo port install gemini\-cli\.
- Start in the current directory with gemini, include multiple directories with gemini \-\-include\-directories \.\./lib,\.\./docs, choose a model with gemini \-m gemini\-2\.5\-flash, and run non\-interactively with gemini \-p\.
- Authenticate by signing in with Google, using a Gemini API key, or using Vertex AI\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Preview releases are published weekly but are not fully vetted and may contain regressions or outstanding issues\.
- Organizations using a paid Code Assist License must set the Google Cloud Project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

GenOffice is a free, open\-source desktop office suite for macOS, Windows and Linux\. It provides Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, HTML and Markdown editors with a built\-in AI agent that can edit documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs\. Files open, edit, save and convert locally; AI features use Genspark credits or your own API key\.

## Key Features

- Docs opens and saves real \.docx files with byte\-preserving editing, so only the content you change is rewritten\.
- Sheets uses an in\-house \.xlsx engine with charts, pivot tables, slicers, conditional formatting and formula tracing\.
- Slides creates and edits native \.pptx decks with masters, layouts and smart guides\.
- PDF supports in\-place text and image editing, annotations and forms, plus local conversion to Word, Excel or PowerPoint\.
- HTML and Markdown editors generate and edit self\-contained pages and plain Markdown, with local export to Word\.
- Local file search indexes names, folders and extracted text in an on\-device SQLite full\-text index, with optional TypeSafe Jev reranking\.

## Use Cases

- Drafting and revising Word documents, reports and proposals with AI\-assisted rewrites and tracked changes\.
- Building budgets, summaries and charts in Excel\-compatible spreadsheets with live formulas\.
- Turning a topic into an editable PowerPoint deck, or editing existing decks\.
- Editing PDF text and images, converting PDFs to editable Office formats, and generating HTML or Markdown documents\.

## Getting Started

- Download GenOffice for macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), Windows (x64 or ARM64) or Linux (Debian/Ubuntu, AppImage, Fedora/RHEL) from genoffice\.ai or GitHub releases\.
- Open, edit, save and convert files locally; sign in with Genspark or add your own provider API key to use AI features\.
- For coding agents, install the genoffice skill from Settings → Integrations, download the skill as a zip, or run npx skills add genspark\-ai/genoffice; then use the genoffice CLI or genoffice mcp server\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS 11\+; Windows 10\+ (x64) or Windows 11\+ (ARM64); Linux x86\_64 with glibc 2\.34\+\.
- Desktop app with local opening, editing, saving and PDF\-to\-Office conversion\.
- AI features require Genspark credits or your own API key; supported providers include Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and any OpenAI\-compatible endpoint, local servers included\.
- Scanned\-page OCR is supported on macOS and Windows\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AI features are not fully bundled; they depend on Genspark credits or a user\-supplied API key, and provider usage charges may apply\.
- Formatting fidelity may vary for complex files, so important documents should be checked before sharing\.
- PDF conversion output should be reviewed for tables and formatting\.
- Online AI features send requests to the chosen provider when used, while core file operations stay local\.
- Official builds collect limited usage statistics by default, with an opt\-out in settings\.

projects.description: Graphiti is an open-source framework for building and querying temporal knowledge graphs for AI agents. It tracks how facts change over time, maintains provenance to source data, and supports hybrid retrieval for evolving real-world data.
projects.descriptionZh: Graphiti 是一个开源框架，用于构建和查询面向 AI 代理的时序知识图谱。它跟踪事实随时间的变化，维护对源数据的溯源，并支持针对不断演变的现实数据的混合检索。
projects.content:
## Overview

Graphiti is a framework for building and querying temporal context graphs for AI agents\. Unlike static knowledge graphs, it tracks how facts change over time, maintains provenance to source data, and supports both prescribed and learned ontology\. It continuously integrates user interactions, structured and unstructured enterprise data, and external information into a coherent, queryable graph\.

## Key Features

- Temporal Fact Management: Facts have validity windows; old facts are invalidated not deleted\. Episodes & Provenance: Every entity and relationship traces back to raw episodes\. Prescribed & Learned Ontology: Define entity and edge types via Pydantic models or let structure

## Use Cases

- Build temporal knowledge graphs that evolve with every interaction\. Represent rich, structured context instead of flat document chunks\. Query across time, meaning, and relationships with hybrid retrieval\.

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install graphiti\-core\. Requires Python 3\.10\+, a graph database (Neo4j, FalkorDB, Amazon Neptune, or Kuzu), and an OpenAI API key\. See the Quickstart example for connecting, initializing indices, adding episodes, and searching\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Python 3\.10 or higher; Neo4j 5\.26 / FalkorDB 1\.1\.2 / Amazon Neptune Database Cluster or Neptune Analytics Graph \+ Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection / Kuzu 0\.11\.2 (deprecated); OpenAI API key (defaults to OpenAI for LLM inference and embedding)\. Optional: Google Gemini,

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Graphiti works best with LLM services that support structured output; other services may cause incorrect schemas and ingestion failures\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Graphiti 是一个用于构建和查询面向 AI 代理的时序上下文图的框架。与静态知识图谱不同，它跟踪事实随时间的变化，维护对源数据的溯源，并支持预设和习得的本体。它持续将用户交互、结构化和非结构化企业数据以及外部信息整合到一个连贯、可查询的图中。

## 核心功能

- 时序事实管理：事实具有有效性窗口；旧事实被失效而非删除。
- 事件与溯源：每个实体和关系都追溯到原始事件。
- 预设与习得本体：通过 Pydantic 模型定义实体和边类型，或让结构从数据中涌现。

## 适用场景

- 构建随每次交互演化的时序知识图谱。
- 表示丰富的结构化上下文，而非扁平文档块。
- 通过混合检索跨时间、语义和关系进行查询。

## 快速开始

- 使用 pip install graphiti\-core 安装。需要 Python 3\.10\+、图数据库（Neo4j、FalkorDB、Amazon Neptune 或 Kuzu）以及 OpenAI API 密钥。参见快速入门示例以了解连接、初始化索引、添加事件和搜索。

## 部署与要求

- Python 3\.10 或更高版本；Neo4j 5\.26 / FalkorDB 1\.1\.2 / Amazon Neptune Database Cluster 或 Neptune Analytics Graph \+ Amazon OpenSearch Serverless collection / Kuzu 0\.11\.2（已弃用）；OpenAI API 密钥（Graphiti 默认使用 OpenAI 进行 LLM 推理和嵌入）。可选：Google Gemini、Anthropic 或 Groq API 密钥（用于替代 LLM 提供商）。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

GraphRAG is a structured, hierarchical approach to Retrieval Augmented Generation\. It extracts a knowledge graph from raw text, builds a community hierarchy, generates summaries for these communities, and leverages these structures for RAG\-based tasks\.

## Key Features

- Extracts entities, relationships, and key claims from TextUnits\.
- Builds a hierarchical community structure using the Leiden technique\.
- Generates bottom\-up summaries of each community and its constituents\.
- Supports Global, Local, DRIFT, and Basic query modes\.
- Provides prompt tuning guidance for fine\-tuning prompts to your data\.
- Offers CLI and Indexer/Query packages for working with the system\.

## Use Cases

- Reasoning over private datasets such as enterprise proprietary research, business documents, or communications\.
- Answering holistic questions over large data collections or singular large documents\.
- Connecting disparate pieces of information through shared attributes to synthesize new insights\.
- Question answering about specific entities by fanning out to their neighbors and associated concepts\.

## Getting Started

- Check out the Get Started guide\.
- Try the command line quickstart\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- GraphRAG is described as a research project that is largely in maintenance mode and will not accept new PRs or implement new features\.
- The provided code is a demonstration and is not an officially supported Microsoft offering\.
- Indexing can be expensive, so users should read the documentation to understand costs and start small\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Grok Build is SpaceXAI's terminal\-based AI coding agent\. It runs as a full\-screen TUI that understands your codebase, edits files, executes shell commands, searches the web, and manages long\-running tasks\. It supports interactive use, headless operation for scripting and CI, and embedding in editors via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP)\. The project is written in Rust and synced periodically from the SpaceXAI monorepo\.

## Key Features

- Full\-screen TUI with mouse interaction; Extensible via plugins, skills, and MCP servers; Understands codebase and edits files; Executes shell commands and searches the web; Manages long\-running tasks; Supports headless mode for scripting/CI and ACP for editor embedding\.

## Use Cases

- Interactive coding assistance in the terminal; Headless automation for scripting and CI pipelines; Embedded in editors via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP)\.

## Getting Started

- Install the released binary via curl \-fsSL https://x\.ai/cli/install\.sh \| bash (macOS/Linux/Git Bash) or irm https://x\.ai/cli/install\.ps1 \| iex (Windows PowerShell), then run grok \-\-version\. Alternatively, build from source with Rust and DotSlash; see the repository for details\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Prebuilt binaries are available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\. Building from source requires Rust, DotSlash, and protoc\. macOS and Linux are supported build hosts; Windows builds are best\-effort and not currently tested\. First launch opens the browser for authentication\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- External contributions are not accepted\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Happy is an open\-source remote control for coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex that run on your own computers\. It lets you start, steer, approve, and review agent sessions from iOS, Android, or the web, then continue the same session in your terminal\. Session data is end\-to\-end encrypted: your code, agent, and encryption keys stay on your devices, and only encrypted session data passes through the Happy backend\. The project is built by a small team and publishes the app, CLI, and server as open source\.

## Key Features

- Mobile access to Claude Code and Codex sessions from iOS, Android, or the web
- Push notifications when an agent needs permission or encounters errors
- Instant switching between phone, desktop, and terminal with a single keypress
- End\-to\-end encryption, with keys held on your own devices and only ciphertext relayed
- Open source app, CLI, and server with no telemetry or tracking
- Realtime voice support alongside the mobile and web clients

## Use Cases

- Checking on a long\-running agent task while away from your desk
- Answering an agent's permission request or question from your phone
- Reviewing diffs and live session output remotely before continuing work
- Starting at your desk and continuing the same session from another device

## Getting Started

- Download the iOS or Android app\.
- Install the CLI on your computer with: npm install \-g happy
- Start your agent through the wrapper: happy claude or happy codex
- Optionally download the native macOS desktop app from its releases page\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- A computer on which your code and coding agent keep running
- Node\.js/npm to install the happy CLI globally via npm install \-g happy
- A paired iOS or Android device, or a web browser, for remote control
- Claude Code or Codex installed to be launched through the happy wrapper

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Session data is end\-to\-end encrypted: the backend stores and relays only opaque ciphertext and never receives the decryption key\.
- The CLI was migrated from the earlier happy\-coder npm package\.
- The project states that it is open source with no telemetry or tracking\.

projects.descriptionZh: Harbor 是由 Terminal-Bench 创作者推出的框架，用于在容器环境中指定沙箱化智能体任务，以评估和优化智能体与语言模型。它支持评估 Claude Code、OpenHands、Codex CLI 等任意智能体，构建和分享基准与环境，通过 Daytona、Modal、LangSmith、Blaxel、Novita Sandbox、Tensorlake 和 Runta 等提供方并行开展数千个环境的实验，并生成用于 RL 优化的 rollout。
projects.content:
## Overview

Harbor is a framework from the creators of Terminal\-Bench for specifying sandboxed agent tasks for evaluation and optimization\. It can evaluate arbitrary agents such as Claude Code, OpenHands, and Codex CLI, build and share benchmarks and environments, run experiments in parallel across thousands of environments, and generate rollouts for RL optimization\.

## Key Features

- Evaluate arbitrary agents like Claude Code, OpenHands, Codex CLI, and more\.
- Build and share your own benchmarks and environments\.
- Conduct experiments in thousands of environments in parallel through providers like Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, Tensorlake, and Runta\.
- Generate rollouts for RL optimization\.
- Serves as the official harness for Terminal\-Bench\-2\.0\.

## Use Cases

- Running benchmarks such as Terminal\-Bench\-2\.0 locally with Docker or on cloud providers\.
- Evaluating arbitrary agents and language models on supported datasets\.
- Exploring third\-party benchmarks like SWE\-Bench and Aider Polyglot\.
- Generating rollouts for RL optimization\.

## Getting Started

- Install Harbor with uv tool install harbor or pip install harbor\.
- Run a benchmark such as: harbor run \-\-dataset terminal\-bench@2\.0 \-\-agent claude\-code \-\-model anthropic/claude\-opus\-4\-1 \-\-n\-concurrent 4\.
- Set ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY before running the Anthropic example\.
- Use harbor run \-\-help to see supported agents and options\.
- Use harbor datasets list to explore supported third\-party benchmarks\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local benchmark runs use Docker\.
- Cloud runs can use providers such as Daytona via the \-\-env flag\.
- Set ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY for Anthropic models and DAYTONA\_API\_KEY for Daytona cloud runs\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Local benchmark runs require Docker\.
- Cloud\-parallel experiments depend on third\-party providers such as Daytona, Modal, LangSmith, Blaxel, Novita Sandbox, Tensorlake, and Runta\.
- The Anthropic example requires an ANTHROPIC\_API\_KEY environment variable\.
- Cloud runs on Daytona require a DAYTONA\_API\_KEY environment variable\.

projects.descriptionZh: 开源基础设施，将 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes 等运行框架作为可插拔的智能体后端运行，让产品通过一个 API 执行任务、获取结果并切换运行框架。
projects.content:
## Overview

HarnessRouter is the execution and runtime layer between a product and supported agent harnesses\. An LLM returns tokens, while a harness gives it a sandbox, tools, and a loop so it returns actual work; HarnessRouter turns existing harnesses such as Codex and Claude Code into plug\-and\-play agent backends\. Applications send a task and receive progress, files, artifacts, final state, and trace through one interface, implemented as the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP) with an OpenAI Responses\-compatible API\. It is available as a self\-hosted Apache 2\.0 Community Edition and as managed HarnessRouter Cloud\.

## Key Features

- One API contract across every supported agent harness, so a product keeps a single integration as harnesses are added
- Implements the Unified Harness Protocol (UHP), an open standard, and exposes an OpenAI Responses\-compatible API
- Handles the agent execution lifecycle: sessions, tools, files, artifacts, streaming progress, cancellation, errors, resume, and traces
- Community Edition is Apache 2\.0 and runs on infrastructure you control with your own keys, state, and files
- Cloud provisions and operates one isolated sandbox per task, scaling workloads without infrastructure work
- Harness × model routing lets teams benchmark combinations by quality, latency, and cost before changing production traffic

## Use Cases

- Build a new agent product on top of Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, or another supported harness
- Migrate an existing managed agent backend to HarnessRouter
- Run a task across harnesses and compare time, cost, and accuracy in the Harness Arena
- Start from open\-source starter kits such as Slides, Sheets, Dashboards, and Videos

## Getting Started

- Run the container: docker run \-d \-\-name harnessrouter \-p 127\.0\.0\.1:3000:3000 \-v harnessrouter:/data harnessrouter/harnessrouter
- Wait for the first launch by following docker logs until the logs show "\[harnessrouter\] ready on :3000"
- Open http://localhost:3000 and sign in with username harnessrouter and password harnessrouter
- Connect a model provider under Bring Your Own Key and add its API key so its supported models become available
- Open Agent harnesses, choose a harness, select New task, pick a model, and follow live progress and produced files

## Deployment & Requirements

- Docker with about 4 GB of disk and a provider API key; no HarnessRouter account or bundled trial key is required for Community Edition
- Do not add \-\-user: the entrypoint and Runner need root to manage per\-session users, while the Console and Gateway run unprivileged and agent processes run as their session's user
- Keep the loopback binding while using the initial credentials
- Use a named volume such as harnessrouter:/data to preserve the database, files, installed harness CLIs, and workspaces between restarts

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Migrating an existing agent workflow requires adopting the API or UHP contract, mapping existing behavior to it, and verifying product\-specific behavior on your side\.
- Harness capabilities differ, so combinations should be benchmarked before production traffic is switched\.
- Model access depends on the third\-party provider and the credentials you choose to supply\.
- Long exact values such as tokens should be attached as files or passed through the harness environment rather than written into the prompt\.

## 项目简介

HarnessRouter 是产品与受支持智能体运行框架之间的执行和运行时层。LLM 只返回 token，而运行框架为它提供沙箱、工具和循环，使其真正完成工作；HarnessRouter 将 Codex、Claude Code 等现有运行框架变成即插即用的智能体后端。应用通过一个接口发送任务，并接收进度、文件、产物、最终状态和追踪信息，该接口以统一运行框架协议（UHP）实现，并提供兼容 OpenAI Responses 的 API。它既有自托管的 Apache 2\.0 社区版，也有托管的 HarnessRouter Cloud。

## 核心功能

- 所有受支持智能体运行框架共用一套 API 契约，因此产品在新增运行框架时仍只需维护一个集成。实现统一运行框架协议（UHP）这一开放标准，并暴露兼容 OpenAI Responses 的 API。处理智能体执行生命周期：会话、工具、文件、产物、流式进度、取消、错误、恢复和追踪。社区版采用 Apache 2\.0，运行在你自己控制的基础设施上，使用你自己的密钥、状态和文件。Cloud 为每个任务预置并运行一个隔离沙箱，无需基础设施运维即可扩展工作负载。运行框架 × 模型路由让团队在切换生产流量前按质量、延迟和成本对组合进行基准测试。

## 适用场景

- 在 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes 或其他受支持运行框架之上构建新的智能体产品。将现有托管智能体后端迁移到 HarnessRouter。在 Harness Arena 中跨运行框架运行同一任务，比较时间、成本和准确性。从 Slides、Sheets、Dashboards、Videos 等开源入门套件开始。

## 快速开始

- 运行容器：docker run \-d \-\-name harnessrouter \-p 127\.0\.0\.1:3000:3000 \-v harnessrouter:/data harnessrouter/harnessrouter。通过跟踪 docker logs 等待首次启动，直到日志显示 \[harnessrouter\] ready on :3000。打开 http://localhost:3000，使用用户名 harnessrouter 和密码 harnessrouter 登录。在 Bring Your Own Key 下连接模型提供商并添加其 API

## 部署与要求

- 需要 Docker、约 4 GB 磁盘和提供商 API 密钥；社区版不需要 HarnessRouter 账户或捆绑试用密钥。不要添加 \-\-user：入口点和 Runner 需要 root 来管理每会话用户，而 Console 和 Gateway 以非特权运行，智能体进程以其会话用户身份运行。使用初始凭据时保持回环绑定。使用 harnessrouter:/data 这样的命名卷，在重启之间保留数据库、文件、已安装的运行框架 CLI 和工作区。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: Headroom is a context optimization layer for LLM applications. It compresses tool outputs, database results, file reads, logs, RAG results, and API responses before they reach the model, reducing tokens while keeping the same answers.
projects.descriptionZh: Headroom 是面向 LLM 应用的上下文优化层，可在工具输出、数据库结果、文件读取、日志、RAG 检索结果和 API 响应到达模型前进行压缩，在保持回答质量的同时减少 token；可作为库、代理或 MCP 服务器使用，压缩在本地运行并支持可逆恢复。
projects.content:
## Overview

Headroom is a context optimization layer for LLM applications\. It compresses tool outputs, database results, file reads, RAG retrievals, API responses, logs, and conversation history before they reach the model, so the model sees less noise\. Compression runs locally, and compressed content is reversible through a local CCR store\.

## Key Features

- Reversible compression (CCR) stores originals locally and gives the model a headroom\_retrieve tool for full details\.
- Smart content detection routes JSON, source code, logs, text, diffs, and HTML to the best compressor with zero configuration\.
- SmartCrusher preserves errors, anomalies, and first and last boundaries in JSON tool outputs through statistical analysis\.
- Works as a transparent proxy, Python or TypeScript library, agent wrapper, or MCP server\.
- Cache optimization stabilizes prefixes to help provider KV caches hit and tracks frozen messages to preserve cache read discounts\.
- Persistent memory uses hierarchical user, session, agent, and turn scopes with SQLite and HNSW backends\.

## Use Cases

- Reduce tokens from tool outputs, logs, database reads, RAG results, file reads, and API responses before sending them to an LLM\.
- Preserve critical errors during SRE incident debugging while compressing large, mostly routine tool output\.
- Compress context during codebase exploration and GitHub issue triage\.
- Share compressed context between agents across frameworks with SharedContext\.

## Getting Started

- Install the Python package with uv tool install \-\-python 3\.13 "headroom\-ai\[all\]" or pip install "headroom\-ai\[all\]"; install the TypeScript SDK with npm install headroom\-ai\.
- Choose a mode: headroom deploy for turnkey local deployment, headroom wrap claude to wrap a coding agent, headroom proxy \-\-port 8787 for a drop\-in proxy, or use the inline Python library\.
- Run headroom doctor to confirm routing works, then headroom perf or headroom dashboard to view savings\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Compression runs locally on your machine; no prompt or file content is sent anywhere to be compressed\.
- The headroom CLI ships only in the PyPI package; the npm headroom\-ai package is the TypeScript SDK and provides no headroom command\.
- Docker\-native installation is documented as an install option\.
- A local proxy can be run on port 8787\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Compression savings depend on how repetitive the input is, so benchmark figures should be treated as workload\-specific\.
- Source code compression is optional and off by default\.
- Prose and already\-dense outputs may compress very little\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Helicone is an AI Gateway and LLM observability platform for AI engineers\. It routes, debugs, and analyzes AI applications, offering one\-line integration to log requests from providers and frameworks\. It supports monitoring, evaluation, experimentation, prompt management, and self\-hosting\.

## Key Features

- AI Gateway: access 100\+ AI models with one API key through the OpenAI API, with intelligent routing and automatic fallbacks\.
- Quick integration: one line of code logs requests from OpenAI, Anthropic, LangChain, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, and more\.
- Observability: inspect and debug traces and sessions for agents, chatbots, document processing pipelines, and more\.
- Analytics: track cost, latency, quality, and more, and export to PostHog in one line for custom dashboards\.
- Prompt management: version prompts using production data and deploy prompts through the AI Gateway without code changes\.
- Playground and fine\-tuning: rapidly test and iterate on prompts, sessions, and traces, and fine\-tune with OpenPipe or Autonomi\.

## Use Cases

- Debugging and monitoring agents, chatbots, and document processing pipelines\.
- Tracking cost, latency, and quality across AI applications\.
- Testing and iterating on prompts, sessions, and traces in a playground\.
- Versioning and deploying prompts using production data\.

## Getting Started

- Get an API key by signing up and add credits\.
- Update the baseURL in your code to the Helicone AI Gateway and add your API key\.
- Use a supported model such as gpt\-4o\-mini, claude\-sonnet\-4, or gemini\-2\.0\-flash, or any model from the Helicone models list\.
- View your logs in the Helicone dashboard and access 100\+ models through one API\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Helicone can be used through its hosted service or self\-hosted\.
- For self\-hosting, use the Docker Compose setup; clone the repository, enter the docker directory, copy \.env\.example to \.env, and start services with the compose script\.
- For Enterprise workloads, a production\-ready Helm chart is available by contacting enterprise@helicone\.ai\.
- Manual deployment is not recommended; Docker or Helm should be used\.
- Helicone comprises Web, Worker, Jawn, Supabase, ClickHouse, and Minio services\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Manual deployment is discouraged; Docker or Helm are the recommended self\-hosting paths\.
- The listed integrations may be outdated, so users should check current documentation for provider or framework support\.
- The production\-ready Helm chart for Enterprise workloads requires contacting Helicone for access\.
- Helicone states SOC 2 and GDPR compliance for enterprise readiness\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Hermes Agent is a self\-improving AI agent built by Nous Research\. It features a built\-in learning loop that creates skills from experience, improves them during use, and builds a deepening model of the user across sessions\. It runs on various infrastructures and integrates with multiple messaging platforms\.

## Key Features

- Real terminal interface with full TUI, multiline editing, slash\-command autocomplete, and streaming tool output\.
- Lives where you do: Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Signal, and CLI from a single gateway process\.
- Closed learning loop: agent\-curated memory, autonomous skill creation, self\-improving skills, FTS5 session search, and Honcho dialectic user modeling\.
- Scheduled automations with built\-in cron scheduler and delivery to any platform\.
- Delegates and parallelizes: spawn isolated subagents for parallel workstreams and write Python scripts that call tools via RPC\.
- Runs anywhere: seven terminal backends including local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox\.

## Use Cases

- Scheduled tasks like daily reports, nightly backups, and weekly audits in natural language\.
- Research: batch trajectory generation and trajectory compression for training tool\-calling models\.
- Personal assistant accessible from messaging platforms while running on a cloud VM\.

## Getting Started

- Install with curl \-fsSL https://hermes\-agent\.nousresearch\.com/install\.sh \| bash on Linux/macOS/WSL2, or use the PowerShell one\-liner for Windows\. Then run 'hermes' to start chatting\. Use 'hermes model' to choose your LLM provider and 'hermes setup' for full configuration\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs on a $5 VPS, GPU cluster, or serverless infrastructure\. Supports terminal backends: local, Docker, SSH, Singularity, Modal, Daytona, and Vercel Sandbox\. Native Windows and WSL2 supported\. Android/Termux via APT repository\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows Defender or antivirus may flag uv\.exe as malware; this is a false positive\.

projects.content:
## Overview

HQBase is an open\-source shared email workspace for teams that runs in the customer's Cloudflare account\. It provides shared mailboxes, team access controls, multi\-domain setup, drafts, audit history, and an OAuth\-protected remote MCP server for AI clients\. Mail and credentials remain in infrastructure the customer controls\.

## Key Features

- Shared mailboxes with team access controls for managing permissions by mailbox\.
- Multiple domains and mailboxes in one workspace, with drafts and audit history\.
- Email via MCP: AI clients connect over OAuth to search, draft, reply, and send\.
- A desktop and mobile PWA client with self\-hosted push notifications for access anywhere\.
- Runs in the customer's Cloudflare account, so the Worker, D1 mail index, and R2 attachments stay theirs\.
- Installation, update, backup, and recovery operations with release verification and rollback support\.

## Use Cases

- Teams that need shared mailboxes while keeping mail and credentials in infrastructure they control\.
- Organizations managing multiple domains and team mailboxes from one workspace\.
- Teams that want AI clients to search, draft, reply, and send email through an OAuth\-protected MCP server\.
- Users who need desktop and mobile access to shared team email through a PWA\.

## Getting Started

- Deploy HQBase to Cloudflare or read the product documentation\. For local development, run pnpm install, pnpm db:migrate:local, pnpm db:seed:local, and pnpm dev\. Before the optional seed command, add BETTER\_AUTH\_SECRET and HQBASE\_LOCAL\_SEED\_PASSWORD with 8 to 128 characters to

## Deployment & Requirements

- Enable Workers Paid, activate the R2 subscription, and have an active domain using Cloudflare DNS\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

## 项目简介

HQBase 是面向团队的开源共享邮箱工作区，运行在客户自己的 Cloudflare 账户中。它提供共享邮箱、团队访问控制、多域名设置、草稿、审计历史，以及面向 AI 客户端的 OAuth 保护远程 MCP 服务器。邮件和凭据保留在客户控制的基础设施中。

## 核心功能

- 共享邮箱与团队访问控制，可按邮箱管理权限；在一个工作区中支持多个域名和邮箱，并包含草稿与审计历史；通过 MCP 收发邮件，AI 客户端通过 OAuth 连接，可搜索、起草、回复和发送；桌面和移动端 PWA 客户端，支持自托管推送通知，随时随地访问；运行在客户自己的 Cloudflare 账户中，Worker、D1 邮件索引和 R2 附件都归客户所有；安装、更新、备份和恢复操作，支持发布验证与回滚。

## 适用场景

- 需要共享邮箱同时将邮件和凭据保留在自己控制的基础设施中的团队；需要在一个工作区中管理多个域名和团队邮箱的组织；希望 AI 客户端通过 OAuth 保护的 MCP 服务器搜索、起草、回复和发送电子邮件的团队；需要通过 PWA 在桌面和移动端访问共享团队邮箱的用户。

## 快速开始

- 将 HQBase 部署到 Cloudflare，或阅读产品文档。本地开发时运行 pnpm install、pnpm db:migrate:local、pnpm db:seed:local 和 pnpm dev。在执行可选的种子命令前，将 BETTER\_AUTH\_SECRET 和 8 到 128 个字符的 HQBASE\_LOCAL\_SEED\_PASSWORD 添加到 \.dev\.vars。

## 部署与要求

- 启用 Workers Paid，激活 R2 订阅，并拥有一个使用 Cloudflare DNS 的有效域名。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：AGPL\-3\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

Hunyuan3D is the industry's first all\-in\-one AI creation platform for 3D content, based on the Hunyuan3D 2\.5 large model\. It offers text\-to\-3D, image\-to\-3D, 3D animation generation, and texture generation, and supports sketch\-to\-3D and 3D character generation, with advantages in low\-poly model generation\. The platform targets high\-resolution textured 3D asset generation, helping users create 3D content\.

## Key Features

- Supports text\-to\-3D, image\-to\-3D, 3D animation generation, and texture generation\. Supports sketch\-to\-3D and 3D character generation\. Has advantages in low\-poly model generation\. Uses a two\-stage generation pipeline: first create a bare mesh, then synthesize a texture map\.

## Use Cases

- Quickly create 3D assets from text or images\. Generate or enhance textures for existing or handcrafted 3D meshes\. Call generation capabilities in 3D workflows via Gradio app, API server, or Blender addon\. Allow professional and amateur users to efficiently manipulate or even

## Getting Started

- Supported usage via code, Gradio app, API server, Blender addon, or official website\. Install PyTorch following the official guide, then install requirements\.txt and the project package\. For texture generation, also install custom\_rasterizer and differentiable\_renderer

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports Macos, Windows, Linux\. Shape generation requires 6 GB VRAM, and shape plus texture generation requires 16 GB VRAM in total\. Requires PyTorch and project dependencies; texture features also require additional rendering components\.

projects.name: Hy-Memory
projects.tagline: Dual-system cognitive memory for self-evolving LLM agents.
projects.taglineZh: 面向自演化 LLM 智能体的双系统认知记忆引擎。
projects.description: Production-grade dual-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK for self-evolving LLM agents, with dedicated Chat, Working, and Coding memory pipelines, plus MemHub for local-first cross-application recall.
projects.descriptionZh: 生产级双系统认知记忆引擎与 Python SDK，面向自演化 LLM 智能体，提供 Chat、Working 与 Coding 专用记忆流水线，并包含 MemHub 以支持本地优先的跨应用记忆召回。
projects.content:
## Overview

Hy Memory is a production\-grade dual\-system cognitive memory engine and Python SDK (hy\-memory) for self\-evolving LLM agents\. It provides specialized memory pipelines across three task scenes: hierarchical long\-term cognitive memory for Chat, two\-layer fact and reusable\-experience memory for Working, and version\-evolution diff\-chain tracking for Coding\. Built on top of Hy Memory, MemHub is a local\-first desktop and CLI product that unifies conversation history and coding traces from user\-authorized AI applications into a single managed runtime and local data directory, enabling governed cross\-application memory recall\.

## Key Features

- Dual\-process cognitive memory architecture: personal memory is organized into an 8\-layer hierarchy spanning raw dialogues, atomic facts, summaries, schemas, and prospective intentions, with conflict reconciliation and cross\-domain schema induction\.
- Three memory scenes selected through a scene router: chat for hierarchical memory L0\-L7, working for two\-layer session facts plus reusable experiences, and coding for the same two\-layer memory plus a code version\-evolution diff chain\.
- Working memory records exactly one fact per session describing the task, approach, and result, alongside zero or more reusable experiences that must pass a value threshold\.
- Coding memory reuses the working pipeline but records exact code coordinates instead of pasting code, stores data in isolated cv collections, and attaches every revision of touched code through a diff chain built with zero LLM calls\.
- Three operating modes: lite for raw\-only embedding writes and searches with no LLM calls, pro adding LLM extraction and reconciliation, and ultra adding System 2 schema induction and a cross\-domain sweeper triggered by evolve()\.
- Python SDK with pluggable storage backends: ChromaDB, Qdrant, or FAISS vector stores, Kuzu or Neo4j graph stores, and local SQLite metadata, plus automatic scene routing, source isolation, and CRUD and evolution APIs\.

## Use Cases

- Building long\-term personal memory for chat assistants, including preference recall, profile abstraction, summaries, and prospective intentions with expiry\.
- Supporting productivity work such as documents, spreadsheets, research, financial analysis, content creation, and computer operation by remembering session facts and reusing proven approaches\.
- Assisting software engineering tasks like coding, debugging, testing, builds, APIs/SDKs, scripts, and SQL, while tracking how each piece of code changed across versions\.
- Unifying conversation history and coding traces from user\-authorized AI applications such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and Qwen Code into a single governed local runtime via MemHub\.

## Getting Started

- Install the SDK from PyPI with pip install hy\-memory==2\.0\.2 for the core package including ChromaDB and Kuzu, or select extras such as \[qdrant\], \[faiss\], \[graph\], \[mysql\], \[rerank\], or \[all\]\. Configuration requires only an LLM and an embedding endpoint, and any OpenAI\-compatible

## Deployment & Requirements

- An LLM endpoint and an embedding endpoint are required; any OpenAI\-compatible service works, and the OpenAI defaults can be used with a single key\.
- Vector stores supported are ChromaDB (default), Qdrant, and FAISS; graph stores used in ultra mode are Kuzu (default) and Neo4j\.
- Working and Coding metadata is stored in local SQLite\.
- Graph usage in pro mode is optional and controlled by MEMORY\_ENABLE\_GRAPH, which is off by default\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The SDK depends on external LLM and embedding services, so an OpenAI\-compatible endpoint and credentials must be supplied\.
- Working and Coding scene memory only takes effect in pro or ultra mode and requires writes to carry a tool\-call trace\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Hy Memory 是面向自演化 LLM 智能体的生产级双系统认知记忆引擎和 Python SDK（hy\-memory）。它针对三类任务场景提供专用记忆流水线：Chat 的层级式长期认知记忆、Working 的两层事实与可复用经验记忆，以及 Coding 的版本演化差分链追踪。基于 Hy Memory 构建的 MemHub 是一款本地优先的桌面与 CLI 产品，将用户授权 AI 应用中的对话历史和编码轨迹统一到单个受管运行时和本地数据目录中，实现受治理的跨应用记忆召回。

## 核心功能

- Hy Memory 采用双过程认知记忆架构，将个人记忆组织为覆盖原始对话、原子事实、摘要、图式和前瞻意图的 8 层层级，并支持冲突调和与跨域图式归纳。它通过场景路由器选择三种记忆场景：chat 对应 L0\-L7 层级记忆，working 对应两层会话事实与可复用经验，coding 在相同两层记忆之上增加代码版本演化差分链。Working 记忆每次会话精确记录一条描述任务、方法和结果的事实，并附带零条或多条必须通过价值阈值的可复用经验。Coding 记忆复用 working 流水线，但记录精确代码坐标而非粘贴代码，数据存放在隔离的 cv 集合中，并通过零

## 适用场景

- Hy Memory 可用于为聊天助手构建长期个人记忆，包括偏好召回、画像抽象、摘要以及带过期时间的前瞻意图。它可支持文档、电子表格、研究、财务分析、内容创作和计算机操作等生产力工作，通过记住会话事实并复用已验证的方法来提升效率。它可协助编码、调试、测试、构建、API/SDK、脚本和 SQL 等软件工程任务，同时追踪每段代码在不同版本间的变化。通过 MemHub，它还能将用户授权的 AI 应用（如 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、OpenCode 和 Qwen Code）中的对话历史和编码轨迹统一到单个受治理的本地运行时中。

## 快速开始

- 安装核心包可使用 pip install hy\-memory==2\.0\.2，其中包含 ChromaDB 和 Kuzu；也可选择附加组件，如 \[qdrant\]、\[faiss\]、\[graph\]、\[mysql\]、\[rerank\] 或 \[all\]。配置仅需 LLM 和嵌入端点，任何 OpenAI 兼容服务均可使用，可设置 MEMORY\_LLM\_API\_KEY、MEMORY\_LLM\_BASE\_URL、MEMORY\_LLM\_MODEL、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_API\_KEY、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_BASE\_URL、MEMORY\_EMBEDDER\_M

## 部署与要求

- 部署 Hy Memory 需要 LLM 端点和嵌入端点，任何 OpenAI 兼容服务均可使用，也可使用 OpenAI 默认值并仅提供一个密钥。向量存储支持 ChromaDB（默认）、Qdrant 和 FAISS；ultra 模式使用的图存储支持 Kuzu（默认）和 Neo4j。Working 与 Coding 元数据存储在本地 SQLite 中。pro 模式下图的使用是可选的，由 MEMORY\_ENABLE\_GRAPH 控制，默认关闭；ultra 模式下图存储始终开启。lite 模式不使用图数据库。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Other。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.content:
## Overview

HyperFrames is an open\-source framework and video editor built for agents\. It turns HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos that can be authored locally with the CLI, through AI coding agents with skills, or through hosted authoring workflows\. The project also provides a desktop Studio app, a catalog of reusable blocks and components, and packages for rendering, previewing, and editing compositions\.

## Key Features

- HTML\-native compositions use HTML files with data attributes for timing, tracks, and media instead of a proprietary timeline format\.
- Agent skills teach coding agents the HyperFrames production loop: plan the video, write valid HTML, wire seekable animations, add media, lint, preview, and render\.
- Deterministic rendering seeks each frame in headless Chrome and encodes the result with FFmpeg, so the same input produces the same video\.
- Adapter\-based animation supports GSAP, CSS animations, Lottie, Three\.js, Anime\.js, WAAPI, or a custom runtime\.
- CLI workflows include init, lint, check, snapshot, preview, render, publish, and doctor commands, plus cloud and AWS Lambda rendering paths\.
- A desktop Studio app and catalog provide previewing, editing, and reusable blocks or components for transitions, overlays, captions, charts, maps, and effects\.

## Use Cases

- Product launch videos and feature announcements\.
- PR walkthroughs with animated code diffs, narration, and captions\.
- Data visualizations, chart races, and map animations\.
- Social videos with kinetic captions, overlays, and music\.

## Getting Started

- With an AI coding agent, install the versioned plugin using claude plugin marketplace add heygen\-com/hyperframes and claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes, or use npx skills add heygen\-com/hyperframes for standalone skills\. Manually with the CLI, run npx hyperframes init

## Deployment & Requirements

- CLI use requires Node\.js 22\+ and FFmpeg\. Desktop builds are available for macOS and Linux, while Windows and Windows ARM64 are coming soon\. Enterprise deployment is available\. AWS Lambda rendering is available for distributed render stacks, and rendering can run locally or in

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
