projects.content:
## Overview

Ruflo is an agent meta\-harness for Claude Code and Codex\. It adds a coordination layer around coding agents, providing specialized agents, swarm coordination, self\-learning memory, federation, and vector RAG integration\. The project is part of the Cognitum One / RuvNet ecosystem\.

## Key Features

- 100\+ specialized agents for coding, testing, security, docs, and architecture\.
- Swarm coordination with hierarchical, mesh, and adaptive topologies and consensus\.
- Self\-learning via SONA neural patterns, ReasoningBank, and trajectory learning\.
- Vector memory with HNSW\-indexed AgentDB and measured performance versus brute force\.
- Federation for agents across machines and organizations to discover, authenticate, and exchange work securely\.
- Plugin marketplace with native Claude Code plugins and npm packages\.

## Use Cases

- Build AI coding teams that plan, remember, test, and improve across sessions\.
- Coordinate autonomous multi\-step workflows and swarms for software development\.
- Give agents persistent memory and RAG context over repositories and project knowledge\.
- Run secure multi\-machine agent collaboration through federation\.

## Getting Started

- In Claude Code, add the marketplace with /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo, then install ruflo\-core@ruflo, ruflo\-console@ruflo, and ruflo\-mods@ruflo\.
- For Codex or another MCP\-enabled tool, run npx ruflo@latest init wizard in your project terminal\.
- To configure a local stdio MCP server, use command npx and arguments \-y, ruflo@latest, mcp start\.
- Install globally with npm install \-g ruflo@latest, or run npx ruflo@latest init for non\-interactive setup\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Claude Code plugin path requires Claude Code 2\.1\.287 or later\.
- CLI path can run on macOS, Linux, WSL, Git\-Bash, Windows PowerShell, and cmd\.
- For local stdio MCP clients, configure command npx and arguments \-y ruflo@latest mcp start\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Mods run with the user's account permissions and are not sandboxed, so code should be reviewed before installation\.
- Performance data is derived from simulations and prototypes and may not reflect final production hardware\.
- Specifications, figures, and statements on the site are subject to change and are not guaranteed\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Scientific Agent Skills is an open library of scientific procedures for AI agents, created by K\-Dense\. The current repository lists 177 skills; the associated paper describes 163 skills across 16 areas of practice\. Each skill is a directory built around a versioned, human\-readable SKILL\.md instruction file, often with reference material and runnable scripts\. The collection follows the open Agent Skills standard and is also packaged as an Agent Plugins package\.

## Key Features

- 177 scientific and research skills spanning biology, chemistry, medicine, physics, engineering, Earth science, data analysis, and scientific communication\.
- Each skill has a SKILL\.md with purpose, workflow, and version metadata, plus optional code examples, reference documentation, executable helpers, or templates\.
- Documents 100\+ scientific and financial databases, including a Database Lookup skill covering 80 sources such as PubChem, ChEMBL, UniProt, COSMIC, ClinicalTrials\.gov, FRED, and USPTO\.
- Provides 70\+ optimized Python package skills with version\-aware workflows for packages such as RDKit, Scanpy, scikit\-learn, pydicom, QuTiP, GeoPandas, pymatgen, and Qiskit\.
- Follows the Agent Skills standard and works with hosts such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Google Antigravity; also available as an Agent Plugins package\.
- Includes skills for scientific integration platforms such as Benchling, DNAnexus, LatchBio, OMERO, Protocols\.io, Open Notebook, Ginkgo Cloud Lab, LabArchives, and Opentrons\.

## Use Cases

- Guiding AI agents through field\-accepted analysis procedures, validation checks, and provenance requirements in scientific workflows\.
- Working with specialized scientific libraries, databases, and tools across genomics, cheminformatics, medical imaging, and other research domains\.
- Supporting research tasks such as literature review, evidence\-traceable scientific writing, grant writing, and confidential peer review assistance\.
- Packaging reusable scientific skills for compatible agent hosts through the Agent Skills and Agent Plugins standards\.

## Getting Started

- Install with the standards\-based installer by running npx skills add K\-Dense\-AI/scientific\-agent\-skills for supported hosts\.
- With GitHub CLI v2\.90\.0 or later, run gh skill install K\-Dense\-AI/scientific\-agent\-skills; optionally target a host with \-\-agent cursor, \-\-agent claude\-code, \-\-agent codex, or \-\-agent gemini\.
- Browse the illustrated skill guides, skill categories, or complete catalog to choose skills relevant to your work\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The npx installer is described for supported Agent Skills hosts including current versions of Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex, Gemini CLI, Google Antigravity, and Cursor\.
- GitHub CLI installation requires GitHub CLI v2\.90\.0 or later\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The associated paper reports no task\-level evaluation and no host selection rate, so it does not provide task\-level performance evidence\.
- The paper warns that 29 of 46 documented workflows would exceed the token window if every reference file were loaded\.
- Each skill records compatibility requirements and validation scope, and the source advises checking those details before reusing an older workflow because test coverage differs\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Screenshot to Code is an open\-source project and hosted product that uses AI to turn screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and screen recordings into clean, functional code\. It supports multiple frontend stacks and lets users run locally or use the hosted app\.

## Key Features

- Convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and screen recordings into clean, functional code using AI\.
- Supported stacks: HTML \+ Tailwind, HTML \+ CSS, React \+ Tailwind, Vue \+ Tailwind, Bootstrap, and Ionic \+ Tailwind\.
- Default AI models include Gemini 3 Flash Preview, Gemini 3\.1 Pro Preview, GPT\-5\.5, GPT\-5\.4 Mini, Claude Opus 4\.6, Claude Opus 4\.8, and z\-image\-turbo via Replicate\.
- Supports turning a screen recording of a website in action into a functional prototype\.
- With multiple provider keys, the app can compare models and automatically pick a stronger mix of models per variant\.
- Optional screenshot preview lets the agent render generated pages in a headless browser and visually check its work\.

## Use Cases

- Converting a screenshot into clean HTML, Tailwind, React, Vue, or other supported code\.
- Turning Figma designs or mockups into functional frontend code\.
- Creating a functional prototype from a screen recording of a website in action\.
- Comparing multiple AI model providers per generation when multiple API keys are configured\.

## Getting Started

- Use the hosted app for the fastest way to try Screenshot to Code with no local setup\.
- Run locally by setting up the React/Vite frontend and FastAPI backend; local operation requires API keys\.
- Backend setup uses Poetry: install dependencies, configure \.env with model provider keys, install Chromium through Playwright, activate the Poetry environment, and run uvicorn main:app \-\-reload \-\-port 7001\.
- Frontend setup uses pnpm: run pnpm install and pnpm dev\.
- Docker setup: from the root directory, create \.env with OPENAI\_API\_KEY and run docker\-compose up \-d \-\-build\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Running locally requires API keys and a backend/frontend setup\. The app has a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend\.
- You need at least one model provider key among OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini; Gemini and Replicate are strongly recommended for the best quality\.
- Replicate must be configured in backend/\.env as REPLICATE\_API\_KEY; without it, edit\_images and remove\_backgrounds are unavailable\.
- Optional screenshot preview requires Chromium installed via Playwright or automatically in the Docker image; if Chromium is missing, the app skips the tool\.
- Docker deployment requires Docker installed and a \.env file with OPENAI\_API\_KEY; docker\-compose up \-d \-\-build starts the app\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Operational caution: Optional screenshot preview depends on Chromium; if Chromium is missing, the app skips the tool\.
- Operational caution: Running with Ollama open\-source models is not recommended due to poor\-quality results\.
- Operational caution: The Docker setup cannot be used for development because file changes won't trigger a rebuild\.

projects.content:
## Overview

SeeCode is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and other Agent Skills hosts\. It converts a short JSON spec into editorial\-quality diagrams that can be explored in a self\-contained HTML file or exported for documents, presentations and social media\.

## Key Features

- Turns a short JSON spec into animated, explorable diagrams for Claude and other coding agents\.
- Supports 45 diagram types plus 15 variants, each with its own animation and an option to be fully static\.
- Interactive HTML diagrams include hover trace, click focus, route playback, lenses, step\-through presentation, search, pan and zoom, an overview map and shareable view links\.
- Exports diagrams as interactive HTML, SVG, PNG, JPEG, GIF and MP4; the in\-page Export menu works in the browser without installing extra tools\.
- Redraws existing diagrams and data from Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw\.io, Excalidraw, Structurizr, BPMN, SQL, Prisma, DBML, OpenAPI, CSV, TSV and JSON\.
- The agent writes 30 to 150 lines of JSON instead of SVG, while SeeCode renderers handle layout, edge routing, label placement, typography, accessibility and motion\.

## Use Cases

- Explain software architecture, deployment, dependencies, data models, flows, sequences, state machines and other technical systems\.
- Produce diagrams for READMEs, docs sites, Notion, Confluence, PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides, Slack, social posts and talks\.
- Import and redraw existing Mermaid, Graphviz, PlantUML, D2, draw\.io, Excalidraw, Structurizr, BPMN, SQL, Prisma, DBML, OpenAPI or data files at a requested level of detail\.
- Draw non\-code explanatory visuals such as leave timelines, monthly spending Sankey diagrams, rental communication sequences or job\-search state diagrams, with labels in any language\.

## Getting Started

- For Claude Code, run /plugin marketplace add Aryanutkarsh/seecode, then /plugin install seecode@seecode\.
- For Cursor, Codex, OpenCode and other Agent Skills hosts, run npx skills add Aryanutkarsh/seecode \-g\.
- Then ask the agent in plain language to use SeeCode to show a flow or system, and continue with requests such as highlighting a path, making it dark or exporting it for slides\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Node 20 or later\.
- The diagram's own Export menu can create PNG, JPEG, SVG, GIF and MP4 in the browser with nothing installed\.
- From the command line, SVG needs only Node; other export formats use Chrome or Edge already installed on the machine\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Running SeeCode requires Node 20 or later\.
- In Claude\.ai or Claude Desktop, the sandbox has no browser, so image and video files must be produced through the diagram's own Export menu\.
- Command\-line exports have external runtime dependencies: SVG requires Node, while other formats require Chrome or Edge\.
- SeeCode should be skipped when a reader would not learn more from the picture than from a good paragraph\.

## Overview

SEO Skills is an open\-source collection of agent skills for SEO, copywriting and product work\. Each skill is one markdown file that can be installed in Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, or pasted into ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Grok\. It includes SEO autopilot, title tags, blog refreshes, backlinks, customer journeys, video transcripts and copywriting\.

## Key Features

- Open\-source agent skills for SEO, copywriting and product work, with each skill as one markdown file\.
- Each skill is a folder with a SKILL\.md that follows the Agent Skills spec\.
- SEO skills include seo\-autopilot, blitz\-seo, seo\-title\-optimization, blog\-refresher and linkdr\.
- Content, marketing and copywriting skills include intro, scribiz, customer\-journey, diff\-marketing, blitz\-copy and understand\-customers\.
- Code and product skills include eval and extension\-store\-assets\.
- Skills can be installed in Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, or pasted into ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Grok\.

## Use Cases

- Run daily SEO checks, fix title tags, refresh posts that slipped, buy backlinks, map search intent, and write the copy that ranks\.
- Turn videos or audio into transcripts, SRT or VTT subtitles, summaries, chapters, blog posts, show notes or social posts with Scribiz\.
- Generate customer\-focused marketing content from recent git changes, commits, merged pull requests and shipped features\.
- Create browser extension branding, Chrome Web Store assets, app icon concepts, store descriptions, or AI prompt evaluation benchmarks\.

## Getting Started

- Install one skill with npx skills add Illyism/seo\-skills \-\-skill seo\-autopilot\.
- Install all skills with npx skills add Illyism/seo\-skills\.
- List available skills with npx skills add Illyism/seo\-skills \-\-list\.
- Use the skills in Cursor, Claude Code or Codex, or paste them into ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or Grok\.

## Before You Adopt

- No recognizable license was detected; verify permission to use, modify, and distribute the project before adoption\.
- The LinkDR skill depends on a managed backlink service and requires fetching its SKILL\.md before quoting prices\.
- The extension\-store\-assets skill relies on OpenRouter gpt\-image\-2 through lib/blog\-image\-generator\.
- The scribiz skill depends on Scribiz for transcripts, subtitles, summaries and chapters\.
- The seo\-autopilot skill runs on a daily schedule and keeps state in a seo/ folder in the repository\.

projects.description: SGLang is a high-performance serving framework for large language and multimodal models, designed for fast, scalable inference across diverse models and hardware.
projects.descriptionZh: SGLang 是面向大语言模型与多模态模型的高性能服务框架，旨在为多种模型和硬件平台提供快速、可扩展的推理。
projects.content:
## Overview

SGLang is a high\-performance serving framework for large language and multimodal models\. It provides production\-grade inference for large\-scale deployments, from a single GPU to distributed clusters, and supports a wide range of open models and hardware platforms\.

## Key Features

- Production\-grade inference built for large\-scale deployments with reliable, low\-latency, high\-throughput serving from a single GPU to distributed clusters\.
- Model and hardware flexibility across a wide range of open models, including LLMs and diffusion models, and diverse hardware platforms\.
- Advanced optimizations including disaggregated prefill/decode, speculative decoding, parallelisms, a zero\-overhead scheduler, and optimized GPU kernels\.
- OpenAI\-compatible API endpoints for querying served models\.
- Support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, CPU servers, TPU, Ascend NPUs, and XPU\.

## Use Cases

- Large\-scale production inference for large language and multimodal models\.
- Serving open models across single\-GPU and distributed\-cluster deployments\.
- Running diffusion models and other supported open models on diverse hardware\.
- Agentic and RL\-rollout workloads that can use session\-aware caching\.

## Getting Started

- Install via pip or Docker\.
- Launch the server with a single command pointing to your model\.
- Query the API using standard OpenAI\-compatible endpoints\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supported hardware includes NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, CPU servers, TPU, Ascend NPUs, and XPU\.
- Installation options include Python via uv, Python, or Docker\.
- The installer offers Stable or Nightly builds, CUDA, ROCm, XPU, or CPU platforms, and CUDA 12\.9 or CUDA 13\.0 versions\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Beam search works alongside regular requests but does not yet support mixing with speculative decoding, disaggregation, or DP\.
- Prefill context parallelism v1 has been removed, and prefill CP is rejected on HIP, NPU, and MUSA until those platforms are ported\.
- Spec V1 is deprecated, with EAGLE and MTP now running on the unified V2 worker\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

SGLang 是面向大语言模型与多模态模型的高性能服务框架。它为大规模部署提供生产级推理，可从单 GPU 扩展到分布式集群，并支持广泛的开放模型和硬件平台。

## 核心功能

- 生产级推理面向大规模部署，可从单 GPU 到分布式集群提供可靠、低延迟、高吞吐的服务。模型与硬件灵活性覆盖从 LLM 到扩散模型等广泛开放模型，并可在多种硬件平台运行。高级优化包括分离式预填充/解码、投机解码、并行、零开销调度器和优化的 GPU 内核。提供 OpenAI 兼容的 API 端点，用于查询所服务的模型。支持 NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU、CPU 服务器、TPU、Ascend NPU 和 XPU。

## 适用场景

- 大语言和多模态模型的大规模生产推理。在单 GPU 和分布式集群部署中服务开放模型。在多种硬件上运行扩散模型和其他受支持的开放模型。可使用会话感知缓存的智能体和 RL rollout 工作负载。

## 快速开始

- 通过 pip 或 Docker 安装。使用指向模型的单条命令启动服务器。使用标准 OpenAI 兼容端点查询 API。

## 部署与要求

- 支持的硬件包括 NVIDIA GPU、AMD GPU、CPU 服务器、TPU、Ascend NPU 和 XPU。安装选项包括 Python（uv）、Python 或 Docker。安装程序提供 Stable 或 Nightly 构建、CUDA、ROCm、XPU 或 CPU 平台，以及 CUDA 12\.9 或 CUDA 13\.0 版本。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.taglineZh: 为 Android 开发提供 AI 优化模块化指令
projects.description: Android Skills is a repository of AI-optimized, modular markdown instructions that help agents understand and execute Android development patterns aligned with official best practices, focusing on workflows where LLMs underperform.
projects.descriptionZh: Android Skills 是面向 Android 开发的 AI 优化模块化 Markdown 指令仓库，帮助智能体理解并执行符合官方最佳实践的 Android 开发模式，并重点关注评估中 LLM 表现欠佳的工作流。
projects.content:
## Overview

Android Skills is a dedicated repository of AI\-optimized, modular instructions and resources for agents working on Android development\. It uses open\-standard agent skill markdown files, SKILL\.md, to provide task specifications and ground LLMs in specialized domains and workflows, with a focus on use cases where evaluations show LLMs underperform\.

## Key Features

- AI\-optimized, modular instructions and resources for Android development\.
- Open\-standard agent skill markdown files (SKILL\.md) that specify tasks and ground LLMs in specialized workflows\.
- Focus on Android use cases and workflows where evaluations show LLMs underperform\.
- Install individual skills, all skills, or selected agents through Android CLI\.
- Update all skills or specific skills with Android CLI\.
- Supports installation as an agent plugin for Claude Code and Codex\.

## Use Cases

- Help agents execute Android development patterns that follow official best practices\.
- Ground LLMs in specialized Android domains and workflows\.
- Install skills into a project directory or detected agent directories\.
- Prompt an agent to complete a relevant task so it automatically activates an installed skill\.

## Getting Started

- Install a specific skill into the current directory with Android CLI: android skills add r8\-analyzer \-\-project=\.
- Install all Android skills to directories for all detected agents: android skills add \-\-all\.
- Update all skills: android skills update \-\-all\.
- Update a specific skill: android skills update wear\-compose\-m3\.
- Install as a Claude Code plugin: /plugin install android\-skills \-\-marketplace android/skills\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Android CLI is used to install and update skills\.
- If no agent directories exist and no agents are specified, skills install for Gemini and Antigravity at ~/\.gemini/antigravity/skills\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- AI\-generated results can be incorrect, so users should verify outputs\.
- Installation and updates depend on Android CLI\.

projects.name: Skills
projects.tagline: Practical agent skills for real engineers
projects.taglineZh: 面向真实工程师的实用代理技能
projects.description: A practical, composable skill system for engineers who want to use AI coding agents without giving up their standards. Install the skills you want, then run slash commands to guide planning, specs, implementation, review, and debugging.
projects.descriptionZh: 一套实用且可组合的技能系统，帮助工程师在使用 AI 编码代理时保持工程标准。按需安装后，通过斜杠命令引导规划、规格、实现、审查与调试。
projects.content:
## Overview

Skills is a collection of small, composable instructions for coding agents, designed to encode senior\-engineering habits\. The skills cover an idea\-to\-ship flow across alignment, specs, tickets, implementation, review, debugging, architecture improvement, and productivity workflows, and they work with agents including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, and Amp\.

## Key Features

- A set of 27 MIT\-licensed skills organized into getting started, main flow, shaping, engineering, productivity, and reference groups\.
- Slash\-command workflows for alignment, specs, tickets, implementation, code review, retro, debugging, triage, and architecture improvement\.
- Composable skills whose outputs feed the next step in the workflow\.
- Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Amp, and other coding agents\.
- The installer writes editable skill files into your project, while Claude Code can alternatively use a managed, read\-only plugin\.

## Use Cases

- Aligning with a coding agent before starting a change by running a grilling session\.
- Turning an agreed conversation into a written spec and splitting it into agent\-sized tickets\.
- Implementing a spec test\-first and reviewing the resulting diff against standards\.
- Surveying a codebase for refactoring opportunities or diagnosing hard bugs from a failing reproduction\.

## Getting Started

- Install the skills with npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills, selecting the skills and agents you use\.
- For Claude Code, install the complete set as a managed, read\-only plugin with claude plugins install mattpocock\-skills\.
- Run /setup\-matt\-pocock\-skills once per repo to configure the issue tracker, triage labels, and where docs are saved\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The installer route copies editable skill files into your project, so updates are manual\.
- Choose either the plugin or the installer per agent because installing both duplicates every skill\.
- The architecture\-improvement skill is a survey that identifies candidates but does not refactor a legacy codebase for you\.

## 核心功能

projects.name: SPACE
projects.tagline: Sandboxed platform for agentic code execution
projects.taglineZh: 面向智能体代码执行的隔离沙箱平台
projects.description: SPACE is a sandboxed platform for agentic code execution. It runs agent and user code in isolated Firecracker microVMs and exposes an HTTP API to create Linux environments, execute commands, collect output, and manage sandbox lifecycles.
projects.descriptionZh: SPACE 是面向智能体代码执行的沙箱平台，可在隔离的 Firecracker 微虚拟机中运行智能体与用户代码，并通过 HTTP API 创建 Linux 环境、执行命令、收集输出和管理沙箱生命周期。
projects.content:
## Overview

SPACE (Sandboxed Platform for Agentic Code Execution) is a sandbox platform for running code in isolated Firecracker microVMs\. Applications use its HTTP API to create Linux environments, execute commands, collect output, and manage sandbox lifecycles\. A template supplies the starting environment, and a sandbox is an instance of that environment with its own VM and writable filesystem\.

## Key Features

- Runs agent, user, and code\-running jobs in isolated Firecracker microVMs\.
- Exposes an HTTP API for creating Linux environments, executing commands, collecting output, and managing sandbox lifecycles\.
- Supports multiple commands in the same sandbox, each with its own VM and writable filesystem\.
- Uses templates to supply starting environments and sandboxes as instances of those environments\.
- Provides asynchronous lifecycle operations through operation IDs that can be polled for completion\.
- Streams command output over a separate data\-plane connection using a session\-scoped attachment token\.

## Use Cases

- Running an agent in a separate execution environment\.
- Providing a user workspace for code execution\.
- Executing code\-running jobs in isolation\.

## Getting Started

- Follow Installation and configuration to deploy SPACE in a local Kind cluster and authenticate\.
- Follow Your first sandbox to run a command and collect its output\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- The setup guide covers Kubernetes; the architecture guide also explains how SPACE can run without it\.
- Host prerequisites, local Kind deployment, configuration defaults, authentication, verification, and teardown are covered in the installation documentation\.
- A local deployment uses a Kind cluster and requires authentication\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Some API schema fields are marked incubating and are outside the supported contract\.
- Sandbox lifecycle changes are asynchronous; clients poll an operation ID for completion\.
- Command output uses a separate data\-plane connection and a session\-scoped attachment token\.
- The documented setup path uses Kubernetes\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

SPACE（Sandboxed Platform for Agentic Code Execution）是一个在隔离的 Firecracker 微虚拟机中运行代码的沙箱平台。应用通过其 HTTP API 创建 Linux 环境、执行命令、收集输出并管理沙箱生命周期。模板提供起始环境，沙箱是该环境的一个实例，拥有自己的虚拟机和可写文件系统。

## 核心功能

- 在隔离的 Firecracker 微虚拟机中运行智能体、用户代码和代码执行作业。提供 HTTP API，用于创建 Linux 环境、执行命令、收集输出和管理沙箱生命周期。同一沙箱中可运行多条命令；沙箱拥有自己的虚拟机和可写文件系统。使用模板提供起始环境，沙箱是这些环境的实例。生命周期操作异步进行，API 返回可轮询完成状态的操作 ID。命令输出通过单独的数据平面连接和会话范围的附加令牌流式传输。

## 适用场景

- 在单独的隔离执行环境中运行智能体。为代码执行提供用户工作区。在隔离环境中执行代码运行作业。

## 快速开始

- 按照“安装与配置”文档在本地 Kind 集群中部署 SPACE 并完成认证。按照“你的第一个沙箱”文档运行命令并收集其输出。

## 部署与要求

- 安装指南说明 Kubernetes 部署；架构指南还说明 SPACE 如何在没有 Kubernetes 的情况下运行。安装文档涵盖主机前提条件、本地 Kind 部署、配置默认值、身份验证、验证和清理。本地部署使用 Kind 集群并需要身份验证。

## 采用前须知

- 许可证：Apache\-2\.0。在使用、修改或分发项目前，请确认其具体条款。

projects.description: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built from composable skills and instructions that make agents use them. It guides brainstorming, planning, TDD, subagent-driven development, and code review.
projects.descriptionZh: Superpowers 是一套面向编码智能体的完整软件开发方法论，由可组合的技能与初始指令构成，让智能体自动使用它们。它引导头脑风暴、计划制定、测试驱动开发、子智能体驱动开发与代码评审。
projects.content:
## Overview

Superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents\. It steps back to draw out intent, presents design in digestible chunks, creates an implementation plan, then uses composable skills that trigger automatically to support implementation, testing, review, and branch completion\.

## Key Features

- Composable skills and initial instructions that make coding agents use the methodology automatically\.
- Workflow covers brainstorming, design approval, writing plans, subagent\-driven development or inline execution, test\-driven development, code review, and finishing a development branch\.
- Skills library includes testing, debugging, collaboration, and meta skills such as test\-driven\-development, systematic\-debugging, brainstorming, writing\-plans, executing\-plans, requesting\-code\-review, and writing\-skills\.
- Supports separate installation across many coding agent harnesses, including Claude Code, Codex App and CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Qwen Code, and others\.
- Includes diagnosing\-superpowers for investigating session problems and packaging evidence for bug reports\.

## Use Cases

- Guiding a coding agent from initial idea through design, planning, implementation, review, and branch completion\.
- Running test\-driven development and subagent\-driven development workflows with review after each task\.
- Diagnosing a misbehaving agent session and producing evidence for a bug report\.
- Creating and testing new skills using the writing\-skills best practices\.

## Getting Started

- Installation differs by harness\. If you use more than one, install Superpowers separately for each one\.
- Claude Code: install from the official Claude plugin marketplace with /plugin install superpowers@claude\-plugins\-official\.
- Codex CLI: open the plugin search interface with /plugins, search for superpowers, and select Install Plugin\.
- Cursor: in Cursor Agent chat, install from the marketplace with /add\-plugin superpowers\.
- Devin CLI: install the plugin from this repository with devin plugins install obra/superpowers\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Superpowers must be installed separately for each coding agent harness in use\.
- Hermes users must restart active sessions after installing Superpowers\.
- Telemetry is enabled by default via a logo load that includes the Superpowers version\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

Superpowers 是一套面向编码智能体的技能框架与软件开发方法论。它会先退一步厘清你的真实意图，以易于消化的片段呈现设计，制定实施计划，然后通过自动触发的可组合技能，支持实现、测试、评审与分支收尾。

## 核心功能

- 可组合的技能与初始指令，让编码智能体自动采用这套方法论。
- 工作流覆盖头脑风暴、设计确认、编写计划、子智能体驱动开发或内联执行、测试驱动开发、代码评审以及开发分支收尾。
- 技能库涵盖测试、调试、协作与元技能，例如 test\-driven\-development、systematic\-debugging、brainstorming、writing\-plans、executing\-plans、requesting\-code\-review 和 writing\-skills。
- 支持在多种编码智能体宿主中分别安装，包括 Claude Code、Codex App 与 CLI、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI、OpenCode、Qwen Code 等。
- 包含 diagnosing\-superpowers，用于排查会话问题并整理证据以提交缺陷报告。

## 适用场景

- 引导编码智能体从最初想法一路走到设计、计划、实现、评审与分支收尾。
- 以每个任务后评审的方式运行测试驱动开发与子智能体驱动开发工作流。
- 诊断行为异常的智能体会话，并生成用于缺陷报告的证据。
- 按照 writing\-skills 的最佳实践创建和测试新技能。

## 快速开始

- 安装方式因宿主环境而异。若同时使用多个宿主，需要为每一个分别安装 Superpowers。

- Codex CLI：用 /plugins 打开插件搜索界面，搜索 superpowers，然后选择 Install Plugin。
- Cursor：在 Cursor Agent 对话中通过市场安装，命令为 /add\-plugin superpowers。
- Devin CLI：从本仓库安装插件，命令为 devin plugins install obra/superpowers。

## 采用前须知

projects.content:
## Overview

SWE\-agent enables your language model of choice to autonomously use tools to fix issues in real GitHub repositories, find cybersecurity vulnerabilities, or perform any custom task\. It is built and maintained by researchers from Princeton University and Stanford University\.

## Key Features

- State of the art on SWE\-bench among open\-source projects
- Free\-flowing and generalizable: leaves maximal agency to the language model
- Configurable and fully documented: governed by a single YAML file
- Made for research: simple and hackable by design
- Supports multimodal input for processing images from GitHub issues with vision\-capable models

## Use Cases

- Fixing issues in real GitHub repositories
- Finding cybersecurity vulnerabilities (offensive cybersecurity / CTF challenges)
- Performing custom coding tasks and competitive coding challenges

## Getting Started

- Install from source or try it in your browser via GitHub Codespaces\. See the documentation for installation and hello world tutorials\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires a language model API key (e\.g\., GPT\-4o or Claude Sonnet 4) and a Python environment\. Configuration is done via a single YAML file\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- SWE\-agent has been superseded by mini\-swe\-agent and is now in maintenance\-only mode\.
projects.contentZh:
## 项目简介

SWE\-agent 使您选择的语言模型（如 GPT\-4o 或 Claude Sonnet 4）能够自主使用工具修复真实 GitHub 仓库中的问题、发现网络安全漏洞或执行任意自定义任务。该项目由普林斯顿大学和斯坦福大学的研究人员构建和维护。

## 核心功能

- 在开源项目中，SWE\-bench 上达到先进水平
- 自由流动且可泛化：给语言模型最大自主权

projects.content:
## Overview

T3 Code is an open\-source control plane for coding agents\. It orchestrates Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, Cursor, and Grok from one surface, with desktop, web, and mobile apps\. Bring your own subscription and fork the whole thing\.

## Key Features

- Orchestrates multiple coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity) from one surface\.
- Bring your own subscription \- no token reselling, no quota caps\.
- One\-button PR creation with auto\-generated titles, bodies, and changelog, including draft and stack PRs\.
- Fully open source (MIT) and forkable \- customize UI, add agents, self\-host\.
- Available on desktop (Electron), web, and mobile (iOS/Android) with remote access\.

## Use Cases

- Remote development from mobile or another machine\.
- Unified control of multiple coding agents with existing subscriptions\.
- Streamlined PR workflow with auto\-generated PRs\.
- Customizing and forking the control plane for personal or team use\.

## Getting Started

- Install via the command line installer or package manager (winget, Homebrew, \.deb, AUR)\. After installation, authenticate at least one supported provider\. Run \`t3\` to start the server and open the local web app\. For desktop, download from GitHub Releases\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires at least one supported coding agent provider (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, or Antigravity) installed and authenticated on the machine\. Can be run as a background service\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Project is at an early stage and may contain bugs\.
- Contributions are mostly not accepted yet; only small fixes may be considered\.

projects.descriptionZh: ThinkRail 是围绕 pi 编码智能体构建的轻量级智能体 IDE，可将本地 git 仓库作为项目并创建隔离的 git worktree 工作区，把智能体对话与 Monaco 编辑器、终端、差异视图和持续维护的规格图结合起来。
projects.content:
## Overview

ThinkRail is an agentic IDE from JetBrains InnovationHub built around the pi coding agent\. It treats any local git repository as a project and creates isolated git\-worktree workspaces so multiple agents can work in parallel without touching the main checkout\. The workbench combines Monaco editor tabs, a files tree, live git diffs, terminals, and documents with concurrent pi chat sessions\. Project intent lives in a connected graph of SPEC\.md files that the agent can search and maintain through dedicated tools\.

## Key Features

- Isolated workspaces: any local git repository can become a project, and workspaces are cut as git worktrees with their own branch, files, terminals, and chats\.
- Parallel agent work: several pi sessions can run per workspace with per\-session models, live token and cost readouts, steering, queued follow\-ups, subagents, and a shared editable plan\.
- Real IDE workbench: Monaco editor tabs, a files tree, live git Changes diffs, real PTYs for terminals, documents, and anchored review comments scoped to the active workspace\.
- Spec graph as ground truth: SPEC\.md files with frontmatter form a connected graph beside the code, and the agent uses dedicated spec tools to search, navigate, and maintain it\.
- Skills and workflows: portable Agent Skills are read in place, and bundled workflows guide project setup, design brainstorming, and shipping a pull request through the user's gh\.
- MCP and provider flexibility: MCP servers can be connected with approval controls, and users sign in with JetBrains AI or connect any provider through pi auth\.

## Use Cases

- Running multiple coding agents in parallel on separate worktree branches while keeping the main checkout clean until a branch is merged\.
- Developing spec\-first, with the agent reading and maintaining a project intent graph so decisions survive a chat session\.
- Reviewing agent\-made changes through live diffs, terminals, and structured review comments before merging\.
- Extending agent workflows with existing Agent Skills, MCP servers, and bundled project setup or pull\-request workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Install the desktop app from the releases page, or use the platform installer to put the thinkrail CLI on the PATH\.
- Run thinkrail, optionally with a git repository path, to open the browser UI or desktop app\.
- Sign in with JetBrains AI or connect your own provider credentials through pi auth\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- macOS desktop builds support Apple Silicon only; there is no Intel desktop build\.
- Windows desktop builds are x64 and distributed as a setup ZIP\.
- Linux desktop builds for x64 and ARM64 need glibc 2\.38 or newer with GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4\.1, Ayatana AppIndicator 3, and librsvg 2, such as Ubuntu 24\.04 or newer\.
- The thinkrail CLI requires git on the PATH and a model provider, either JetBrains AI sign\-in or your own provider credentials\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Linux desktop and CLI artifacts are unsigned\.
- The macOS CLI is signed but not notarized\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Tolaria is a desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux for managing Markdown knowledge bases\. It is files\-first, Git\-first, and offline\-first: notes are plain Markdown files with YAML frontmatter, each vault is a Git repository, and no account or cloud dependency is required\. The app combines a block\-based editor, wikilinks, relationships, a built\-in Git client, and AI support through CLI coding agents or local/API model providers\.

## Key Features

- Plain Markdown files on disk with YAML frontmatter, no database or proprietary format\.
- Block\-based editor with slash commands, wikilinks, raw Markdown, whiteboards, media previews, table navigation, and note width controls\.
- Fully integrated Git client for committing, pushing, browsing history, and viewing per\-note version history\.
- AI support with CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, and Gemini, plus local or API model providers for chat over note context\.
- Native relationships and types as lenses, not schemas, for navigating notes\.
- Cross\-platform desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with offline\-first operation and no account required\.

## Use Cases

- Operate second brains and personal knowledge\.
- Organize company docs as context for AI\.
- Store OpenClaw/assistants memory and procedures\.
- Manage large personal vaults for journaling, writing, and knowledge management\.

## Getting Started

- On macOS, install via Homebrew with brew install \-\-cask tolaria\.
- Download the latest release for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- On first launch, you can clone the Getting Started vault for a walkthrough of the app\.
- Public user docs start with Install Tolaria and First Launch\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Desktop app supports macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- For local development: Node\.js 20\+, pnpm 8\+, Rust stable, and macOS or Linux\.
- Linux development requires WebKit2GTK 4\.1 and GTK 3, with distro\-specific packages\.
- The bundled MCP server spawns the system node binary at runtime on Linux for the external AI tooling flow\.
- Windows installers are Authenticode\-signed; company\-managed devices may still require IT approval of the Tolaria publisher before first install\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Windows installers are signed, but company\-managed devices may still require IT approval before first installation\.
- The external AI tooling flow on Linux depends on the system node binary for the bundled MCP server\.
- Tool\-backed AI editing depends on external CLI coding agents when that workflow is used\.
- Chat over note context can rely on local or API model providers and does not provide vault\-write tools\.

## Overview

TradingAgents is a stock trading framework inspired by trading firms\. It uses LLM\-powered agents in specialized roles, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts, bullish and bearish researchers, traders, and a risk management team\. Agents communicate through structured reports and focused debate to assess market conditions and make trading decisions\.

## Key Features

- LLM\-powered specialized agents cover fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis\.
- Bullish and bearish researcher agents debate market conditions and evaluate risk/reward\.
- Trader agents synthesize analyst and researcher insights to decide on trades\.
- A risk management team monitors exposure and adjusts trading plans within risk constraints\.
- A structured communication protocol combines reports with natural language debate to reduce information loss\.
- Backbone models can be exchanged for locally hosted or API\-accessible alternatives\.

## Use Cases

- Simulating collaborative trading\-firm workflows for research and decision\-making\.
- Backtesting trading strategies on historical financial data and comparing against baseline strategies\.
- Analyzing market signals from news, social media sentiment, fundamentals, and technical indicators\.
- Researching multi\-agent LLM coordination, debate, and risk\-management processes in finance\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- API credits are needed for model access\.

## Before You Adopt

projects.content:
## Overview

treg is an open\-source tool catalog and gateway for AI agents\. It provides a single token and base URL to access over 3,800 endpoints from 110 providers across areas such as SEO, backlinks, AI visibility, social media, enrichment, ads, and measurement\. Calls are priced per result, with credentials injected server\-side, and users can bring their own keys for unmetered access\.

## Key Features

- One unified key across 110 providers, so agents use a single treg token for all catalog tools\.
- 3,800\+ endpoints priced up front and billed per call, with no provider signup required\.
- Credentials are injected server\-side and never stored on the caller's machine\.
- The catalog is grouped by task, covering keyword and rank tracking, backlinks, AI visibility, trending content, publishing, enrichment, ads, and measurement\.
- Bring your own key overrides treg's keys and is never metered\.
- Open source under AGPL and self\-hostable\.

## Use Cases

- Equip coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw to act as SEO experts, social media managers, SDRs, or media buyers\.
- Find in\-market buyers from public signals such as complaints, job changes, hiring, funding, and tool adoption\.
- Create AI UGC videos with trending hooks, presenters, talking\-head clips, and captions\.
- Compare enrichment, web search, web fetch, and sitemap providers using live pricing, success rates, and speed data\.

## Getting Started

- Install the treg CLI with the official install script\.
- Sign in with GitHub, an email one\-time code, or a token for agents and CI\.
- Search the catalog by task, call a tool, and check your balance with the CLI\.
- Optionally install the treg plugin from the Claude Code plugin marketplace or add skills via the skills CLI\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The catalog relies on third\-party providers, and some capabilities are behind subscription walls or have no public API, requiring treg to carry provider accounts\.
- Credentials are injected server\-side, so callers never hold provider keys on their machines\.

projects.content:
## Overview

TrueForge is an open\-source agent harness with three parts: a core server that runs the agent loop, an HTTP API with a TypeScript SDK, and a chat UI with a React UI SDK\. It orchestrates bring\-your\-own model providers, MCP servers, and sandbox services, while handling planning, tool execution, context management, approvals, and session state\. It supports local mode with SQLite and hosted mode with Postgres and Redis\.

## Key Features

- Any model provider: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, other catalog providers, or any OpenAI\-compatible endpoint\.
- MCP tools: remote MCP servers with header auth or OAuth, including in\-chat authorization\.
- Skills: git\-backed SKILL\.md instruction packs loaded on demand in the sandbox\.
- Sandbox as a tool: isolated code and file execution provisioned only when needed, with secrets kept in the harness\.
- Human checkpoints: tool approval, ask\-user\-questions, and Generative UI in chat\.
- Context engineering: subagents, deferred tool loading, Code Mode, large\-result offloading, and compaction\.

## Use Cases

- Personal use on a local machine as a single process with SQLite, similar to Claude Desktop\.
- Team or production shared deployments with Postgres, Redis, and optional OIDC login\.
- Automating agent sessions and streaming turns from application code via the HTTP API and TypeScript SDK\.
- Embedding a customized chat interface in a React app with @truefoundry/trueforge\-ui\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @truefoundry/trueforge@latest for a local quickstart\.
- Use the Quickstart guide to run TrueForge locally or with Docker Compose, Kubernetes, or Railway, then connect models, tools, and skills and build a reusable agent\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Local mode runs as a single process with SQLite storage and no extra infrastructure\.
- Hosted mode uses Postgres for storage and Redis as extra infrastructure; it can run with Docker Compose, Helm, or Railway\.
- Shared deployments can enable optional OIDC login with admin versus user roles\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Local mode defaults to no login and stores data in a local SQLite file, which matters for access control and privacy\.
- Sandbox code and file execution currently depends on Daytona as the available sandbox provider\.

projects.description: TrustGraph is an open-source context graph platform with a deterministic agent runtime. It builds an ontology-grounded operating graph and checks AI agent actions against business meaning and evidence, returning allow, pause or deny.
projects.descriptionZh: TrustGraph 是一个开源上下文图谱平台，具有确定性代理运行时。它构建基于本体论的运营图谱，并根据业务含义和证据检查 AI 代理操作，返回允许、暂停或拒绝。
projects.content:
## Overview

TrustGraph is an open\-source context graph platform with a deterministic agent runtime\. It turns enterprise knowledge, systems, and business logic into an ontology\-grounded operating graph, then checks every action an AI agent proposes against business meaning, authority, and evidence before execution\. Decisions can be allow, pause, or deny, and each decision records the evidence and policy version behind it as W3C PROV\-O provenance\.

## Key Features

- Ontology\-grounded operating graph built from documents and systems using OWL, RDF 1\.2, SHACL, and domain or custom ontologies\.
- Deterministic agent runtime that checks proposed actions against semantic policy for authority, scope, risk, uncertainty, time, and value\.
- Allow, pause, or deny decisions recorded with evidence and policy version as queryable W3C PROV\-O provenance\.
- Deployment with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, on cloud or on\-prem, with hosted LLM APIs or self\-hosted open\-weight models\.
- Unstructured data ingest for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, Markdown, CSV, and images into ontology\-typed knowledge\.
- UI tools including Agent Console, GraphRAG View, Context Explorer, Document Ingestion, Ontology Workbench, Schema Workbench, and Prompt Editor\.

## Use Cases

- Finance and banking: enforce payments, approvals, and delegated authority on every agent action\.
- Agentic threat intelligence: unify threat, event, and log intelligence in one governed graph\.
- Pharmacovigilance: support traceable drug\-safety workflows with evidence behind every decision\.
- Aerospace, defense, and telecom: high\-assurance agents where decisions must be auditable and reproducible\.

## Getting Started

- Run npx @trustgraph/config to generate deployment configuration\.
- The config process outputs deploy\.zip with docker\-compose\.yaml for Docker or Podman or resources\.yaml for Kubernetes, plus INSTALLATION\.md\.
- A browser\-based Configuration Terminal is available for configuration\.
- Documentation includes Getting Started Guides, Developer APIs and CLI, and Deployment Guides\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Deploy with Docker Compose or Kubernetes\.
- Can run on every major cloud or on\-prem\.
- Supports hosted LLM APIs or open\-weight models on your own accelerators\.
- Includes managed multi\-model storage in Cassandra, vector embedding storage in Qdrant, file and object storage in Garage, and high\-speed pub/sub messaging with Pulsar or RabbitMQ\.
- Native inference stack supports vLLM, TGI, Ollama, LM Studio, and Llamafiles\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The core is open source, while some enterprise capabilities are provided as add\-ons with production engineering support\.
- Using third\-party LLM providers may require API keys\.
- Using third\-party OCR services may require API keys\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Unsloth is an open\-source framework for running and training LLMs\. It lets you run and train AI models on your own local hardware via an open\-source UI\. Supports MacOS, Linux, Windows, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and CPU setups\.

## Key Features

- Run and train LLMs, diffusion, embedding, audio models: Qwen3\.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax\-H3, Muse Glimmer, DeepSeek\-V4, Gemma 4\.
- Agents & Tools: Use local models with Claude Code, Codex, and MCP, including tool calling and code execution\.
- Search & RAG: Use private and unlimited web search, deep research, auto\-compaction (rolling context window) and RAG\.
- Remote & LAN: Access your local models from any device on LAN or remotely through secure Cloudflare HTTPS\.
- Fine\-tuning: Train LLMs, diffusion, TTS, and embedding models 2× faster with 70% less VRAM with no accuracy loss\.
- Export & Deploy: Export or Deploy models with including GGUF, NVFP4, FP8 and more formats\.

## Use Cases

- Run and train models locally for personal or research use\.
- Connect local models to coding agents like Claude Code and Codex\.
- Use private web search and RAG for deep research\.
- Fine\-tune models for specific tasks with reduced VRAM usage\.

## Getting Started

- Download the native desktop app for macOS, Windows, or Linux from the Unsloth website or GitHub Releases\.
- Alternatively, install manually: on macOS, Linux, or WSL run \`curl \-fsSL https://unsloth\.ai/install\.sh \| sh\`; on Windows PowerShell run \`irm https://unsloth\.ai/install\.ps1 \| iex\`\.
- A Docker image \`unsloth/unsloth\` is also available\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports MacOS, Linux, Windows, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel and CPU setups\.
- Supports Multi GPU setups, NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs, CPUs and the Vulkan backend\.
- For Docker, GPU access setup may be required on Linux\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VidBee is a free, open\-source desktop application for downloading video and audio from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, and 1000\+ sites, or importing local media\. It creates searchable, timestamped transcripts on your computer with speaker labels and playback sync, and can summarize, translate, or answer questions through supported AI providers\.

## Key Features

- Downloads video and audio from 1000\+ sites, including YouTube playlists, channels, search results, Watch Later, Liked videos, and private playlists\.
- Creates searchable, timestamped transcripts on your computer with speaker recognition and 100\+ language support\.
- Exports transcripts as text, Markdown, subtitles, or captioned video; downloads subtitles in SRT format with 50\+ languages\.
- Runs transcription locally with Whisper, SenseVoice, or Qwen3\-ASR after download, keeping speech and files on device\.
- Uses selected AI providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, or Groq for summaries, translation, FAQs, and mind maps\.
- Supports high\-quality downloads up to 4K and 8K, with subscription auto\-download and batch processing\.

## Use Cases

- Transcribe interviews, podcasts, lectures, YouTube downloads, or files already on your computer, then search for exact moments\.
- Review product research by finding every objection, grouping themes, and keeping original timestamps\.
- Build FAQ, chapter outline, quote library, or follow\-up questions from a transcript using AI workflows\.
- Download and archive YouTube playlists, channels, search results, Watch Later, or Liked videos for offline reference\.

## Getting Started

- Download VidBee for desktop for macOS, Windows, or Linux\.
- Paste a link or choose a file to download or import media\.
- Create a local transcript with speaker labels and timestamps\.
- Search transcript results and jump to exact moments, then export, summarize, or translate\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Supports macOS, Windows, and Linux\.
- Free with no account required\.
- Local transcription requires downloading a supported model once\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Downloads and transcripts stay on the user's computer rather than VidBee's servers\.
- VidBee relies on yt\-dlp and FFmpeg under the hood\.
- Local transcription requires an initial model download before it can run locally\.
- AI processing occurs only when the user sends content to a chosen provider\.

projects.content:
## Overview

VideoLingo is an AI video localization tool that combines speech recognition, subtitle translation, segmentation, alignment, and dubbing in a Streamlit interface\. It produces subtitle files and optionally subtitled or dubbed videos\. Translation quality depends on the source audio, language, and chosen models\.

## Key Features

- Intelligent subtitle segmentation using NLP and LLM technologies to segment subtitles based on sentence meaning\.
- Context\-aware translation with GPT\-generated terminology knowledge base and a three\-step process of direct translation, reflection, and paraphrasing\.
- Precise word\-level subtitle alignment using Qwen3\-ASR with Qwen3\-ForcedAligner\.
- High\-quality dubbing with GPT\-SoVITS, OpenAI, Edge TTS, and other TTS solutions, including personalized voice cloning\.
- YouTube video download via yt\-dlp and one\-click startup and processing in Streamlit\.
- Developer\-friendly structured files, multiple deployment methods, model searchbox with API auto\-fetch, and task control for pause, resume, or stop\.

## Use Cases

- Localize videos by generating translated subtitles and optionally dubbed audio\.
- Create dual subtitles for videos\.
- Dub videos with a cloned voice using GPT\-SoVITS or other TTS methods\.
- Process YouTube videos through a multilingual subtitle and dubbing workflow\.

## Getting Started

- On Windows, download the source code zip from the latest release, extract it, double\-click OneKeyStart\.bat, and keep the window open; the first run installs uv, Python 3\.12, app dependencies, and FFmpeg and requires an internet connection\.
- After installation, VideoLingo opens in the browser; enter the API URL, key, and model in the sidebar to start using it\.
- Install from source on Windows, macOS, or Linux by cloning the repository and running uv run start\.py\.
- For the HTTP API, configure config\.yaml and run uv run start\.py \-\-api from the project root\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- VideoLingo supports Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel), and Linux\.
- The Windows one\-click first run requires an internet connection and installs uv, Python 3\.12, app dependencies, and FFmpeg\.
- Docker deployment for Linux NVIDIA containers requires Docker, a compatible GPU driver, and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit; the image uses Python 3\.12 and CUDA 12\.8\.1/cu128 by default\.
- LLM use requires an OpenAI\-compatible Chat Completions provider and model that can return the structured JSON required by the workflow\.
- Speech recognition runs Qwen3\-ASR with ForcedAligner locally by default, or can use ElevenLabs or MAI\-Transcribe\-2\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The former Excel batch mode has been replaced by a local HTTP API for agents and scripts\.
- Some speech recognition options send audio to external providers and may incur charges\.
- Recognition and word timestamps can be affected by background noise and language\-specific alignment models, and numbers or symbols may lack reliable word timings\.
- The workflow requires LLM output to satisfy its JSON structure\.
- Dubbing quality and timing depend on translation, TTS service, and speech rate, and speed adjustment does not guarantee natural delivery or perfect synchronization\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Void is a CLI, platform, and full\-stack SDK that unifies building and deploying apps\. It supports building and deploying full\-stack apps with Vite on Cloudflare Workers, with server routes, pages, typed APIs, databases, storage, AI, and one\-command deployment workflows\.

## Key Features

- Void SDK provides file\-based API routes, server\-rendered pages, and typed APIs for databases, storage, and AI, carrying types from database queries to the UI\.
- Void CLI builds apps, provisions Cloudflare resources, applies migrations, deploys, manages resources, inspects logs, and rolls back\.
- Void Platform installs a shared deployment environment in your Cloudflare account for teams or customers, with access controls, resource limits, usage reporting, and connected applications\.
- SDK features are optional and composable; you can use React, Vue, Svelte, or Solid for Void pages or keep a supported application framework\.
- Void supports TanStack Start, SvelteKit, Nuxt, and more through adapters, and can build APIs, SPAs, or server\-rendered pages\.
- npx void deploy builds the app, provisions resources, applies database migrations, and prints the deployed URL\.

## Use Cases

- Build and deploy full\-stack Vite apps on Cloudflare Workers\.
- Let a team build and deploy apps with coding agents while admins retain control of Cloudflare access\.
- Self\-host a shared Void Platform in your Cloudflare account for your team or customers\.
- Build APIs, SPAs, or server\-rendered pages with supported Vite frameworks\.

## Getting Started

- Use Node\.js 24\.21\.0 or later\. In an empty directory, run npm install \-D void, npx void init, and npm run dev\.
- Choose your UI framework and starter, then select Cloudflare to deploy to your account\.
- Run npx void deploy to build the app, provision resources, apply database migrations, and print the deployed URL\.
- To deploy to a team platform, run npx void connect \<url\> first, then use the same deploy command\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Node\.js 24\.21\.0 or later\.
- A Cloudflare account as the deployment target for npx void deploy\.
- For team platform deployment, run npx void connect \<url\> before deploying\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Team deployments are designed so admins retain control of Cloudflare access and credentials\.
- Void Platform can be self\-hosted and customized for a team's security needs\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Warp is an agentic development environment that evolved from the terminal\. It provides Warp Factories, an open platform for building cloud software factories: fleets of agents wired to the SDLC and defined in code\. Teams can automate work across tasks such as triage, implementation, review, and incident response, with evals, benchmarks, and self\-improvement built in\.

## Key Features

- Warp Factories as code in factory\.yaml, defining repositories, agents, models, permissions, checkpoints, and triggers\.
- Works with any MCP\-capable coding agent and any model or harness, including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI\.
- Provides API, CLI, SDK, and MCP interfaces for running agents and integrating with workflows\.
- Includes built\-in evals, benchmarks, quality loops, and self\-improvement that scores runs and can open PRs against the factory config\.
- Offers a governance and control plane for centrally configured agent access, permissions, and cost per PR visibility\.
- Includes Warp Terminal and Warp Agent CLI for agentic coding in the terminal and any terminal\.

## Use Cases

- Code review: first\-pass review on every PR\.
- Bug investigation: reproduce bugs and route fixes\.
- Refactors and migration: scope, migrate, and validate changes\.
- Incident response: investigate alerts and summarize next steps\.

## Getting Started

- Download Warp terminal and read the docs for platform\-specific instructions\.
- Request early access to Warp Factories\.
- To build and run Warp from source, run \./script/bootstrap, \./script/run, and \./script/presubmit\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: AGPL\-3\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Warp Factories are in closed early access, with usage credits available to qualifying organizations\.
- Warp Factories use usage\-based pricing charged per agent run\.
- Customers can choose where data lives, including a self\-hosted VPC under existing retention and compliance rules\.
- The new agentic management workflows are powered by GPT models, and OpenAI is the founding sponsor of the open\-source Warp repository\.

projects.content:
## Overview

Whisper is a general\-purpose speech recognition model trained on a large dataset of diverse audio\. It is a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification\. It uses a Transformer sequence\-to\-sequence model trained on various speech processing tasks, including voice activity detection, with tasks represented as token sequences\.

## Key Features

- Multilingual speech recognition
- Speech translation
- Language identification
- Voice activity detection
- Multiple model sizes (tiny to turbo) with speed and accuracy tradeoffs

## Use Cases

- Transcribe speech in audio files using command\-line or Python API
- Translate non\-English speech into English
- Detect spoken language in audio
- Process audio with a sliding 30\-second window for long recordings

## Getting Started

- Install with pip install \-U openai\-whisper\. Requires ffmpeg installed on the system\. For Python usage, load a model with whisper\.load\_model('turbo') and call transcribe on an audio file\. Command\-line usage: whisper audio\.flac \-\-model turbo\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Requires Python 3\.8\-3\.11 and PyTorch\. Requires ffmpeg\. Model sizes have varying VRAM requirements from ~1 GB to ~10 GB\. May require Rust if tiktoken does not provide a pre\-built wheel\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: MIT\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Performance varies widely by language and real\-world speed depends on many factors\.

projects.content:
## Overview

WordCraft is an open\-source, clean\-room reimplementation of Microsoft Word built in pure Rust\. It is a native word processor with the familiar ribbon workflow, styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge, and it reads and writes \.docx\.

## Key Features

- Familiar ribbon interface with tabs, groups, keyboard shortcuts and a live Styles gallery\.
- Reads and writes \.docx natively, imports and exports \.odt, \.rtf, \.html, \.md and \.txt, and exports PDF with selectable text\.
- Cached paragraph layout and on\-demand page rendering keep large documents responsive\.
- Track changes, margin comment balloons, accept/reject review, document comparison, and offline spelling and grammar\.
- References support including tables of contents, footnotes, citations and bibliographies in APA, MLA, Chicago and IEEE styles, indexes and captions\.
- Command\-driven automation through a command\-line tool, JSON control channel and MCP server\.

## Use Cases

- Writing and editing \.docx documents in a Word\-like native application\.
- Producing academic and business documents with citations, bibliographies, footnotes and tables of contents\.
- Reviewing documents with track changes, comments and document comparison\.
- Automating document inspection, conversion and editing through CLI and MCP workflows\.

## Getting Started

- Download a standalone build for macOS, Windows, Linux or Web, or use the ArtCraft Launcher\.
- To build from source, install Rust 1\.90 or newer, clone the repository, change into the wordcraft directory, and run cargo run \-\-release \-p wordcraft\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Runs natively on macOS, Windows, Linux and BSD, and in the browser via WebAssembly\.
- Build from source requires Rust 1\.90 or newer\.
- Linux builds are available as Flatpak, AppImage, Debian package, RPM package and tarball\.
- A web build is available to host yourself\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The project page lists WordCraft as in development\.

projects.content:
## Overview

XERJ is an AI\-native search engine that indexes code, documents, and data, then answers agent questions from the index instead of the context window\. It speaks the Elasticsearch API and ships as one Rust binary\.

## Key Features

- One Rust binary with no JVM, Apache\-2\.0 licensed, running from laptop to server with the same artifact\.
- Autoindex sniffs 13 format families by content, infers mappings, records junk instead of crashing, and resumes idempotent ingest\.
- AST code search parses source with tree\-sitter across 36 languages into symbols, kinds, line numbers, and searchable definitions\.
- Hybrid search supports 50 query types, including native BM25 and kNN fusion in one query tree\.
- Elasticsearch API compatibility with 1,366 of 1,369 wire\-conformance cases green on every commit\.
- Agent memory and graph features provide namespaced /\_memory REST APIs and a /\_graph knowledge layer with evidence on every link\.

## Use Cases

- Reference coding: clone and index open\-source repos closest to a task, then retrieve how they solved a problem before writing code\.
- Codebase Q&A and RAG: index a repo and get the mechanism with file line details instead of a directory listing\.
- Security audits: index a target tree and query for sink patterns, secrets, and dangerous calls across every file type at once\.
- Agent long\-term memory: store what an agent learns and recall it by meaning in later sessions\.

## Getting Started

- Install XERJ with the one\-line installer\.
- Start a node with xerj \-\-insecure \-\-data\-dir \./data & for local development\.
- Run xerj autoindex ~/my\-project to index a folder by content\.
- Use xerj search for ranked passages and xerj def for go\-to\-definition results\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Prebuilt for Linux, macOS, and Windows on x86\-64 and arm64\.
- Static musl by default, so it can run on any distro including Alpine\.
- No JVM and no dependencies; the same static binary runs from laptop to server\.
- Auth is on by default unless \-\-insecure is used; autoindex needs \-\-api\-key or XERJ\_API\_KEY when auth is enabled\.
- The default lexical embedder is offline; neural mode needs three model files staged locally before the first semantic operation\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Apache\-2\.0\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- The built\-in embedder is lexical rather than neural, so semantic retrieval is based on vocabulary overlap, not neural understanding\.
- Neural embedding mode requires staging three model files locally before semantic operations\.
- Reference coding can be neutral or harmful on popular public libraries the model already knows\.

## 项目简介

XERJ 是一个 AI 原生搜索引擎，为代码、文档和数据建立索引，随后由索引而非上下文窗口回答智能体的提问。它使用 Elasticsearch API，并以单个 Rust 二进制文件的形式发布。

## 核心功能

- 单个 Rust 二进制，无 JVM，Apache\-2\.0 许可，同一构件从笔记本到服务器通用。
- autoindex 按内容嗅探 13 种格式家族，推断映射，把无用文件记录下来而不是报错，并支持可断点续传的幂等导入。
- AST 代码搜索使用 tree\-sitter 解析 36 种语言的源码，提取符号、类型、行号和可搜索的定义字段。
- 混合检索支持 50 种查询类型，包括在单个查询树中融合原生 BM25 与 kNN。
- 兼容 Elasticsearch API，每次提交有 1,366 / 1,369 条 wire 一致性用例通过。
- 智能体记忆与图谱：带命名空间的 /\_memory REST API，以及每条链接都带证据的 /\_graph 知识层。

## 适用场景

- 参考编码：克隆并索引与任务最接近的开源仓库，在写代码前检索它们如何解决该问题。
- 代码库问答与 RAG：为仓库建立索引，得到含 file:line 的机制说明，而不是目录列表。
- 安全审计：为目标代码树建立索引，一次跨所有文件类型查询 sink 模式、密钥和危险调用。
- 智能体长期记忆：存储智能体学到的东西，并在之后的会话中按语义召回。

## 快速开始

- 使用一行安装命令安装 XERJ。
- 本地开发时用 xerj \-\-insecure \-\-data\-dir \./data & 启动节点。
- 运行 xerj autoindex ~/my\-project 按内容为文件夹建立索引。
- 用 xerj search 获取排序后的段落，用 xerj def 获取定义位置。

## 部署与要求

- 提供 Linux、macOS 和 Windows 的 x86\-64 与 arm64 预编译版本。
- 默认使用静态 musl，因此可运行于包括 Alpine 在内的任何发行版。

## Overview

Zed is a minimal code editor crafted for speed and collaboration with humans and AI\. It is written from scratch in Rust to efficiently leverage multiple CPU cores and the GPU\. Zed supports macOS, Linux, and Windows\.

## Key Features

- Written from scratch in Rust to efficiently leverage multiple CPU cores and the GPU\.
- Agentic editing with parallel agents that can edit files, navigate code, and run tools at native speed\.
- Collaboration features for chatting with teammates, coding together, and sharing screen and project\.
- Native Git support for staging, committing, pulling, pushing, viewing diffs, and many more operations\.
- Debugger built on the Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP) with native support across multiple programming languages\.
- Edit Prediction powered by Zeta2, an open\-weight language model\.

## Use Cases

- Collaborative coding with teammates in real time\.
- Running multiple agents in parallel across projects for agentic editing\.
- Debugging code across multiple programming languages with native DAP support\.
- Remote development where the local machine runs the Zed UI and the codebase runs on a remote server\.

## Getting Started

- Download Zed for macOS, Linux, or Windows\.

## Deployment & Requirements

- Available for macOS, Linux, and Windows\.
- Remote Development can run the Zed UI locally while the codebase runs on a remote server\.

## Before You Adopt

- License: Other\. Review its terms before using, modifying, or distributing the project\.
- Debugging support depends on the Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP)\.
- Remote Development uses a remote server to run the codebase while the local machine runs only the Zed UI\.

## 项目简介

Zed 是一款极简代码编辑器，专为速度以及与人类和 AI 协作而打造。它使用 Rust 从零编写，以高效利用多核 CPU 和 GPU。Zed 支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。

## 核心功能

## 适用场景

## 快速开始

- 从 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 下载 Zed 即可开始使用。

## 部署与要求
